jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Our Sales Development team play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives.

We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology.

In this role you will:

Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market

Engage in outbound activities such as cold calling, emailing, and social media outreach to initiate contact with potential customers

Implement personalized and effective outreach campaigns to maximize lead conversion.

Collaborate closely with the Account Executive to exchange insights on prospect feedback, objections, and market trends

Continuously refine and adjust outreach strategies based on the feedback loop

Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to outbound sales activities, including conversion rates, lead quality, and outreach effectiveness

Collaborate with the sales leadership to analyze data and optimize strategies for better results

Requirements

2–3+ years of outbound B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of securing net-new business meetings

Proven ability to build and qualify opportunity-sized lead lists in new markets and verticals

Fluency with modern prospecting tools and multi-channel outreach strategies

Experience building and scaling outbound processes in fast-paced environments

Intellectually curious, asking thoughtful questions and developing insights-driven approaches to outreach

Highly self-motivated, able to work independently while thriving in a collaborative team culture

Strong prioritization and time management skills, with the ability to handle a high volume of leads efficiently

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Fluency in additional European languages is desirable but not essential 

Location

This role is remote-first, however there is a preference for candidates to be based in London or Dublin with the option to work out of one of our offices.

#LI-Remote

Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Lead Growth Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. Our aim is to help the business understand what is driving growth, where performance is changing, and where the biggest opportunities and risks are.

In this role, you will lead analysis on some of our most important growth questions. You will take ownership of analytical workstreams end to end, from framing the business question and exploring the data through to clear recommendations and supporting execution.

A key part of the role will be helping teams make better growth and investment decisions. You will bring together signals from channel performance, customer behaviour and experimentation to understand what is driving performance.

You will partner closely with Growth, Marketing and Product teams, acting as a trusted thought partner.

Key responsibilities

Drive end-to-end analysis on priority growth questions, from problem definition through to recommendation and measurement.

Proactively identify and investigate changes in growth performance, including the key drivers, risks and opportunities behind them, rather than waiting for questions to be handed over.

Identify and size growth opportunities across channels, customer journeys and Product.

Support investment decisions by bringing together MMM, channel performance and customer behaviour.

Build clear growth narratives from complex analysis, translating data into concise, understandable insights with a strong “so what”, and clearly articulating the implications and actions for stakeholders.

Contribute to wider commercial questions such as forecasting, pricing and scenario analysis where they materially affect growth.

Build scalable analytical approaches that improve the speed, consistency and quality of decision-making.

Act as a trusted analytical partner, bringing a clear analytical point of view that shapes key growth decisions.

Own key stakeholder relationships and help ensure analytical recommendations are followed through into action and measurable impact.

Mentor other analysts and help raise the analytical bar across the team.

Experience and competencies

Significant experience in growth, marketing, or commercial analytics within a digital, marketplace, subscription or consumer technology business.

Strong understanding of growth, customer acquisition, funnel performance and the interaction between Marketing and Product.

Experience analysing customer journeys across multiple stages of the funnel, including cohort behaviour, lifecycle performance and longer conversion or nurturing journeys.

Good knowledge of marketing effectiveness approaches such as MMM, incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution.

Proven ability to independently structure and lead complex or ambiguous analytical work.

Strong commercial judgement and the ability to move from analysis to clear recommendations.

Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, influencing without authority and partnering closely with leadership teams.
Flexible and open-minded, able to thrive in a fast-moving, evolving environment.

Clear, confident communicator with strong written and verbal presentation skills.

Tools and technical skills

Advanced SQL. You're not reaching for documentation for standard analytical patterns

Familiarity with analytical tools and languages such as Python or R.

Experience working with marketing and experimentation data from major digital platforms and internal data warehouses (we use Databricks).

Practical understanding of advanced measurement methodologies and their limitations in real-world decision-making.

Nice to have: experience integrating AI tools into analytical workflows in a way that's actually made a difference

Compensation

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family

Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
year towards travel costs to and from sits

Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan

Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan

Specsavers eyecare scheme

Weekly virtual yoga sessions

Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

 💻 Working environment

Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident

Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start

Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe

We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year

We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth

Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)

Competitive salary which is reviewed annually

Generous equity package for permanent employees

Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly

Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters

£500 recruitment referral bonus

If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

When the world's largest organizations bet on Mural, Govern & Trust is the team that earns that trust at scale. We build the experiences that help enterprises roll out Mural with confidence, keep it secure, and see the impact it has on how their people work. Data sits at the center of it all. Admins are Mural's most demanding data consumers: they need to prove ROI to their leadership, guide adoption across thousands of people, and account for every action. If data products can meet their bar, they'll work for everyone.

 Mural has a modern data platform, strong data engineering and analytics teams, and a wealth of data on how teams collaborate. The next step is treating that data as a product in its own right, with a dedicated owner for what it means and how it's used.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Product Manager you'll define the metrics that describe how Mural creates value, and make them the shared foundation for everything built on top. The same definitions will power internal product decisions, the Insights experience Admins use in the product, and the reporting API and MCP server that customers and AI agents query.

This role starts upstream. You'll work from raw product events to decide what each metric should measure, how it's calculated, and what the data needs to look like for customers and internal teams to rely on it. Then you'll turn those metrics into experiences that help organizations understand and grow their use of Mural.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The evolution of data products. Shape how Mural's data products move from reporting on what happened to guiding what happens next. Work across the Govern & Trust portfolio to define how insights become part of how organizations run Mural.

The metric layer. Define Mural's shared, cross-product metrics, like activity, collaboration, and adoption. Set the standards that let product teams define and publish their own metrics consistently. Data Engineering builds and runs the layer; you shape what goes in it and how it evolves.

Internal product analytics. Be a thought partner to domain PMs as they set their north-star metrics, and make product data easy for them to explore on their own. Work with Business Analytics to keep product-facing and business-facing reporting working together.

Customer-facing data products. Own the strategy and roadmap for Insights: in-product reporting and dashboards, exports and APIs, audit logs, and the methodology behind every number customers see.

AI and agent access. Package and launch Mural's customer-facing reporting MCP server: which data it exposes, which plans get it, and what guardrails apply. Define how natural-language and agent-driven analysis extends Insights.

Instrumentation. R&D teams own emitting events. Your job is to raise the bar on what they emit. Set per-product requirements for granularity and retention, which differ for audit logs, activity data, and product analytics. Partner with Data Engineering on event standards so metrics start from good data.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 5+ years of product management experience, including shipping at least one analytics or reporting product used by paying business customers. You defined the metrics behind it, not just the UI.

A track record of making messy or conflicting data trustworthy: reconciling competing definitions, writing metric specs engineers could build from, and getting instrumentation changed upstream.

Experience building both platform products, where your customers are internal teams or developers, and end-user-facing data products like analytics, reporting, or insights. You understand how the two have to work together.

Working knowledge of modern data stacks: event pipelines, warehouses and lakehouses, dbt-style modeling, and semantic layers. You can write SQL and pull data yourself.

The ability to get agreement on definitions across teams you don't manage, including PMs, data engineering, analytics, finance, and go-to-market.

Experience with enterprise admin or governance products (IAM, security, compliance, audit)

Hands-on experience with semantic layer tools (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML)

Experience designing APIs, MCP servers, or connectors for analytics

Equal Opportunity 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Position: Account Specialist
The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This position requires verbal and written fluency in German.

The Role:
As an Account Specialist, you will provide white glove service to diverse brands investing in influencer marketing campaigns. This role is particularly focused on campaign execution, including but not limited to driving influencer recruitment, managing influencer partnerships, and owning campaign deliverables, tracking, and reporting. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives.
The successful candidate will have strong experience in developing and managing successful, KPI-driven influencer marketing campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies. They will have working knowledge of the overall partner marketing landscape, including affiliate, and the ability to both develop comprehensive strategy as well as capably execute. The successful candidate will be a self-starter that can confidently plug in to any challenging situation with ease and can balance competing priorities well. The Account Specialist must be flexible, willing and able to pivot quickly, and excited to operate successfully in an “intrapreneurial” situation. This person will also have a history of working well with their peers, quickly establishing relationships easily and leading through influence.

You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth.

Top 5 Responsibilities:

INFLUENCER RECRUITMENT, NEGOTIATING & ONBOARDING –Sources new partnership opportunities and creates influencer casting lists. Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes.

INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS MANAGEMENT – Crafts program-wide influencer communications and vital creator resources. Guides influencers on content strategy and creation. Works with influencers to develop content timelines and ensures influencers stay on track with the schedules discussed. Collects content drafts and leads the content review process, including screening to ensure FTC guidelines are met. Closely works with influencers to adjust content strategy as needed, troubleshooting any signs of poor performance to optimize campaign towards goals and objectives.

AUDITING, REPORTING & ANALYSIS – Accountable for auditing program content to ensure compliance with FTC regulations and brand guidelines. Ensures content is tracked accurately and regularly shared with client, along with placement insights, partner insights, and campaign pace towards KPI goals. Performs robust analysis of influencer campaigns using both social analytics and conversion metrics to identify performance trends and areas of opportunity. Proactively provides actionable recommendations to client backed by data and continuously refines strategy to drive growth at scale. Supports team in creation of customized strategy plans, detailed campaign performance summaries and comprehensive hindsight presentations that are delivered to clients.

CLIENT SERVICE & COMMUNICATION- Consistently provides superior client service and escalates issues or key risks as appropriate. Works to ensure client develops trust in our team by delivering client outputs and communications in the AP way, consistently maintaining quality, accuracy, and precision. Develops and nurtures excellent relationships, supports team in promoting very high client satisfaction and retention rates, and an average 8.5 client rating.

PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT- Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Manages multiple campaigns with solid organizational skills and the ability to focus on and prioritize tasks based on client objectives, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Has full grasp of each client’s scope of work, delivering what is due under terms; maintains ability to identify new opportunities to drive client success while conjunctively identifying possible goal misalignments, getting to the root of an issue, and working with their team to bring solutions to resolve.

What Success Looks Like:
BY 3 MONTHS:

The Account Specialist is contributing across a portfolio of influencer programs, collaborating with their team closely to ensure strong alignment with the campaign strategy in place.

You are working with key client contacts to ensure brand alignment with recruitment efforts and content creation.

You have become familiar with AP’s tools and solutions and are equipped to conduct casting for prospective influencers, execute content timelines with influencers, audit content, and ensure performance is tracked and measured.

By 6 MONTHS:

You are owning execution of the day-to-day operations of multiple influencer programs with little guidance from your team, including reporting, processing applications, recruiting and casting creators, and crafting partner communications.

Challenging client or team situations are being managed with guidance from managers and directors collaborating closely to bring a solutions-oriented approach to these situations proactively.

You are regularly analyzing client data and strategically leveraging insights to optimize campaigns.

Client accounts are being handled effectively and strategically, without dropping any balls, and clients are aware of and pleased with this outcome. Clients are being serviced profitably with AP targets, client KPI’s being met, and an average 8.5 client rating is being upheld across campaigns.

You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance

By 1 YEAR:

You will troubleshoot and resolve account and creator issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.

You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.

You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.

Qualities of the Ideal Candidate

Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well

Only provides superior results and unsurpassed customer service

Exhilarated by managing change and comfortable with ambiguity and moving targets

Passionate about the digital marketing industry and how influencer relates to the greater digital landscape

Ensures that influencer strategies and tactics have measurable results

Has incredible attention to detail and is capable of multi-tasking and coordinating several projects at once

Translates data and insights into actionable next steps for clients

Strong with data analysis, is easily able to pinpoint issues and opportunities within a data set

Prioritizes competing objectives and manages time with skill

Displays accountability, always meeting deadlines and keeping commitments

Thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to chaos

Likes to share and collaborate with peers in a remote environment

Possesses superior written and verbal communication skills

Possesses mature and measured judgment, and the ability to solve problems on their own

Works independently with minimal supervision

Has confidence, poise, and eloquence in client meetings and difficult situations

Hears and incorporates feedback from other team members, clients and partners

Qualifications & Skills:

Fluency in German

2+ years working for an influencer marketing agency and experience executing influencer campaigns and managing both client and influencer relationships

Solid understanding of omni-channel and digital marketing, with a track record of successfully running influencer campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies

Excellent at communicating, presenting and approval from clients on new campaign strategies and initiatives

Working knowledge of attribution in digital marketing

Strong understanding of how influencer and affiliate marketing can work together

Tools (CreatorIQ, Grin, Izea, etc.) experience preferred, not required

Knowledge of Affiliate Networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, ShareASale, Commission Junction, etc.) experience preferred, not required

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

Ability to travel up to 15%

Advanced Excel capabilities and comfortable with formatting, formulas, customizing reports, etc.

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?
Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER 

100% remote work for everyone

Maintain a strong understanding of competitive dynamics, buyer trends, and ecosystem shifts across the region

Proven track record of personally sourcing, structuring, and closing strategic partnerships that drive revenue

Experience operating as a senior individual contributor with high ownership and autonomy in fast-growing or early-stage companies

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs.

What you'll do:

Risk Management

Perform risk assessments and process incoming risk questions and intake requests

Track risk treatment plans and follow up with owners on progress

Manage the exceptions and issues tracking process, including intake, documentation, expiration follow-up, and reporting

Support third-party risk activities, such as vendor assessments, questionnaire review, and tracking remediation

Compliance and Audit

Coordinate evidence collection from control owners and chase outstanding requests

Help prepare control owners and stakeholders for audit interviews

Keep the SOC 2 system description, ISMS documentation, and Statement of Applicability (SoA) up to date

Track audit gaps and findings and drive remediation to closure with control owners

Security Program Support

Help GRC and partner teams run governance for the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), including tracking adoption, gathering evidence, and maintaining supporting standards

Support data classification and data governance efforts by maintaining documentation, tracking adoption, and coordinating with data owners

Assist with business impact analysis (BIA) and business continuity/disaster recovery (BC/DR) activities, including plan maintenance, exercise coordination, and follow-up on gaps

Track vulnerability management metrics and remediation status, and follow up with system owners on overdue items

Help coordinate penetration testing engagements, from scoping and scheduling through findings tracking and remediation follow-up

GRC Operations and Tooling

Serve as an administrator for our GRC platform, including users, workflows, integrations, and reporting

Identify opportunities to streamline processes and automate repetitive GRC work

Help maintain policies, standards, and supporting documentation

What you'll bring:

Experience in cybersecurity, GRC, IT audit, or a related field (typically 2-4 years)

Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST

Familiarity with risk assessment concepts and the risk management lifecycle

Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle many workstreams and deadlines at once

Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with technical and non-technical stakeholders

A collaborative, curious mindset and a genuine desire to learn and take on new challenges

Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees—we share in our success as one team.

Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage.

Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute).

Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together.

Annual professional development budget.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend 

The Opportunity: 

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.

Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.

Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.

Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.

Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.

Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.

Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.

Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.

Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.

Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.

Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.

Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.

A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.

A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.

Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.

Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.

An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.

Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. 

Bonus Points For

Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.

Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.

Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.

Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.

Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 124,571 - EUR 149,485. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. 

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

As General Manager, Industrial Products & Services (IPS), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s business across Automotive, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Oil & Gas, Chemical, and Logistics clients, with full P&L and budget authority. You will identify where we can win, decide where to invest, and build the team and client relationships to deliver sustained growth. Your mandate covers winning new enterprise clients, expanding existing relationships, and increasing the value clients receive from Toptal’s capabilities.

You will bring a clear perspective on the challenges facing potential clients and where Toptal can help. Working with our Services leaders and subject matter experts, you will translate those challenges into viable sales proposals across our AI solutions, managed services, management consultancy, and talent offerings. You will choose which markets, accounts, and opportunities to pursue, allocate resources accordingly, and give your team a focused plan.

You will lead from the front: personally leading executive client conversations, shaping proposals, working through difficult commercial negotiations, and helping close critical pursuits. Your team should see the selling standard you expect in your own work. You will understand what is driving performance, where growth is constrained, and what needs to change.

You will build on established enterprise relationships to expand the problems clients trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will have the authority to build the team and invest in profitable growth.

This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

Set and execute the industry strategy. Identify the markets, client problems, and offerings with the strongest growth potential. Build an IPS business plan with clear priorities, financial objectives, and investment decisions. Test your assumptions with clients and adjust the plan as evidence changes.

Own the P&L and budget. Be accountable for revenue, profitability, and spending. Set and manage the budget, allocate resources, and evaluate returns on investments in people and growth initiatives. Understand how pricing, delivery economics, retention, and portfolio mix affect results, and act when performance diverges from the plan.

Win new enterprise clients. Lead your team in pursuing priority accounts. Develop a credible reason for each client to engage with Toptal, build relationships with decision-makers, and personally advance important opportunities through discovery, solution development, negotiation, and close.

Expand and retain client relationships. Work with Client Partners to understand client priorities, broaden relationships across buying centers, and develop opportunities across Toptal’s portfolio. Stay close to important engagements, resolve concerns with the responsible teams, and turn successful outcomes into further business.

Make account planning actionable. Establish clear priorities and ownership. Expect your team to explain why an account matters, whom they need to engage, what opportunity they are pursuing, and how they will create progress. Ensure priority accounts receive sustained attention.

Bring the right expertise into the sale. Work with Services leaders, solution architects, and specialists to diagnose needs and develop credible proposals across services, AI-based solutions, and talent. Coordinate with supporting functions to resolve obstacles and keep opportunities moving toward a decision.

Maintain a credible forecast. Challenge the evidence behind opportunity values, close dates, and expected revenue. Understand the assumptions connecting the pipeline to the financial plan, identify risks early, and take specific action to address shortfalls.

Build and develop the team. Recruit strong commercial talent, set clear expectations, and coach people through real client situations. Review calls, account plans, and active pursuits; demonstrate stronger approaches and follow through on improvements. Address underperformance promptly and develop future leaders.

Accomplish work objectives through leading and supervising other Toptal team members on the Industrial Products and Services team.

Establish objectives and initiatives for the team, recommend the team’s structure and jobs, and organize, assign, delegate, oversee, and monitor work.

Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, conduct performance reviews, and implement performance improvement plans, if needed.

In the first week, expect to:

Learn Toptal’s business model, capabilities, sales process, and client value proposition.

Meet your team and the leaders whose functions support the IPS business.

Begin reviewing the client portfolio, active opportunities, P&L, budget, and growth priorities.

In the first month, expect to:

Meet priority clients and develop an informed view of their needs, our relationships, and the opportunities ahead.

Assess the team’s capabilities and identify immediate coaching, performance, and hiring priorities.

Establish a consistent rhythm for account planning, opportunity reviews, forecasting, financial management, and coaching.

Present your proposed IPS business plan, including priority markets and accounts, revenue and profitability assumptions, investment choices, and the first actions you will take.

In the first three months, expect to:

Be executing an agreed business plan with clear objectives, resource allocations, account priorities, and ownership.

Be personally advancing major pursuits, helping close new business, and building qualified pipelines in priority accounts, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

Have specific expansion plans for key clients and be executing the talent decisions needed to strengthen the team.

In the first six months, expect to:

Demonstrate measurable commercial progress against the plan through closed new business, expansion revenue, and margin performance.

Show that coaching, account planning, and opportunity reviews are improving seller performance and commercial results.

Manage the P&L against the budget, address material variances, and refine investment priorities using evidence from sales and delivery outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

Deliver against the agreed IPS revenue, profitability, and budget objectives.

Have built a stronger team with clear accountability, consistent execution, and emerging leadership capability.

Demonstrate deeper client relationships and broader adoption of Toptal’s services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities.

Present the next stage of the industry business plan, including the investments required to sustain profitable growth.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.

5+ years of proven success leading professional services sales teams specifically in Industrial Products and Services, with in-depth experience in the Energy Sector, specifically Oil & Gas is required.

12+ years of demonstrated experience running and managing an industry business unit with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles.

Deep industry relationships ranging from director-level to C-level contacts is expected.

A sustained record of leading enterprise SaaS or services sales teams, winning new clients, and expanding existing relationships. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to those results.

Industry expertise and demonstrated sales experience in at least one of Oil & Gas, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, or Defense & Aerospace.

Demonstrated accountability for commercial results and resource decisions. You can explain how your choices on pricing, hiring, investment, and account priorities affected revenue, margin, and profitability.

Experience closing complex enterprise opportunities, including shaping a business case, coordinating technical expertise, navigating procurement, and negotiating commercial agreements.

Strong industry relationships and a record of earning access to senior decision-makers through relevant insight and demonstrated value.

Evidence of hiring strong sellers, improving individual and team performance through specific coaching, and developing future leaders.

Disciplined qualification and forecasting skills. You distinguish client interest from a credible buying process, assess the evidence behind a forecast, and act when an opportunity loses momentum.

Sufficient fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client priorities intelligently and recognize when deeper specialist expertise is needed.

Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex client problem into a compelling proposal and explain business performance without obscuring the issues.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.

Work independently with minimal supervision.

Use all required digital collaboration tools.

Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)

Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

About the Role

Our customers are the most demanding buyers in software: security teams and engineers who can smell fluff from a mile away. Keeping them successful takes a technical post-sales team, and those teams need strong leaders driving them.

You'll lead a team of Commercial Technical Account Managers who own everything after the deal closes: onboarding, adoption, customer health, and the deep technical partnership that keeps engineers happy. Your team owns making sure there's never a product reason to walk away.

You have deep experience in post-sales, a track record of coaching team members to success, and have owned retention numbers that matter. You’ve been the person others go to for guidance, and you’re looking for the right opportunity to manage a small, dynamic team.

The Socket blueprints exist: segmentation, a health score model, role charters, and playbooks are drafted. Now we’re hiring a leadership layer to strengthen our operating muscle: automation, targets, cadences, team accountability and growth.

You'll inherit a strong team and a customer base that genuinely loves the product. Your job is to turn the blueprint into a retention engine that runs without heroics.

What You'll Do

Lead, coach, and grow a team of Commercial TAMs. Hire ahead of need as we scale.

Own adoption, customer health, and gross retention outcomes across the customer base, partnering with AEs who own the commercial renewal

Influence and mature the post-sales operating system: our segmentation, health scoring, and lifecycle playbooks exist. Make them run, then make them better. QBRs should tell a real story with real data instead of a slide of vanity metrics.

Be the senior escalation point when an account is at risk. Run the deep dive, build the save plan, and see it through.

Set the bar for performance and career growth on your team, then hold it

Make the team faster per head every quarter through automation, playbooks, and one-to-many programs

Feed technical field intelligence back to Product and Engineering so customer patterns actually reach the roadmap

Report retention, adoption, and team health to leadership with numbers you'd bet on

What You'll Bring

Required:

4+ years directly managing post-sales teams (TAM, Solutions Engineering, or related). You've hired, developed, and performance-managed ICs.

6+ years total in pre or post-sales roles (TAM, Solutions, or Services) in B2B SaaS

You've owned GRR, NRR, or adoption targets and can walk us through the number, the misses, and what you changed

Background in security, developer tools, or an adjacent technical product. You know how the SDLC works and how devs and security teams actually operate.

You've been the escalation owner on at-risk commercial accounts and have the save stories to prove it

You've built, operationalized, or improved on core post-sales systems: segmentation, playbooks, health scoring, QBR frameworks.

Ready to step in as an individual contributor to support team needs, cover gaps, or lead by example when the team is at capacity.

Executive presence with CISOs and VPs of Engineering, and with our own leadership

Willingness to travel for customer and company meetings as needed

Preferred:

Domain experience in software supply chain security, AppSec, DevSecOps, or open-source ecosystems

You scaled a post-sales function at a high-growth startup through rapid ARR and headcount growth

You've managed TAM charters and kept each motion distinct but coordinated.

Hands-on with Vitally or similar CS platforms and scaled/digital-touch programs

Tools You'll Use

Slack, GitHub, Zendesk, Vitally, HubSpot, Grafana

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.

Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

Market competitive salary bands

Meaningful equity program

Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

Paid parental leave

Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites 

At Socket, we

Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

jobs.description:
Ready to make a real difference in how our people grow? 

Join our small, collaborative L&D team, where you'll have the autonomy to shape learning that makes a real difference. From the moment a stakeholder says, "We need something on this," you'll own the journey - challenging the brief, designing engaging solutions, testing what works and continuously improving the experience so people genuinely learn and grow.

Excited? Read on!

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

_____________________________________________________________________

We are Laminar Projects! 

We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it)

We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products.

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of place that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job”, we challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life: 

Connects us with meaningful relationships 

Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans 

Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

We are achieving this vision through the following two missions:  

To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation 

To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_____________________________________________________________________

The Role 

Purpose of the role

As our L&D Specialist, you'll own learning and development projects from end to end. You'll partner closely with stakeholders to understand what they actually need (not just what they first ask for), design learning experiences built around how people really learn, pilot solutions, and continuously refine them based on feedback and results.

Alongside project work, you'll help keep our learning management system (Thrive) running smoothly, supporting users, managing learning content and using data to understand what's working and where we can improve. You'll also be comfortable using AI as part of your day-to-day work, exploring how it can help us design, develop and deliver high-quality learning faster and smarter without compromising quality.

As you develop in the role, you'll have opportunities to facilitate learning sessions and contribute to a wide variety of L&D initiatives across the business. We're a small team with plenty of exciting projects, so you'll gain broad experience, take on increasing responsibility and have lots of opportunities to learn and grow.

Team

You'll report directly to the L&D Lead as part of a small, hands-on and collaborative L&D team. You'll receive plenty of support as you get up to speed, while being trusted with real ownership from the start. We value people who take initiative, are comfortable navigating ambiguity and enjoy challenging ideas to find better solutions.

Like everyone at Laminar, you'll have your own Individual Development Plan, designed to support both your personal and professional growth. Working with your manager and a wider development team, you'll set meaningful goals, build new skills and continue developing throughout your career. It's a core part of how we invest in our people, and something you'll experience yourself, not just help deliver for others.

Your top three objectives

Design and deliver impactful learning solutions that build capability and help all Lamineers to flourish

Build trusted partnerships with stakeholders to identify learning needs and create the right solutions.

Commit to continuous improvement by embracing new ways of working, growing your own capability and contributing to the development of others. 

Your top five responsibilities 

Partner and challenge: Work closely with stakeholders to explore growth opportunities. Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions and help shape the right learning solution.

Design, test and improve: Create engaging, discovery-led learning experiences. Pilot ideas before scaling, gather meaningful feedback and continuously refine solutions to maximise their impact. 

Support our learning ecosystem: Keep Thrive running smoothly by maintaining content, supporting users, monitoring learning data and reporting on what's working and where we can improve. 

Use AI with purpose: Embrace AI as part of your everyday workflow, identifying practical ways it can help us design, develop and deliver learning more efficiently, while applying critical thinking to ensure quality always comes first.

Facilitate and contribute: Facilitate learning sessions, including our Laminar Way series, and contribute to a wide range of L&D initiatives, building your facilitation skills and broadening your impact over time. 

Your Capabilities 

You'll thrive in this role if you're curious about how people learn and enjoy designing learning solutions that make a real difference. You're comfortable taking ownership, asking thoughtful questions and navigating ambiguity to find the best way forward. You enjoy variety and working across different parts of the L&D cycle. 

As a candidate, you should have: 

Must-Have (The fundamentals)

Mastery: 2-4 years' experience in L&D, training design, facilitation, coaching, people development or consultancy. Understands what makes learning effective, from uncovering the real need to designing experiences that people can apply in their work. Curious about learning technology (no experience with Thrive or Rise 360 needed) and excited by the potential of AI to design and deliver learning more effectively, with the judgement to know when it adds value. A degree in Behavioural Science, Organisational Psychology, Educational Psychology, L&D or a related field is a bonus, not a requirement.

Communication: Builds relationships easily and asks good questions to get to the real need behind a request. Communicates clearly, listens well, and adapts to the audience. Shares a point of view while staying open to feedback.

Leadership: Takes initiative rather than waiting to be asked. Comfortable working through ambiguity, makes decisions within their remit, knows when to escalate, and is keen to grow in confidence and capability over time.

Impact: An experience in taking ownership of projects and improving processes, and a genuine interest in growth. Like everyone at Laminar, you’ll have your own Individual Development Plan, and we’re looking for someone who is excited to use it to continue growing.

Nice to have (or areas you'll develop with us) 

Mastery: Experience designing learning using Rise 360 and working with a Learning Management System. Some experience facilitating learning sessions, whether through training, workshops, coaching, teaching or knowledge-sharing.

Communication: Experience working with different stakeholder groups or in a consultancy-style environment.

Leadership: An interest in developing your facilitation skills and growing into more coaching-style conversations with stakeholders over time. 

Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: 

You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge

You like to be the smartest person in the room

You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback

You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

_____________________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority

Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance

Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

The Life-Changing Stuff

In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being

Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected. 

Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists. 

Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded

Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

_____________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

Why do you want to join us?

If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders. In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

Compensation

Additional Information

Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about supporting professional growth and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages.

CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. Travel is reasonable and your work/life balance will benefit as a result. Most meaningfully - your voice will be heard. Working in a midsized CRO allows you to have influence and impact when it matters most with support from direct line management.

To support continued growth from our clients, we are hiring all levels of CRAs experienced in monitoring Oncology, Cardiology, or Lupus,

Position Summary:

The CRA II is a seasoned, experienced professional in monitoring and site management. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the CRA II is assigned and typically include activities involving start-up and study implementation, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management. Incumbents work independently as a study team member.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports.

Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.

Updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports.

If required, manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager.

If required, assists the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee.

Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.

Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre-study/ qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH-GCP and Precision SOPs. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on-site and remote).

Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.

Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.

Communicates effectively and proactively with both site personnel and Precision Project and Clinical Trial Management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues.

Develops and maintains good working relationship with investigators and study staff, serving as an ambassador to promote Precision high quality and professional image.

Performs investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.

Performs data review activities, including remote EDC CRF and patient profiles review, query resolution, and assists data management and clinical data quality personnel to resolve data discrepancies.

Identifies and processes Serious Adverse Events according to the procedures defined by the study team. Also demonstrates a full understanding of the SAE reporting process.

Identifies site risks and escalates those to Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager with suggested contingencies. Owns the timely and appropriate resolution of the risk with minimal support from project team.

Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face-to-face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.

Travels as necessary according to project needs.

Performs other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required: 

4-year college degree or equivalent experience in a scientific or healthcare discipline. 

Two (2) years or more as a CRA in a CRO or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies. Site management or equivalent experience 
in clinical research

Other Required: 

Excellent communication and organizational skills are essential. A team player.

Evidence of a client focused approach

Experience using computerized information systems, electronic spreadsheets, word processing and electronic mail.

Ability to travel overnight. Up to 60% travel on average, based on regional requirements. International travel as needed.

Fluency in English and for non-English speaking countries the local language of country where position based

Preferred: 

Graduate or postgraduate degree

Lupus monitoring experience

Experience monitoring in rare and complex therapeutic areas

Experience monitoring EDC trials and EHR records

Experience in biopharma or relevant therapeutic area

Relevant site start-up (feasibility, contract negotiations, submissions) experience for the particular country

Ability to monitor study sites, with supervision, according to protocol monitoring guidelines, SOPs, GCP and ICH guidelines.

Ability to resolve project related problems and prioritizes workload to meet deadlines with minimal support from management.

Competencies: 

Exhibits self-motivation and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment

Understands clinical trials methodology, including a working knowledge of protocols and indications being studied

Demonstrates professionalism as evidenced by punctuality, ability to deliver on commitments, an understanding of the service culture and positive interactions with customers and teammates, including good interpersonal skills

Collects data of consistently high standard

Demonstrated ability to conduct formal presentations to a wide variety of audiences including 
colleagues, investigative staff, and clients with a high level of proficiency

Fluency in English and for non-English speaking countries the local language of country where 
position based

Precision for Medicine is a precision medicine CRO. Precision’s uniquely integrated offerings enable the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for complex disease states.

Precision medicine is revolutionizing the attack on cancer. We strike tumors on a molecular level using biomarkers to link specific mutations to specific treatments. We combine deep science with deep data from advanced technological platforms, then layer on specialized expertise in the design and execution of targeted, adaptive clinical trials. We’re looking for a driven, high-performing Account Manager to join the momentum and help shape the future of farming in the West Coast region.
