Serving as the primary point-of-contact for Halter customers, you will be passionate about driving farmer success for one of the world’s fastest-growing companies that will transform how they farm to become leaders in productivity and sustainability. You will be backed by a team of exceptional people on the ground in the South Island and at Halter’s Auckland HQ, to ensure this is the best job you’ll ever have.

Location - This role is to be based anywhere in the West Coast region. Frequent travel is required as part of the position.

What your day could look like

Revenue Retention & Expansion: You will own the retention, renewals and expansion targets of Halter’s existing revenue in the region.

Ensure farmers are extracting full value from Halter to achieve their goals and ultimately understand the impact it’s having on their farming business.

Account Management: Responsible for renewing customer agreements and expanding the revenue of existing Halter customers, by adding value in every interaction to drive on-farm goals and performance.

Deployment: Supporting the onboarding, training and implementation of the Halter system on customers' farms, ensuring all relevant farm owners, managers, and workers are able to successfully use the system.

Relationship Building: Proactively cultivate genuine and trustworthy relationships with farmers, their teams, and families, fostering strong connections and understanding.

Farmer Success: Strategically partnering with customers to establish clear business goals, timelines, priorities and metrics of success.

Problem-Solving: Provide prompt and effective communication and support to farmers and team members, addressing technical or operational challenges with expertise and efficiency.

Community & Networking: Represent the Halter brand with pride, lead local discussion groups, and proactively build strong networks within the community for increased brand visibility and connections.

Customer Advocate: Acting as the voice of the customer and bridging the gap with our product teams to provide important context about what is happening on the ground with our farmers and their animals.

Technical Expertise: Working closely with our product teams to provide technical and practical advice from a farmer’s perspective on everything reproduction, pasture and agronomy.

Contribute to a positive team environment, supporting others to succeed and role modelling Halter’s Operating Principles.

We’re backing potential over polish. These are the traits that matter most

A great human first

You bring integrity, humility, and care. You do what you say you’ll do. You show up for your farmers and your teammates.

Lifelong learner mindset

You’re genuinely curious. You ask questions, seek feedback, and are excited to keep leveling up alongside a world‑class team.

Hunger and grit

You love chasing ambitious goals, solving hard problems, and sticking with it when things get tough.

Positive energy and team spirit

You lift the people around you, not drain them. You enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas, and celebrating others’ wins as much as your own.

Comfort in a fast‑moving environment

You’re at your best when things are dynamic. You can work autonomously, manage your time well, and stay focused on what matters most.

Experience that helps you hit the ground running

A background in relationship management, account management, sales, or working closely with customers.

Experience in dairy or the wider ag sector is a bonus, but not a deal breaker if you bring strong learning agility and a genuine passion for helping farmers succeed.

A foundation of business acumen and a willingness to deepen it on the job.

If you’re excited by the idea of working with an exceptional South Island team, spending time on farm with great people, and helping farmers become leaders in productivity and sustainability, we’d love to hear from you.

Who we’re looking for

3-5 years of experience in relationship management/account management roles.

Experience in dairy farming or within the agriculture sector with a deep passion for helping farmers succeed.

Strong business acumen.

Positive attitude and collaborative team player who excels at overcoming challenges.

The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.

A hunger for success and personal growth, and an eagerness to evolve alongside a world-class team.

Our Benefits

Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; you'll be a key leader shaping the growth and success of Halter in Queensland.

You'll be responsible for leading your team's sales performance end to end, from pipeline and forecasting to territory strategy, running regular one-on-ones and ride-alongs so you stay close to the deals your team is running and can coach them through real farm meetings. A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience. 

Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities. 

Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results. 

Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition. 

Experience in farming or within the agricultural sector is a highly advantageous. 

A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills. 

Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet. 

Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred

A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must. 

What your day could look like:

Setting and managing quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks for the sales team. 

Coaching, mentoring and developing our junior sales staff to help drive their professional growth to reach targets. 

Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.

Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal. 

Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment. 

Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations. 

Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand. 

Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap. 

Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales

jobs.description:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Role Summary:

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the proactive partner responsible for ensuring new and existing clients successfully achieve their strategic outcomes using Ping Identity solutions. Operating within the Global Support Organization, you will guide the customer’s journey from purchase to production, reviewing configurations and translating complex use cases into sound product architecture. By regularly engaging with customer leadership (up to the Director and VP levels) and taking full ownership of your accounts' technical trajectory, you will ensure customers are fully optimized and continuously receiving value from their Ping investments.

You will:

Provide proactive technical recommendations, architectural reviews, and best practices for Ping solutions tailored to the customer's identity and security needs.

Conduct regular environment health reviews and business reviews to highlight success against goals and ensure full value adoption.

Act as the voice of the customer, advocating for product features and internal roadmap adjustments that drive long-term operational success.

Adopt and utilize internal AI tools to generate customer reports, technical recommendations, and data-driven insights to boost daily productivity.

Take full accountability for the technical trajectory of your accounts, ensuring no ball is dropped between the customer and internal Ping teams.

Identify opportunities to improve internal reporting and automate status tracking to better visualize customer health.

Contribute to internal Knowledge Bases (KBs) and support the onboarding of new TAMs by sharing operational best practices.

Represent the TAM role with professionalism during internal summits and occasionally act as a liaison during off-hours for critical customer upgrades.

You have:

Must have enterprise customer-facing experience in a Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, or Professional Services role.

Foundational knowledge of the cybersecurity domain, including common security technologies, enterprise network architectures, and basic threat landscapes.

Familiarity with leveraging standard AI productivity tools to enhance daily workflows, streamline communication, and generate basic data-driven insights.

Understanding of Java, web technologies, and enterprise architecture.

Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build credible, transparent relationships with customer leaders.

Experience with Identity Management, Access Management, or Federation.

Ability to manage both proactive and reactive tasks effectively while demonstrating high ownership.

Experience with SFDC or equivalent CRM systems.

On-call availability may be a requirement for this position.

You have an advantage if:

Experience with Ping Identity solutions and APIs.

Experience with Windows and Linux operating systems.

General networking knowledge of protocols like HTTP/S, TCP/IP.

General knowledge of protocols such as SAML, OAuth, or OpenID Connect.

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.

Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.

Regular company and team bonding events.

Competitive benefits and perks.

Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 

Parental Leave

Progressive Healthcare Options

Retirement Programs

Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 

Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io. We're always looking for thoughtful, driven Engineering Managers to add to our org. Whichever kind of problem energizes you, if you lead people well, hold a high technical bar, and drive work to completion without waiting to be handed a plan, we want to hear from you.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies—from scrappy startups to global brands—use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data—what people do or don't do inside a web or mobile app. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What we value

Ownership. You set direction and see initiatives through. You create clarity when things are murky and set the path forward rather than waiting for one to be defined, and you're motivated by impact—not just intention. You hold yourself and your team accountable to shipping, not just staying busy.

Leaders who can do both. You operate at the strategic level and stay close to the technical work. You can align stakeholders on a plan and earn your engineers' respect in the same day—you don't choose between vision and execution, you hold both.

A drive to execute through resistance. Competing priorities, skeptical stakeholders, tired teams—you've moved work forward anyway. You name the resistance, make the call, and own the milestones and the misses.

An AI-first mindset. AI is central to how you build and how you lead your team to build. You have a real, concrete point of view on AI-native development, you use agentic tooling yourself, and you bring it into how your squad operates.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done." You bring rigor and pragmatism. Best practices matter—but never more than forward motion. You know when to build, when to buy, and when to wait—and you're comfortable making the call with incomplete information, then adjusting as you learn.

What you'll do

Care deeply about our customers and their outcomes

Lead your squad to deliver real customer value by owning projects end to end—from planning through delivery, quality, and follow-through

Drive execution: set milestones, keep work moving through ambiguity and competing priorities, and ship in small, observable increments rather than waiting for a release window

Make confident decisions when the path isn't obvious, and lead your team through them

Set the operating rhythm that helps your team move fastest, rather than defaulting to ceremony for its own sake

Ensure your squad's solutions are scalable, architecturally sound, flexible, and secure, with strong peer-review, QA, documentation, deployment, logging, and monitoring practices

Stay close to the work—jump into design reviews, architecture calls, and incidents rather than watching from a distance

Provide direct, timely, and specific coaching, and create meaningful development opportunities for your direct reports

Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the reliability of the systems you build

Hire, onboard, and manage performance so the right people are in place to hit your squad's goals

Bring an AI-native perspective—use AI tools to accelerate the team's velocity and help everyone prototype faster and ship smarter

Partner across engineering and other departments to align efforts with customer success, and reach higher when our customers are having a bad day

What we're looking for

3+ years managing engineers at a SaaS company (B2B or B2C), ideally early-to-mid-stage

A track record of driving execution—concrete delivery outcomes with milestones, dates, and "I drove" ownership, especially in complex or fast-moving environments

A strong technical background—you can hold your own in architecture conversations and design reviews, represent your squad's technical choices across the company, and you've shipped real work recently enough to stay credible

Comfort operating with high autonomy and little prescribed structure—you create your own clarity and make difficult tradeoffs between competing priorities

Demonstrated AI-native leadership—not just personal fluency, but bringing AI-first practices into how your team builds

Experience building high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative teams

Clear, concise, and direct communication, both verbal and written

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $185,000-$215,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. See full benefits here →

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

As a Regional Sales Lead at Halter, you will lead a team of Territory Managers on the front lines of transforming livestock management across the U.S. This is a deeply hands-on role: you’ll spend most of your time in the field coaching reps, joining customer conversations, and removing barriers to their success.

You’ll shape regional performance, uphold rigorous pipeline and Salesforce standards, and ensure your team executes with consistency and excellence. We’re looking for a leader who brings energy, high standards, and a strong sense of culture. Someone who cares about people, thrives in fast growth, and can operate equally well in strategy discussions and day-to-day execution.

This role can be based anywhere in North Dakota. Frequent travel is required as apart of this position.

What you’ll do

Lead, coach & develop Territory Managers through frequent in-field work (~60% travel), ongoing feedback, role-plays, and hands-on sales training to ensure strong execution and skill development.

Own regional revenue performance by driving consistent activity, supporting both new sales and account expansion, and ensuring TMs meet input and output targets.

Maintain world-class Salesforce hygiene & forecasting, reviewing pipelines weekly, ensuring accurate data, and acting as deal support on structure, escalations, and critical opportunities.

Serve as the regional voice - surfacing customer insights, product feedback, and operational issues to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer teams, and broader leadership.

Localize national strategy into regional execution plans, run lightweight team rhythms (1:1s, check-ins), and align closely with U.S. commercial leadership on performance and priorities.

Recruit and develop high-performing talent, helping scale Territory Manager teams as Halter grows rapidly across the U.S.

What you’ll bring

Strong Frontline Sales Leadership: Experience leading and developing field sales reps, ideally in high-growth or high-velocity environments, with a track record of coaching reps to consistently improve performance.

Hands-On, Field-First Mindset: Comfortable spending the majority of your time on the road - joining customer visits, modeling best practices, and staying deeply connected to real-world customer challenges.

Expertise in Sales Process & Methodology: Proficiency in modern sales practices (e.g., consultative/challenger sales models, role-plays, discovery techniques) and the ability to coach Territory Managers to master them.

Pipeline, Salesforce, & Forecasting Discipline: Strong operational rigor with CRM hygiene, pipeline management, input metrics, and forecasting accuracy - especially important in a hardware + software environment.

Direct, Supportive People Leadership: A leadership style built on clarity, accountability, empathy, and high support - someone who cares deeply, sets high expectations, and builds strong team culture.

Comfort With Ambiguity & Fast Growth: Thrives in dynamic, evolving environments; adaptable, resourceful, and motivated by building systems, processes, and habits in a rapidly scaling U.S. business.

Our Benefits

Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual USD$750 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

Health Benefits - We offer best-in-class insurance for our employees, so they can care for themselves and their families.

16 weeks of paid parental leave for primary and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers plus many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

We're proud to offer 401k and make an employer match. We offer a 100% match on the first 3% you contribute, and a 50% match on the next 2%.

Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

About Quora:

Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms:

Quora: a global knowledge sharing platform with millions of monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others.

Poe: a cloud workspace where millions of users run multiple AI agents on shared context and tools. One subscription, every frontier model, and the collaboration layer that makes them work together.

Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world.

This role will be working on our Quora product.

About the Team and Role:

At Quora, machine learning drives nearly every aspect of our product, and our lean, high-velocity engineering team tackles complex, high-impact challenges daily. We thrive in a remote-first culture built on absolute autonomy, continuous learning, and bold experimentation.

We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to define the technical future of Quora’s recommendation ecosystem. In this role, you will own the technical direction for feed ranking and retrieval, lead our highest-impact modeling bets, and pioneer the integration of LLMs and generative models to redefine how we understand and rank content. Beyond the home feed, you will also scale recommendation surfaces like notifications and digest emails, while architecting the underlying tools and abstractions that empower our entire engineering organization.

This is a high-leverage, hands-on IC role with organization-wide scope. You will write production code, mentor rising talent, and actively shape how our team leverages AI-assisted development to accelerate our shipping velocity.

Responsibilities:

Set the technical direction for Quora’s home feed recommendation systems

Lead the highest-impact projects across the recommender stack, from candidate generation and retrieval to ranking, re-ranking, and multi-objective optimization

Drive measurable improvements in user engagement and content quality through well-designed online experiments

Take end-to-end ownership of ML systems, including data pipelines, candidate extraction, feature engineering, model training, and production integration

Identify new opportunities to apply machine learning to different parts of the Quora product

Partner with product, data science, and infrastructure teams to align on priorities and tradeoffs

Mentor engineers and lead by example, raising the bar for code quality, modeling rigor and AI assisted dev velocity

Minimum Requirements:

Availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's “coordination hours" (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time)

6+ years of professional software development experience in machine learning

4+ years of professional experience building and optimizing Home Feed recommendation systems for social media and user-generated content platforms.

Deep knowledge of the full recommender stack: candidate generation, retrieval, ranking, re-ranking, embeddings, and multi-objective optimization.

Deep understanding of mathematical foundations of machine learning algorithms

Experience leading large-scale ML projects end-to-end with measurable outcome

Strong communication and interpersonal skills

BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science

Preferred Requirements:

6+ years of experience writing Python or C++ code

Hands-on experience deploying and running generative models at scale

Background in notifications, email/digest recommendations, or growth and lifecycle modeling

Flexible and positive team player

Publications at venues like RecSys, KDD, NeurIPS, or ICML.

Passion for Quora's mission and goals

At Quora, we value diversity and inclusivity and welcome individuals from all backgrounds, including marginalized or underrepresented groups in tech, to apply for our job openings. We encourage all candidates who share a passion for growing the world’s knowledge, even those who may not strictly meet all the preferred requirements, to apply, as we know that a diverse range of perspectives can have a significant impact on our products and our culture.

About Our Company:

Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients.

About the Position

We are seeking an experienced and proactive HR Business Partner to support employees, managers, and business leaders across multiple locations throughout the United States and Canada.

This role combines hands-on HR support with business partnership, manager enablement, performance management, leadership development, leave administration, and organizational effectiveness. The ideal candidate possesses strong HR expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to build effective relationships while providing practical guidance and supporting organizational objectives.

What You Do Daily

Manager Enablement & Leadership Development

Assist in the development and deliver manager training in collaboration with HR leadership to strengthen managerial skills and competencies.

Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness and support managers in the consistent application of HR policies and procedures.

Leave Management & Employee Accommodations

Manage and administer employee leaves of absence across the US and Canada, including FMLA, state and provincial leave programs, disability-related absences, and other applicable leaves.

Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers regarding leave eligibility, documentation requirements, leave status, and return-to-work processes.

Coordinate workplace accommodation and return-to-work arrangements in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

Maintain accurate leave records and employee status information in Dayforce, monitor leave timelines, and coordinate with Payroll and Total Rewards as needed.

Talent Management & Organizational Development

Partner with leadership to identify talent development needs, high-potential employees, and opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness.

Support talent reviews, succession planning, employee development, and retention initiatives in collaboration with HR leadership.

Evaluate employee exit feedback and turnover trends to identify retention risks and recommend improvements to the employee experience.

HR Projects, Analytics & Compliance

Support HR initiatives, including employee engagement surveys, policy development, organizational design, and process improvements.

Analyze workforce metrics, including turnover, retention, engagement, and performance trends, to identify opportunities and recommend improvements.

Support the development, implementation, and consistent application of HR policies and programs across the US and Canada.

Coordinate federal, state, provincial, and other applicable regulatory reporting requirements, collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely submissions.

Monitor employment law and regulatory changes, provide compliance-related guidance to managers, and identify potential impacts on HR policies and practices.

Employee Relations

Assist with employee relations activities and recommend appropriate resolutions, escalating complex or sensitive matters as needed.

Promote a positive workplace culture through consistent application of HR policies, effective communication, and employee engagement.

Performance Management

Coordinate and administer performance management processes, ensuring consistent implementation across the organization.

Analyze performance trends and partner with leadership to address challenges, promote accountability, and support employee development.

What Makes You a Good Fit

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Minimum of 7+ years of progressive HR experience, with a strong background in manager development, performance management, and business partnering.

Demonstrated ability to advise and influence managers and business leaders while handling sensitive employee matters with discretion and sound judgment.

Experience supporting talent management, organizational development, and employee engagement initiatives.

Strong understanding of employment laws and HR practices in the United States and Canada.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to interpret workforce data and recommend actionable solutions.

Ability to manage competing priorities and balance day-to-day HR responsibilities with longer-term initiatives.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Dayforce or a comparable HRIS preferred.

SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR, or applicable Canadian HR designation preferred.

Conversational or fluent French language skills preferred; experience supporting geographically dispersed or multi-site operations is an asset.

jobs.description:
CoderPad's mission is to create a more inclusive and strong tech community. 

How? By improving the technical interviewing experience with tools that allow for standardization and consistency, while reducing bias and increasing equality of opportunity.

As CoderPad's first customer marketer, you'll own the customer marketing plan and execute it hands-on. Your job is to turn our installed base into a predictable source of expansion pipeline and a deep bench of customer advocates.

You'll work across our whole book of mid-market and enterprise sized customers, from self-serve customers ready to move up to Enterprise Plans to large accounts with room to grow, using scaled, one-to-many programs and opportunity to build 1:few programs as we scale. You'll partner with Expansion Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Campaigns and Demand Gen. This is a builder-and-doer role: you'll set the strategy and then build, launch, and measure your programs with the support of the team.

This role is required to work East Coast Hours. 

You'll report to the VP of Marketing. 

What you'll be doing:

Drive expansion pipeline

Own the self-serve-to-Enterprise upgrade marketing motion. Take our current pilot and scale what works into an always-on program while continuing to optimize.

Build one-to-many expansion programs for Enterprise customers in partnership with Expansion Sales, including cross-sell and upsell plays, targeted nurtures, and sales-ready offers.

Partner with Campaigns to adapt our major campaigns and launches for customer audiences, so existing customers hear the right story at the right moment.

Give Expansion Sales the timing, messaging, and assets to act on signals from your programs.

Localize expansion and lifecycle programs for EMEA customers, adapting messaging, timing, channels, and events to the region (about 15% of your effort).

Fuel adoption with Customer Success and Product Marketing

Build lifecycle programs that support CS in getting customers to value: onboarding and feature-adoption email, customer webinars, and launch communications.

Work with Product Marketing to turn new features into customer-facing campaigns that drive usage.

Design lifecycle journeys and build them in our marketing automation platform, working with Marketing Ops on complex builds and attribution.

Build the customer data foundation with Marketing Ops and CS: the segments and scores that decide who gets which program, and when.

Build our advocacy engine

Create and run our customer advocacy program that provides speakers for events, case studies, customer references and referrals. 

Produce customer case studies and stories. 

Drive a review program on G2 and similar sites to strengthen our position against competitors.

Run customer events and our Customer Advisory Board

Launch and run a Customer Advisory Board that brings customer insight into product, messaging, and strategy.

Plan customer-focused events and user groups.

How we'll measure success

Expansion pipeline (primary): pipeline sourced and influenced by your programs, tracked separately for self-serve upgrades and Enterprise expansion.

Adoption impact (shared with CS and product marketing): engagement with adoption programs and the feature activation that follows them.

Advocacy: case studies published, customer availability for speaking and thought leadership activites, and review volume and ratings against plan.

In your first 90 days, you'll take over the upgrade pilot, define the customer marketing plan for 2027, and partner with sales on driving quick expansion pipeline.

What you should bring:

6+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 3 years in customer, lifecycle, or expansion marketing.

A track record of owning an expansion pipeline or revenue number, not just engagement metrics.

Experience creating a customer marketing plan and executing it end to end, doing the hands-on work yourself.

Experience partnering with Ops and CS to build customer segments and scores. You understand how product usage, CRM, and CS data combine to target the right accounts at the right moment.

Experience running advocacy programs: case studies, references, reviews, or advisory boards.

Credibility with sales and CS leaders, and the ability to turn their input into programs that ship.

Comfort with data. You can define the metrics, work with Ops on attribution, and explain what's working.

Strong writing and a feel for what resonates with customers.

Compensation

Compensation for this role includes: base salary 

Base salary range (in USD): $150,000- $180,000 

Exact salary is based on skills, experience, location, market ranges, and other compensation offered. The salary range does not include equity and company-wide benefits you may be eligible to receive.

Additional Information

Company Overview 

CoderPad is on a mission to fix the technical interview process. We serve over 3,800 customers and have hosted more than 4 million technical interviews in 90+ programming languages since our launch in 2013. 

Through its simplicity, speed and accuracy, CoderPad has become a leading interview platform for hiring teams that need a reliable solution to better evaluate technical candidates – and more fairly! It works like an IDE to emulate real-world scenarios and is easily personalized to specific team needs, ensuring a positive experience for both candidate and interviewer alike. And more…

jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive on Toptal’s Consumer Products & Services (CP&S) team, your mission is to win new enterprise clients and secure new business bookings. You will build your own pipeline, open doors into organizations where Toptal does not currently do business, develop opportunities, and close new commercial deals. This is a pure hunter role for accomplished sales professionals who thrive on creating opportunities, competing for business, and turning new relationships into meaningful revenue.

You will lead the end-to-end new-client acquisition process, from identifying target accounts and engaging decision-makers to shaping solutions, negotiating commercial terms, and securing the first revenue booking. Working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders, you will develop compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business. You will partner with Client Partners to ensure a seamless transition following the initial booking, allowing you to remain focused on what you do best: opening new doors and winning new clients.

We are looking for exceptional business developers who combine deep Consumer Products & Services industry expertise, executive credibility, and consultative selling skills with the urgency, persistence, and competitive drive of a true hunter. You understand the business and technology challenges facing consumer products, retail, and services organizations, and know how to translate those challenges into compelling commercial opportunities. You leverage your industry knowledge and relationships to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engage senior decision-makers, and create demand where none exists. You take ownership of your results, thrive on winning new clients, and do not wait for opportunities to come to you.

Consumer products and retail organizations are under pressure to move faster than their current operating models allow. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rethinking how work gets done across brand and marketing, commercial operations, supply chain, and digital commerce. Toptal’s CP&S team already partners with some of the world’s largest consumer products organizations to help address these challenges. You will bring together our capabilities across technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent to help new clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.

Success in this role is measured by new enterprise logos acquired and new business booked. This is a high-accountability, high-reward opportunity for individuals who want direct ownership of their commercial results and the opportunity to build a substantial business through their own efforts.

This is a remote position with a strong expectation of regular, in-person client engagement and field activity. Candidates based on the US East Coast, or within commutable distance of a major East Coast metropolitan area, are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building and converting a pipeline of net-new enterprise clients across Consumer Products & Services. You will identify high-potential organizations, develop access to decision-makers, uncover business challenges, and create opportunities for Toptal to compete and win. You will lead the sales process from initial engagement through securing the first revenue booking, working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to shape compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business.

Your focus is exclusively on acquiring new clients. You will not inherit an existing book of business or carry ongoing account management and expansion responsibilities. Following the initial revenue booking, new clients transition to Client Partners and the appropriate delivery teams.

Hunt and win new enterprise clients. Own new-logo acquisition and secured bookings across consumer products, retail, and services organizations, with direct accountability for identifying, developing, and closing new business.

Build your own pipeline. Proactively identify target accounts, develop prospecting strategies, leverage your CP&S industry network, and create new opportunities through consistent, disciplined outreach. Partner with SDRs to accelerate prospecting without depending on them to generate your pipeline.

Open doors at the executive level. Establish relationships with senior business and technology leaders, economic buyers, and key decision-makers within organizations where Toptal does not have an established commercial relationship.

Create demand and shape opportunities. Engage prospective clients around their strategic priorities, identify business problems worth solving, and position Toptal’s capabilities in ways that create compelling reasons to act. Bring informed perspectives on the commercial, operational, and technology challenges shaping the consumer products and retail industries.

Lead and close complex sales pursuits. Own the full sales cycle, including qualification, discovery, stakeholder alignment, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, procurement, contracting, and securing the initial revenue booking.

Compete and win. Develop winning strategies to displace incumbent providers, differentiate Toptal from traditional consulting and technology services firms, and navigate competitive enterprise buying processes.

Sell the full breadth of Toptal’s capabilities. Work with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to bring together specialized talent, technology, AI, marketing, consulting, and managed services solutions addressing client challenges across digital commerce, supply chain, customer experience, commercial operations, and business transformation.

Maintain a high-quality, self-generated pipeline. Build sufficient qualified pipeline to consistently deliver new-logo and bookings targets. Maintain accurate opportunity intelligence, forecasting, and disciplined sales execution.

Take ownership of commercial outcomes. Drive opportunities forward with urgency, navigate obstacles, negotiate effectively, and remain personally accountable for securing booked revenue.

Execute clean client transitions. Ensure commercial commitments, initial booking details, and relevant client context are transferred to Client Partners and delivery teams, allowing you to return your focus to new-client acquisition.

Build a strong market presence. Spend meaningful time in front of prospective clients, developing relationships through executive networking, CP&S industry events, referrals, and direct engagement.

We are seeking people who enjoy the hunt as much as the win. You should be energized by breaking into new accounts, creating opportunities from scratch, and securing business that would not exist without your efforts.

In the first week, expect to:

Onboard with Toptal, learning our business model, value proposition, and capabilities.

Familiarize yourself with our sales methodologies, prospecting tools, and commercial processes.

Understand our CP&S industry strategy, target client profiles, priority segments, and markets.

Meet the Industry, Sales Development, and internal subject matter experts and stakeholders who will support your success.

Become familiar with our contracting, legal, and commercial processes.

In the first month, expect to:

Develop a targeted new-logo acquisition plan with your CP&S Industry GM, identifying priority accounts, executive buyers, and initial pursuit strategies.

Begin actively prospecting into new consumer products, retail, and services accounts, leveraging your existing industry relationships while building new ones.

Establish a consistent cadence of outbound activity, executive outreach, and new-business development.

Coordinate with SDRs to expand target-account coverage and accelerate opportunity creation.

Begin discovery conversations with prospective clients and build your initial qualified pipeline.

Develop a strong understanding of how to position Toptal’s technology, AI, marketing, consulting, managed services, and talent capabilities against the priorities and challenges facing CP&S organizations.

In the first three months, expect to:

Establish a measurable pipeline of qualified net-new CP&S enterprise opportunities, including a meaningful contribution from your own prospecting and relationship development.

Build relationships with economic buyers and senior decision-makers across priority target accounts.

Lead active sales pursuits, working with internal subject matter experts to develop differentiated solutions and competitive proposals tailored to consumer products, retail, and services organizations.

Demonstrate the ability to qualify, advance, and close opportunities through complex enterprise buying processes.

Secure initial new-logo wins and revenue bookings, building momentum toward your commercial targets.

Maintain an accurate, well-managed pipeline with clear next steps, close strategies, and forecasts.

In the first six months, expect to:

Establish a track record of acquiring new enterprise CP&S clients and securing initial revenue bookings.

Build and sustain a healthy pipeline of new-logo opportunities sufficient to support continued bookings performance.

Demonstrate consistent self-sourced opportunity creation alongside effective use of SDR and cross-functional support.

Successfully navigate competitive pursuits, executive negotiations, procurement, and contracting to close business.

Demonstrate the ability to move from one successful acquisition to the next, maintaining momentum without becoming involved in ongoing account management.

Show measurable progress against defined new-logo and bookings targets.

In the first year, expect to:

Consistently deliver against new-logo acquisition and bookings expectations.

Establish a repeatable, high-performing approach to originating and closing new enterprise business across Consumer Products & Services.

Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified new-logo opportunities through direct prospecting, executive relationships, industry referrals, and coordinated business development.

Build a reputation as a highly effective hunter and closer who can create opportunities, navigate complex enterprise buying environments, and win competitive deals.

Develop a network of executive relationships and market connections across CP&S that supports continued new-client acquisition.

Be recognized for your industry knowledge, commercial judgment, competitive drive, personal accountability, and ability to deliver measurable new-business results.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree is required.

7–10+ years of demonstrated success in enterprise new-business development and sales, ideally within consulting, technology services, professional services, or managed services.

Extensive experience selling into Consumer Products & Services organizations particularly within Retail, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Food, and Grocery segments, with a demonstrated understanding of industry dynamics, business priorities, and enterprise buying environments.

A proven track record as a true new-business hunter. You have personally originated, developed, and closed enterprise clients rather than relying on inherited accounts, established relationships, or account * expansion to deliver your results.

Consistent achievement or overachievement of new-logo and new-business bookings targets, with the ability to demonstrate your individual contribution to pipeline creation and closed business.

Demonstrated ability to build a territory and qualified pipeline from scratch, including direct prospecting, executive networking, account penetration, and competitive displacement.

Experience originating and closing complex, high-value enterprise engagements, ideally with organizations generating $2B+ in annual revenue.

Proven success selling consultative, service-oriented solutions involving technology, consulting, managed services, or other complex professional services offerings.

Strong understanding of the challenges facing consumer products and retail organizations including digital commerce, brand and marketing transformation, supply chain modernization, operational efficiency, customer experience, and AI-enabled business transformation.

Ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives and senior business and technology leaders within CP&S organizations, develop executive sponsorship, and navigate complex stakeholder environments.

Strong business acumen and the ability to uncover client challenges, shape commercial opportunities, and translate business priorities into compelling solutions.

Demonstrated success leading full-cycle enterprise sales pursuits, including opportunity qualification, solution development, competitive positioning, pricing, negotiation, procurement, and contracting.

Experience navigating complex enterprise procurement, legal, and commercial processes within large consumer products, retail, or services organizations.

Strong understanding of emerging technologies, including AI, and the ability to discuss their practical application to enterprise business challenges within Consumer Products & Services.

Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to shape and win complex engagements while retaining personal ownership of the sales outcome.

Strong commercial discipline, including pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, opportunity prioritization, and consistent execution.

Resilience, persistence, competitive drive, and the ability to create momentum in environments where opportunities must be earned rather than provided.

An entrepreneurial mindset, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.

Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.

Work independently with minimal supervision.

Use all required digital collaboration tools.

Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.

What your day could look like

Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.

You’ll be great if you exhibit

Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

Bonus things you could bring along to the role

Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.

Our Benefits

Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual USD$750 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

Health Benefits - We offer best-in-class insurance for our employees, so they can care for themselves and their families.

16 weeks of paid parental leave for primary and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers plus many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

We're proud to offer 401k and make an employer match. We offer a 100% match on the first 3% you contribute, and a 50% match on the next 2%.

Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for an experienced Senior Telecom Engineer to join our cloud operations organization on a full-time basis. The ideal candidate is someone who has worked in a 24/7 production support environment and has a strong working knowledge of VoIP, SIP, and RTP. 
This position is based anywhere in the UK.

Key Responsibilities

Interface directly with customer’s telecom engineers and IT teams to deploy customized solutions and trouble shoot issues;

Assist int the day-to-day operational support of the Telecommunications network, analyzing problems affecting network availability and customer quality reports;

Escalation point of contact for the Network Operations Center to resolve critical alerts generated by the SBC’s Analyze history of telecommunication related incidents and perform preventive measures;

Assist in the day-to-day operation of the telecommunications network, where necessary analyzing problems affecting network availability and customer/vendor service quality;

Provide root-cause analyses on service outages;

Respond to Telecom alerts and alarms and provide corrective actions in coordination with the Network Operations Center;

Create technical documentation and call flow drawings as needed Manage Telecommunications Service Provider & Vendors Implement hardware and software deployments on the telephony network as required;

Deploy new services including interop testing with telecom carriers and customers;

Provide emergency assistance and technical recovery in the event of an emergency situation affecting the availability and/or service quality of the network;

Participate in on-call emergency rotation.

Requirements

3-5 years of telecom engineer experience with VoIP/SIP voice applications.

Must have a detailed, working and theoretical knowledge of voice and data communications, including traditional switching, signaling and routing systems to include SIP, TCP/IP, MPLS etc.

Experience with ribbon SBCs and PSX.

Working knowledge of VoIP principles, protocols and CODECs such as H.248, SIP, G.711, G.729, WebRTC, MPLS, VPN, UDP, RTP, MTP etc.

Knowledge of SIP call routing, Least Cost Routing, Security Controls (TLS, IPSEC, ACLs) with Session Border Controllers.

Knowledge of telecom principals and terminology including DIDs, Toll Free numbers, LATA OCN and NPA-NXX etc.

Experience with International Routing including ITFS, iDID’s and local termination policies Ability to build, interop and maintain direct connect SIP Trunks to customers and carriers.

Review, Assess, Critique and Implement Telecom Architecture design changes in Lab and Production environments.

Excellent organizational and follow-through skill sets are essential.

Ability to document, troubleshoot and resolve a multifaceted and complex Global voice network.

Maintain the telephony environment to assure delivery of Cloud applications, voice and customer connectivity and availability to target 99.99% SLA.

Experience with Softswitch, Session Border Controllers (preferably Sonus/Ribbon, Audio Codes), SIP proxies, Media Servers (preferably AudioCodes IPM-6310 and FreeSWITCH).

In depth knowledge of Wireshark, Empirix or other network protocol analyzers Ability to capture and analyze RTP streams as related to voice quality traditional KPI’s such as MOS, Jitter, Latency, Packets Loss.

Ability to execute and use intermediate level Linux/Unix system administrator commands.

Excellent working knowledge of telecommunications, maintenance processes and systems.

Proven ability to resolve complex issues in an efficient and timely manner and provide clients with consultative explanations and advice.

Self-starter with excellent troubleshooting skills and ability to prioritize tasks and organize workflow accordingly.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required Excellent documentation skills are required.
