You will be managing a portfolio of large corporate beef operations and stations, from phase one rollout through to full-scale integration with Halter technology. You will be driving the success and growth of Halter within these accounts.

You’ll be an expert at building trusting relationships, identifying opportunities within a farming system to add value, and enjoy driving the growth of the largest agricultural businesses in New Zealand. You’ll thrive in high-pressure environments, using initiative to make results happen, often against the odds. You might find yourself in a boardroom assisting the negotiating of a million-dollar contract one day, reporting key KPI’s to a GM the next day, communicating opportunities and driving change with Farm and Station Managers by Friday. You’ll masterfully navigate layers within these businesses, adjusting your communication at each level accordingly, to convey the right context and value to all parties. You’ll likely have deep extensive farming systems knowledge and have a natural ability to drive change at a farm and leadership level.

This isn’t a typical role. This is a high-stakes role, playing a critical role in Halter’s growth into the enterprise segment in New Zealand.

Aside from jumping on the Halter roller coaster, you will be making a real-world impact, helping large scale beef businesses transform how they operate to become more efficient and productive. You will build relationships across some of the most influential beef businesses in New Zealand while working closely with Halter senior leadership. Up for the challenge? Let’s talk.

This role covers customers across New Zealand. Frequent travel is required as part of this position.

WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE.

Enterprise Customer Success: You’ll be embedded in the success of some of Halter’s largest and most strategic customers, ensuring our enterprise beef businesses realise full value from their investment. You’ll understand their goals and farm system deeply, help them embed Halter into daily operations, and surface impact across the business. Your efforts will directly influence execution, retention, expansion, and long-term growth.

Strategic Account Management: You’ll build trusted, long-term relationships with farm and station teams, operational teams and executive stakeholders alike. You’ll know when to guide, when to challenge, and when to step in to unlock new value. This isn’t just about managing relationships; it’s about owning customer outcomes.

Executive Engagement: In collaboration with the Enterprise Sales Manager you will work directly with senior leaders and multi-entity decision-makers. You’ll understand the organisational structure, surface strategic pain points, and partner with the Enterprise Sales Manager to tailor solutions that move the needle. With the Enterprise Sales Manager, you’ll also play a key role in supporting expansion and renewal conversations.

Influencer & Network Management: You won’t stop with your customer. You’ll build relationships with rural professionals, consultants, and other industry influencers who shape opinion, success on farm and purchasing behaviour across your portfolio. You’ll be known and respected in the region as a trusted Halter advisor.

Enterprise Growth Strategy: You’ll collaborate with the NZ Enterprise Sales Manager to co-create account plans, drive territory expansion, and identify new revenue streams within your customer base. You’ll know your portfolio inside-out and play a key role in shaping how we grow our enterprise presence in-market.

Cross-functional Leadership: You’ll work closely with Halter’s product, support, and sales teams to champion your accounts internally. Whether it’s surfacing product feedback, coordinating training, or aligning on rollout strategy, you’ll be the glue that holds enterprise relationships together and drives results.

Forecasting & Planning: Alongside the Enterprise Sales Manager, you’ll contribute to accurate revenue forecasting and strategic planning. You’ll bring rigour to account performance tracking and identify early signals of both risk and growth.

Scalable Growth Initiatives: You’ll help evolve how we support and grow our largest customers. From refining account management strategies to building scalable playbooks, you’ll be part of the team shaping what great looks like as Halter scales globally.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR.

Enterprise experience: You’ve managed large, complex accounts and know how to drive growth over time. You’re comfortable navigating executive rooms, operational teams, farm and station teams, multiple stakeholders, and matrixed business structures.

Customer centric: You’re relentlessly farmer-first. You anticipate needs, address problems early, and are accountable for continuously improving customer satisfaction.

Industry fluency: You bring real experience in beef production systems and know what success looks like on high performing beef farms and stations. You’re credible, informed, and customer-first.

Strong commercial instincts: You don’t just nurture relationships; you find value, expand accounts, and deliver results.

Team-first mindset: You collaborate across roles and functions to get the best outcome for the customer and the company.

Autonomy & pace: You’re happy working independently in a fast-changing environment. You solve problems proactively and adjust quickly.

Growth hunger: You’re looking to stretch yourself, take on more, and grow your career alongside a world-class commercial team.

Travel-ready: You’ll regularly be out with customers, in the room, the paddock, or the boardroom when it counts. Expected travel up to 50% of the time.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role:

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative.

This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction in this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers.

Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

Location - This role is to be based in the Mount Gambier region

Sales & Customer Success Expertise: Value-based sales experience, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

jobs.description:
D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift. 

New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.

D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.

D2L has had a singular mission for over 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.

D2L has a hybrid working model based on proximity to our working spaces. We hire both remotely, and hybrid out of our office locations.

While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.

As the Talent Acquisition Partner focused on Technical and Product Recruitment, you will help build teams that create and improve D2L products. Reporting to the TA Operations Lead, you will own and prioritize full-cycle searches and advise hiring managers on how to attract and assess experienced technical and product talent. 

You understand the requirements behind technical and product roles and can help teams build clear, job-related interview processes. You will bring market insight, thoughtful sourcing and strong candidate advocacy to every search. Our approach is high-tech and high touch: we pair effective recruiting practices with a responsive and inclusive candidate experience. 

How Will I Make an Impact?: 

Lead full-cycle recruitment for assigned technical and product roles, from intake and search strategy through offer, close and transition to onboarding. Occasional recruitment for other functions as needed. 

Partner with hiring managers to clarify business needs, role outcomes, level, essential qualifications and decision criteria; shape clear job descriptions and realistic hiring plans. 

Recruit for experienced and senior roles across software engineering, architecture, product management, data, design, security, infrastructure and other business units depending on capacity and needs. 

Develop targeted sourcing strategies and talent pipelines using research, networks, referrals, social platforms and other appropriate channels, including outreach to passive candidates. 

Build a working understanding of each role’s scope, technical context, level and core competencies so you can ask useful intake questions and advise on candidate profiles. 

Help design interview plans with hiring teams: clarify what each stage should assess, who should participate and how interviewers will capture job-related evidence. 

Prepare interviewers to use consistent questions and assessment criteria; support calibration and debriefs so teams can make timely, evidence-based decisions. 

Keep candidates informed, set expectations, gather feedback and provide a responsive, respectful and inclusive experience throughout the process. 

Advise on market conditions, talent availability, compensation considerations and search trade-offs; surface risks early and recommend practical options. 

Maintain accurate requisition and candidate records in the ATS and related People systems. Use recruiting data to monitor pipeline health, service levels, bottlenecks and outcomes. 

Partner with the TA Operations Lead and People & Culture colleagues to improve recruiting practices, share expertise and contribute to TA programs processes and strategy. 

What you’ll bring to the role 

5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in a fast-paced, complex environment, including searches for experienced or senior technical and/or product talent. 

Experience partnering with technical or product leaders to define role requirements, calibrate profiles and build effective interview processes. 

Strong consultative partnership skills, with the ability to influence, coach and communicate clearly with candidates, hiring managers and senior stakeholders. 

Confidence with sourcing tools, an ATS and recruiting data; sound judgment, organization and follow-through across competing priorities. 

A collaborative, accountable approach and commitment to inclusive hiring and a high-quality candidate experience. 

Education or equivalent experience in Human Resources, Business or a related field is an asset. 

How success is measured 

Hiring managers and candidates receive clear, timely communication and consistent, high-quality recruitment experience. 

Evaluates progress against agreed priorities and service expectations, with risks surfaced early and decisions supported by relevant evidence. 

Interviews and follow-up are coordinated effectively across regions and time zones. 

Talent pipelines are appropriately targeted; ATS records and reporting are accurate and useful.

Location Requirements:

Kitchener, Toronto, or Remote in Ontario; our Kitchener and Toronto offices have hybrid in-office expectations.

This posting is for an existing vacancy

The annualized base salary offered is determined by each candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, education, training and experience. It is aligned to ensure both internal and external competitiveness using market data for the geographic location and industry. As part of the total compensation at D2L the role may be eligible for additional benefits including a Wellness Subsidy, Equity Grants, Variable Incentive, and more.

Base Salary Range

$80,000—$95,000 CAD

Don’t meet every single requirement? We strongly encourage you to still apply! At D2L, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage your application even if you don't believe you meet every single qualification outlined, because we love to help our people grow and develop!

jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The AI Engineering Team is chartered with enabling next-generation AI applications, with a special focus on Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic systems. Our mission is to build robust pipelines, high-performance infrastructure, and operational tooling that allow AI systems to be deployed with speed, safety, and scale.

We manage petabyte-scale pipelines, serve models with millisecond-level latency, and provide the observability and governance needed to make AI production-ready. We’re also deeply involved in evaluating and integrating cutting-edge tools in the LLM and agent space — including open-source stacks, vector databases, evaluation frameworks, and orchestration tools that unlock TRM’s ability to innovate faster than the market.

The impact you will have:

Architect and implement a robust agentic framework that supports tool use, context retrieval, memory, and planning

Build intelligent, modular agents that automate investigative tasks and augment analyst decision-making

Extend and scale our LLM infrastructure (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, local models), including prompt engineering, RAG, and evaluation loops

Design safe, observable, and auditable agent behaviors — ensuring reliability in high-sensitivity environments

Evaluate performance across metrics like reasoning, latency, success rate, and hallucination, and iterate based on user feedback and system telemetry

Contribute to a culture of high ownership, rapid experimentation, and ethical AI deployment

What we’re looking for:

Strong engineering background with deep experience in backend or systems work (Python preferred)

Hands-on experience building with LLMs, agents, and tooling frameworks (LangChain, semantic caches, vector DBs, etc.)

Comfort working with agentic pipelines and optimizing information flow into AI systems

Thoughtful approach to system design, with an eye for safety, scalability, and explainability

High product empathy - you care about how agents impact real users (analysts) and optimize accordingly

Bias toward experimentation and iteration - you’re excited to try, learn, and ship fast

Previous experience with knowledge graphs, task orchestration, or AI safety a plus

About the Team:

The AI Engineering team operates with a high level of collaboration and interdependence, fostering an inclusive culture where connections extend beyond work. We value diverse personalities and seek someone who is both results-driven and sociable, with strong communication, leadership, and teamwork skills, along with a positive, solutions-oriented mindset.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

Rapid Issue Resolution. TRM Engineers identify and resolve critical onsite issues in minutes to hours, not weeks. We create virtual war rooms, implement fixes, and share lessons with both customer stakeholders and internal teams within 48 hours.

Navigating Bureaucracy. We anticipate and address procedural hurdles, build trust with key stakeholders, and find alternative pathways to approvals. This keeps projects moving even in complex environments.

Efficient Knowledge Transfer. Engineers document and share updates in real time, ensuring the entire team—onsite and remote—has full visibility into plans, blockers, and resolutions. Knowledge sharing sessions and clear documentation reduce friction and accelerate delivery.

About TRM's Engineering Levels:

Engineer: Responsible for helping to define project milestones and executing small decision decisions independently with the appropriate tradeoffs between simplicity, readability, and performance. Provides mentorship to junior engineers, and enhances operational excellence through tech debt reduction and knowledge sharing.

Senior Engineer: Successfully designs and documents system improvements and features for an OKR/project from the ground up. Consistently delivers efficient and reusable systems, optimizes team throughput with appropriate tradeoffs, mentors team members, and enhances cross-team collaboration through documentation and knowledge sharing.

Staff Engineer: Drives scoping and execution of one or more OKRs/projects that impact multiple teams. Partners with stakeholders to set the team vision and technical roadmaps for one or more products. Is a role model and mentor to the entire engineering organization. Ensures system health and quality with operational reviews, testing strategies, and monitoring rigor.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

The estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $270,000

Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

Accelerate repeatable workflows

Structure and solve problems

Improve output quality

Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

Priorities and targets to change quickly

Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Public Sector Deployment Strategist team at TRM Labs is dedicated to ensuring government and regulatory customers achieve their desired outcomes with TRM's blockchain intelligence platform. As a Deployment Strategist focused on the regulator segment, you will serve as a trusted advisor for regulatory agencies — driving adoption, onboarding, and retention across a critical and growing customer base. This position requires US Citizenship.

The impact you will have:

Act as a trusted advisor for regulator customers, helping them maximize the effectiveness of TRM’s blockchain intelligence tools within their compliance, enforcement, and investigative workflows.

Onboard new regulator customers and drive utilization milestones within 60 days, tailoring training and enablement to each agency’s unique regulatory mandate.

Build and maintain strategic relationships with economic buyers at regulator agencies, connecting them to TRM executive leadership within the first 90 days.

Develop and launch self-serve resources (regulator playbooks, onboarding guides, FAQ copilots) to scale support and reduce time to value across the regulator segment.

Identify recurring regulator use cases and deliver scalable solutions (chatbots, workflow templates, standard query sets) that can be reused across multiple customers.

Monitor customer usage, detect adoption gaps, and execute proactively to maintain ~90%+ retention and identify expansion opportunities.

Serve as the Voice of the Customer for the regulator segment, surfacing product feedback and feature requests to Product and Engineering.

What we're looking for:

3–5+ years of experience with financial regulators, gained in any of these ways: (1) Working at or alongside a regulator bodies, (2) Serving regulatory bodies as your primary customers in a customer success, deployment, consulting, or account management role, or (3) Building AML compliance programs at a VASP

Practical experience with or strong interest in blockchain analysis, virtual currencies, and investigative/compliance tools.

Experience structuring problems and identifying the most critical issues to prioritize in complex regulatory environments.

Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively for technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.

Demonstrated AI fluency — ability to build and deploy workflow-driven AI solutions (e.g., copilots, automated trackers, bots) beyond basic summarization.

Comfort operating in a fast-paced, remote-first environment where priorities can shift quickly.

About the Team:

The Public Sector DS team is a small, high-impact group covering multiple public sector segments, including regulators — serving some of TRM’s most strategically important customers.

Fully remote and globally distributed, with most overlap between 7am–5pm PT for meetings and collaboration.

The team thrives on asynchronous communication via Slack and Notion, with weekly customer syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, and regular POD calls.

As regulator interest grows across TRM’s product suite, this role is at the forefront of expansion into the regulatory segment.

The team culture is mission-driven, customer-obsessed, and operates with TRM Speed — delivering V1 solutions fast and iterating based on feedback.

Team Operating Rhythms:

Weekly customer syncs with assigned accounts

Bi-weekly health syncs with DS team and leadership

Weekly POD calls with aligned Sales AEs

Weekly hiring sync with Recruiter (during active hiring)

Async daily standups via Slack

On-Call Responsibilities:

Limited on-call responsibilities including one weekend on‑call per month after ramp, monitoring Slack about every two hours for P0/P1 issues

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

Self-Serve Resource Launch: Develop and launch self-serve resources (e.g., regulator playbooks, onboarding guides, or templates) within 2–3 weeks to reduce time to value and scale support across customers.

Scalable Regulator Solution: Identify a recurring regulator use case and deliver a scalable solution (e.g., chatbot, workflow template, or standard query set) within 30 days that can be reused across multiple customers.

Executive Relationship: Establish an economic buyer relationship within the first 60 days for new accounts, and connect that stakeholder to at least one TRM executive or senior leader within the first 90 days.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

Accelerate repeatable workflows

Structure and solve problems

Improve output quality

Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

Priorities and targets to change quickly

Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

A high level of personal ownership and accountability

Close collaboration across teams and functions

Frequent, high-touch communication

Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. 

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Your role in our mission

We are seeking a Sr. Application Security Engineer to join our security team. In this role, you will be a critical partner to engineering, product, and SRE teams, helping to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will drive security by design, shape our product security standards, and ensure vulnerabilities are identified, tracked, and resolved efficiently.

This is a hands-on technical role. You’ll lead secure architecture and design reviews, code reviews, and penetration testing, and you’ll be a core part of how Prosper builds and uses AI securely. That covers threat modeling agentic systems, red teaming AI applications, building AI defenses, and assessing AI risk across internal tools and vendors. 

The expected working hours for this role are based in Pacific Time.

How you’ll make an impact

Partner with engineering and product teams to define and implement security requirements for applications, APIs, microservices, and AI systems (AI platform foundations, AI agents, MCP/tool integrations) during design and architecture reviews.

Conduct in-house penetration testing, secure code reviews, and threat modeling for high-impact features, including AI-specific threat models covering models, retrieval, tools, identity, and data flows.

Plan and execute AI red teaming: prompt injection (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, data exfiltration through tools, excessive agency, and output abuse. 

Design and implement AI defenses such as guardrails, input/output filtering, gateway controls, least-privilege tool scopes, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, logging, and kill switches.

Lead application vulnerability management, including triaging and driving the remediation of security findings from SAST, DAST, SCA, and penetration tests.

Consult and advise cross-functional teams (engineering, SRE, product) on secure coding practices, security architecture, and remediation strategies.

Establish and maintain application security and secure AI development standards, guidelines, and best practices, aligned with OWASP, NIST, ISO, and industry frameworks.

Stay up-to-date on emerging security threats, especially the fast-moving AI attack landscape, to continuously improve Prosper’s security posture.

Skills that will help you thrive

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, with 8+ years of relevant experience (or Master’s degree with 6+ years).

Strong hands-on experience in application security, secure coding, and penetration testing.

Development background with expertise in Java/Python, SQL, JavaScript, including scripting against model APIs to build test harnesses and automation 

Experience working with modern web application frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, .NET, J2EE, Rails, REST, SOAP).

In-depth understanding of web and API security vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, CWE).

Familiarity with authentication and authorization protocols (e.g., OAuth2, OIDC, SAML).

Knowledge of application security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST) and methodologies.

Proven experience working with DevOps/DevSecOps pipelines, integrating security tools and automation.

Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and regulatory frameworks (e.g., PCI DSS, GDPR, SOC 2).

Extra credit

Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes).

Security experience in Agile, CI/CD, and fast-paced product development environments.

Industry certifications such as OSCP, CSSLP, GWAPT, CEH, GPEN, CISSP.

Familiarity with mobile application security testing and API security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Postman, ZAP, Insomnia).

Knowledge of network security, infrastructure security, and microservices architecture.

Experience driving secure SDLC initiatives and developer security education.

Resources to help you prosper

A connected experience: We prioritize high-touch collaboration and flexibility. Whether you are working from our San Francisco or Phoenix offices or joining us as a fully remote team member, we provide the digital-first tools and intentional culture to keep you synced and supported.

Invested in your future: A competitive salary and a 401(k) with a 5% company match to help you build long-term financial security.

Holistic well-being: We provide the resources you need to thrive, from flexible time off and paid parental leave to an annual wellness allowance and comprehensive health coverage.

Professional & personal growth: Take advantage of a suite of premium perks, including Udemy access, childcare assistance, pet insurance, and a bevy of additional savings through Beneplace.

Interview process

Recruiter Call: A brief screening to discuss your experience and initial questions.

Department Interview: Deeper dive into technical skills and project alignment with the Hiring Manager or team member.

Technical Interview: Deeper dive into coding skills.

Team Interview: Meet team members for collaborative discussions, problem-solving, or technical exercises.

Compensation

Compensation details: The salary for this position is $190k - $220k annually, plus bonus and generous benefits. In determining your salary, we will consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

jobs.title: AI Brand Design Lead

company.name: Nash
company.description: Employer named in the Jobicy listing. Check the original listing for employer details.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote, on US working hours · Reports to: Chief Growth Officer

Background

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics for brands like Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the last year we've built a brand we genuinely love: a visual identity with real thought and meaning behind it, a motion system rooted in physics, a voice people notice, a website, a presence at the biggest trade shows in commerce.

We're already an AI-obsessed team. Now we want to see what happens when someone with real creative taste and flair pairs with the velocity we've built.

The Role

We believe brand is one of the most important things a company builds, and the person in this seat has real creative authority. You will shape how Nash looks, moves, sounds, and feels everywhere it shows up. Your taste sets the bar.

We are hiring an AI Brand Design Lead to take that brand and push it into territory that wasn't possible before AI. Not redesign it. Not maintain it. Push it: more expressive motion, tighter systems, higher craft, broader application, faster velocity, and new creative territory that only opens up when you treat AI as a core design tool.

Your superpower is taste. Your medium is AI. Your job is to make the two compound: taste sharp enough that AI finally gives you the velocity to match your ambition.

Just as importantly, you think about brand as a platform. You'd rather build a system that lets any marketer on this team, armed with Claude and the right prompts, produce something fantastic and on-brand than review every output yourself. You raise the ceiling for your own work. You raise the floor for everyone else's.

If you see AI as a threat to good design, this isn't the role for you. But if you believe that one person with real taste and the right tools can build a brand system that rivals teams ten times the size, and that the real unlock is making everyone on the team capable of shipping work with your standards baked in, we want to talk.

You'll report directly to our Chief Growth Officer (who spent his career building and leading marketing, growth, and product organizations at companies like Twilio, Plaid, and Salesforce). You'll work with our CEO, CTO, and a small, senior, fast-moving team across product, engineering, and growth.

What You'll Do

Extend and refine the Nash visual identity across motion, web, print, environmental, campaign, and product surfaces

Build the brand platform: prompt libraries, LLM-readable brand documentation, component systems, and template kits that let the whole team produce on-brand work with AI

Own the marketing site (fully Claude-coded): evolve it, ship new pages, raise the bar for craft and interaction

Create the work that wasn't possible before: generative illustrations, interactive explainers, AI-driven animations, brand content that would have taken a full studio and now takes you and a prompt

Produce the visual layer of the growth engine: decks, one-pagers, customer materials

Own booth and experiential design for trade shows (NRF, Manifest, Shoptalk) where Nash shows up with installations, not just a banner

Set the standard for craft and fix the system when something falls short, not just the artifact

Requirements

6+ years in brand or visual design with a portfolio showing real range: identity, web, motion, campaign, systems

Has extended or evolved a brand at a high-growth technology company

AI-obsessed. Daily use of Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Cursor, or equivalent. Can show us the workflow, not just the outputs. If your portfolio is full of beautiful work but none of it involved AI, this is not the role

Systems thinker who can build a design kit, a prompt library, and a brand doc an LLM can reason against

Comfortable in Figma, After Effects, and Illustrator; bonus if you can ship a page with Claude Code

Treats taste as the skill that matters most, and AI as the tool that makes taste scale

How to Apply

We don't want your resume. We want to see your taste and how you apply it through tools.

Go to nash.ai. Look at our brand: read how we built it and explore the brand system. Then show us one example of how you would take something we already have and make it better. A tighter page. A motion concept. A campaign direction. An illustration style. A prompt template that generates on-brand output. Whatever catches your eye. Show us how you used AI to make it: the workflow, prompts, or system behind it, not just the output.

Send it however you want: a Figma file, a Replit prototype, a Loom, a PDF, a Claude artifact. No format requirements. Just the design idea.

Keep it small: an hour or two is plenty, and rough is fine. We're looking for your thinking and taste, not a finished deliverable. It stays yours.

A work sample is required to apply. Share it as a link or a file upload on the application form. Applications without one won't be reviewed.

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

Your role in our mission

As the first peer to peer lending marketplace in the United States, Prosper has a history of innovation. As a growing company that generates cash (rare in the valley), Prosper also has a history of generating results. 

The Director, Credit Risk Analytics is responsible for underwriting and portfolio credit strategies and oversight of credit quality and performance of the Credit Card business. They will review, analyze, and enhance the risk strategies through the use of Machine Learning models and credit data to manage the new accounts growth while managing credit losses in the risk appetite. 

They will be responsible for the life cycle of credit risk management. Because this touches every part of our business, you must be a strong collaborator who can work seamlessly across Capital Markets, Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Marketing. 

The ideal candidate is expected to bring broad and in-depth credit card expertise to the team, be comfortable to be hands-on to guide the team to develop strategies for automated credit decisions, own the end-to-end process to ensure the credit strategies are performing as expected to support business growth while managing credit losses effectively. We are looking for a passionate business and people leader with the acumen and domain expertise to tackle challenges in truly innovative ways, ensuring we continually deliver on our mission of advancing financial well-being.

How you’ll make an impact

Innovate and Optimize: Develop cutting-edge underwriting and portfolio credit, pricing, and line strategies to continually enhance credit performance using data, ML/AI models, and advanced analytics tools. Bring an out-of-the-box mindset to our credit and fraud risk management framework, balancing risk-return trade-offs with creative solutions.

Drive Strategy and Action: Translate complex findings into actionable enhancements. Present data-driven recommendations to executive leadership and the Credit Risk Committee, always weighing business impact and resource allocation.

Master External Communication: Serve as a trusted voice to our investors, translating complex data into clear, compelling narratives and insights that build confidence and transparency.

Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner seamlessly with the Capital Markets, Product, Marketing, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Engineering teams. Cultivate an open-minded environment where internal and external stakeholders can work together to implement and monitor high-performing strategies.

Manage Risk Appetite: Ensure credit losses consistently remain within the company’s defined risk appetite. 

Discover New Capabilities: Identify, evaluate, and build business cases for new products, vendors, alternative data sources, and emerging technologies.

Monitor and React: Analyze credit performance at a granular segment level on an ongoing basis to identify key performance drivers, spot emerging trends, and implement strategy changes as needed.

Skills that will help you thrive

Master’s degree or higher in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.

10+ years of experience managing credit risk within Credit Card businesses, with strong business acumen and deep knowledge of credit management.

5+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven ability to develop and mentor high-performing teams.

Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines without compromising quality. A quick, agile thinker who can confidently and constructively address questions on unfamiliar topics with clarity and conviction.

Outstanding thought leadership, with the capability to build, refine, and elevate credit strategy frameworks through innovative and structured approaches.

Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex analyses and technical subject matter clearly and succinctly to internal stakeholders, external partners, and Senior Management.

A quick thinker who can confidently address questions on unfamiliar topics with clarity and conviction.

A strong team player with a collaborative mindset and a business-owner mentality, able to partner effectively across functions.

A connected experience: We prioritize high-touch collaboration and flexibility. Whether you are working from our San Francisco or Phoenix offices or joining us as a fully remote team member, we provide the digital-first tools and intentional culture to keep you synced and supported.

Invested in your future: A competitive salary and a 401(k) with a 5% company match to help you build long-term financial security.

Holistic well-being: We provide the resources you need to thrive, from flexible time off and paid parental leave to an annual wellness allowance and comprehensive health coverage.

Professional & personal growth: Take advantage of a suite of premium perks, including Udemy access, childcare assistance, pet insurance, and a bevy of additional savings through Beneplace.

About Frontier:

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people, and we place them in the best companies. We have placed over 800 hires across 50 different US based startups and high growth companies. 

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support a US-based commercial real estate brokerage team with marketing, research, listing management, and day-to-day administrative tasks.

This role is ideal for someone who goes beyond basic AI prompting and understands how to use tools like ChatGPT and other AI platforms to get things done more efficiently. You'll be expected to use AI to research information, organize data, create and refine content, simplify repetitive tasks, and identify opportunities to improve existing workflows.

You'll also support marketing activities, online property listings, document preparation, and general administrative tasks. While marketing experience is valuable, we're particularly interested in candidates who are comfortable experimenting with AI tools, figuring out how to solve unfamiliar problems, and turning ideas into practical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing & Content Support

Create and update marketing materials, presentations, brochures, flyers, and promotional content using existing templates and digital tools.

Use AI tools to assist with drafting property descriptions, marketing copy, email campaigns, research summaries, and other content.

Review and edit AI-generated content to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and a professional tone before sharing or publishing.

Coordinate property images, maps, aerial imagery, and other visual assets for marketing materials.

Assist with email marketing campaigns, property announcements, and promotional activities.

Help coordinate the preparation and updating of property signage.

2. AI & Digital Tools

Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other relevant platforms to streamline research, drafting, data organization, and repetitive administrative work.

Develop effective prompts and workflows to generate useful, accurate outputs for day-to-day tasks.

Verify AI-generated information against reliable sources rather than relying on unverified outputs.

Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and support team productivity.

Learn and adapt to new software, platforms, and workflows as business needs evolve.

3. Research & Data Management

Conduct online research to gather property details, market information, comparable listings, and other relevant data.

Maintain and update internal databases, spreadsheets, contact lists, and property records.

Collect, organize, and verify information from multiple sources.

Ensure data is accurate, complete, and consistently formatted.

Identify missing information, inconsistencies, or errors and follow up as needed.

4. Listing & Administrative Support

Create and update online listings using approved information, templates, and workflows.

Maintain accurate property details, descriptions, pricing, images, and supporting documents across relevant platforms.

Prepare and organize documents using established templates.

Assist with sending documents through DocuSign and tracking signatures or outstanding paperwork.

Support the preparation of listing agreements and other brokerage documents using approved templates and instructions.

Keep marketing assets, property records, and administrative documents organized and easy to access.

Track pending tasks, follow up on outstanding items, and provide general support to the brokerage team.

Requirements

Experience in virtual assistance, administrative support, marketing coordination, research, data management, or a similar role.

Strong experience in AI tools such as ChatGPT to support research, writing, content creation, and administrative workflows.

Strong attention to detail and the ability to verify information before using or sharing it.

Good written English and the ability to produce clear, professional content.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets, online databases, document management tools, and web-based platforms.

Resourceful and quick to learn new software and processes.

Able to work independently in a remote environment and communicate proactively with a US-based team.

Nice to Have

Experience with commercial real estate, property management, or real estate marketing.

Familiarity with platforms such as Buildout, CoStar, LoopNet, or Crexi.

Experience with Canva or similar tools for creating marketing materials.

Familiarity with DocuSign, email marketing platforms, and CRM systems.

Experience using AI tools beyond basic prompting, including building repeatable workflows or using AI to improve productivity.

Experience coordinating property imagery, maps, aerial photos, or signage.

What We're Looking For

AI-savvy: Comfortable using AI to improve the speed and quality of everyday work, while checking outputs carefully.

Detail-oriented: Takes the time to verify facts, review documents, and catch inconsistencies.

Proactive: Spots what needs to be done and follows through without constant supervision.

Adaptable: Learns new platforms and workflows quickly, even without prior industry experience.

Organized: Keeps information, files, and tasks structured and easy to track.

Resourceful: Knows how to research unfamiliar topics, find reliable information, and solve problems independently.

The ideal candidate combines strong administrative and marketing skills with practical AI experience and a willingness to learn.

jobs.description:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.

To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com

About Mattermost Federal

Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Our platform runs on-premises, in private clouds and in air-gapped networks, and is trusted by defense, government and enterprise customers with strict security and compliance requirements.

About the Role

We are looking for Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who want to solve real operational problems alongside mission teams. In this role you will work directly with operators, analysts, and engineers to deploy and build systems that are used every day in mission environments.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You will operate close to the mission, often inside classified environments, working through ambiguity and building solutions that have immediate operational impact.

The problems you will work on here are hard, ambiguous, and consequential.

What You'll Do

Work directly with defense and intelligence organizations to understand operational problems

Deploy and integrate Mattermost in classified and mission-critical environments

Build plugins, integrations, and automations that enable operational workflows

Prototype new capabilities quickly and iterate based on operator feedback

Debug complex systems operating in constrained environments

Help shape the evolution of the Mattermost platform based on mission needs

You will move between writing code, deploying infrastructure, and working directly with operators, often within the same week. Travel is typically approximately one week per month onsite with customers.

What We're Looking For

Strong engineering ability (Go, Python, TypeScript, or similar)

Comfort working across the full stack from infrastructure to applications

Ability to solve open-ended technical problems

Strong communication skills with both engineers and operators

Willingness to travel approximately one week per month

Nice to Have

Experience working with DoD, IC, or national security organizations

Experience deploying systems in secure or classified environments

Familiarity with Kubernetes, distributed systems, and APIs

Experience building integrations or operational tooling

AI-Forward Engineering

Mattermost Federal is aggressively adopting AI-enabled workflows across mission operations. FDEs will be among the first engineers deploying and operationalizing AI capabilities in secure environments, including:

AI agents that summarize operational channels and generate SITREPs

AI-assisted mission timelines and decision logs

Knowledge retrieval across operational history

AI tools that help operators understand fast-moving mission data

Why This Role Exists

The best software is built close to the problem. Forward Deployed Engineers at Mattermost Federal work directly with the people using the systems we build. You will see problems firsthand, build solutions quickly, and deploy them into environments where reliability, security, and speed matter.

Compensation

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

Mattermost offers a remote-first work environment with medical, dental, and vision coverage. You’ll also receive unlimited PTO plus company holidays, a work from home stipend, an annual learning and development budget for conferences, certifications, and courses, paid parental leave for all parents, and a 401(k) plan.

Canada Eligibility & Compliance

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada without current or future sponsorship.

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a government security clearance or equivalent designation (such as Reliability Status or Secret clearance under Canada's Controlled Goods Program), depending on customer engagement. Candidates must meet eligibility requirements to be considered.

Given Mattermost's work with U.S. defense and government customers, some positions may also require compliance with U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR, which can apply to non-U.S. based employees working on covered technical data. For more information, visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

jobs.description:
If you've spent the last few years in consulting, you know the work: get inside a client's operation, find where value is leaking, and go after it. This is that job, except here you keep the clients. You keep an ongoing relationship with the clients where your engagement would normally end.

You'll run a book of Nash's strategic and enterprise customers, four or five strategic accounts or about ten enterprise ones. When a deal is sold, a Solutions Consultant scopes and builds each deployment. Your role during onboarding is to learn the operation alongside them and take the lead once the customer is live.From there, your job is to make sure every account gets the most out of Nash, and to keep finding what would make it better.

What you'll do

Learn each operation from the inside. Join during onboarding with the Solutions Consultant and Engineers, so by go-live you know how the customer runs as well as the people who built it.

Find the opportunities and go after them. Every account has four kinds:

Adoption: customers are engaged with the services they purchased, as well as all future releases of Nash that are applicable to their operations, including our AI Agents.

Operations: better on-time performance, lower cost per delivery, fewer exceptions.

Efficiency: accounts that run cleanly, with day-to-day work handled by Support instead of you.

Growth: a well-run account surfaces new opportunities. You bring them to the Account Executive and Solutions Consultant to pursue.

Run each account on a cadence. Quarterly adoption goals, a regular operating review with the customer's team, and business reviews with their leadership.

Spot risk early. Know the health of every account in your book, and act before a problem becomes an escalation.

Work across Nash. Support handles day-to-day requests, Solutions Consultants and Engineering handle builds, and Account Executives handle the commercial side. You're the one who knows what each account needs from all of them.

Keep up with the product. Nash ships product quickly, including AI capabilities. Know what's new before your customers ask, and bring it to them when it fits.

Who you are

From consulting or strategic customer work. Two or more years in strategy or operations consulting, or in strategic customer success or account management at an enterprise software company.

A problem finder. You look at an operation and see where it could be better, and you structure the case for fixing it.

An operator. You get things done by working with other people and following through until the job is complete.

Data fluent. You're at home in dashboards and spreadsheets, and you can pull the numbers that make your case.

Fluent with AI. You already use AI tools in your daily work, and you pick up new ones quickly.

Credible at every level. With executives and with the people running the operation every day.

Logistics experience helps, but isn't required. How you think matters more.

How you're measured

Adoption goals for each account, set quarterly.

The health of every account in your book.

How efficiently each account runs.

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

jobs.description:
About Us

Every physical product you touch starts with raw materials & chemicals that someone has to find, qualify, and buy. The soap you wash your hands with, the laptop you’re looking at right now, and even the concrete sidewalk under your feet. That’s a $6T industry. Most of it still runs on spreadsheets, phone calls, and trade shows.

Valdera is the leading AI platform for chemicals and raw materials. Our agents help procurement teams find savings, reduce supply risk, and source from qualified suppliers. We also help suppliers find and win the right customers. We work with some of the largest manufacturers in the world, including market leaders in pharma, personal care, beauty, and industrials. Many of them spend $1B to $10B each on raw materials. They rely on Valdera as their source of truth and to run big workflows end to end.

Index Ventures led our $15M Series A, and we’re growing fast.

What's interesting?

You'll think like a product manager and own results like a revenue leader.

Drive real revenue - We're the fastest-growing company in our space, and we're investing heavily in technology to make step changes in how fast we sell. What you build shows up directly in our growth.

Build on a winning product - The largest manufacturers in the world rely on Valdera to run big purchasing and supply chain workflows end to end. Your work helps us win more of them, faster.

Have creative ownership - You'll help set the vision and have ownership of how we get there.

Work directly with the founders. You'll partner with them every week on how we sell, serve customers, and grow.

Build for top talent. Our people are technology-first and highly capable. You won't have to convince anyone to try what you build.

A fast engineering team. Our engineers are exceptional, and they'll speed you up instead of slowing you down.

You get the best tools. You'll have the budget to pick the best AI tools and data for the job.

Role Description

We're hiring our first GTM AI & Engineering Lead to keep accelerating Valdera's growth. You'll design the AI workflows our sales team runs on. Then you'll help build them. 

Our AEs sell to some of the largest manufacturers in the world. Every deal takes deep account research, sharp meeting prep, tailored proposals, and steady follow-through. You'll build AI agents and workflows that handle that work, so our sellers spend their time with customers.

You'll start with sales and extend to customer success, forward deployed engineering, and marketing. You'll learn how each team works, where their time goes, and what would change their results. Then you'll prototype, prove ideas with data, and partner with our engineers to put it into production.

Role Responsibilities

Help set the AI vision for GTM. Decide which AI workflows, tools, and data will make the biggest step change in how fast we grow. Turn that into a plan the team believes in.

Learn how our sellers work. Sit with our AEs, CSMs, and FDEs. Map their workflows, find where their time goes, and pick the changes that will move results most.

Raise the bar for sales. Work with sales leaders as a peer. Challenge how we sell today, show them what's possible, and redesign the process around it.

Build AI agents for every stage of the deal. Automate account research, prospecting, meeting prep, call follow-ups, and proposals for Fortune 500 manufacturers. Every AE should have an AI team behind them.

Turn signals into pipeline. Use data from our platforms and from massive live global data sources to find the right accounts and the right moment to reach them, on both the buyer and supplier side.

Design how our systems fit together. Decide how Attio, our AI tools, and our data sources connect, from data models to integrations. Use AI to keep data clean, and make sure every tool earns its place.

Prototype fast. Build working versions with LLMs, coding agents, APIs, and automation tools. Test them with the team and keep what works.

Ship with engineering. Partner with our engineers to turn your best prototypes into production systems the whole team relies on.

Be data drive. Query and analyze pipeline, usage, and customer data. Judge every workflow by what it does to win rates, deal speed, and expansion.

Run AI the team can trust. Set guardrails, check output quality, and manage model costs as the agents scale.

Make change stick. Roll out each new workflow, train the team, and track adoption. A workflow only counts when people use it.

Experience & Qualifications

You have 5+ years in GTM engineering, revenue operations, sales, growth, BizOps, or product, ideally at a fast-growing B2B startup.

You've built AI workflows that a sales team uses every day. You can show what they did for revenue, pipeline, win rates, or time saved.

You've enabled cross-functional GTM teams before. Sales, customer success, and marketing moved faster because of what you built.

You think like a product manager. You start with the user's workflow and the outcome, then decide what to build.

You think in systems. You understand APIs, data schemas, and integration patterns, and you know how tools like CRMs, Claude, and Jira connect.

You're data driven. You can write queries, analyze data, and let real evidence drive your decisions.

You know how B2B sales works. You understand prospecting, long enterprise sales cycles, and how pipeline, win rates, and expansion drive growth.

You build your own prototypes with LLMs, coding agents, APIs, and automation tools.

You've partnered with engineers to take a prototype to production.

You love open-ended problems. You take a high-level goal, shape the plan, and see it through.

Our Culture

The best want to work with the best. That's why we obsess over our culture and bring in exceptional people to lead every part of the business. Above all, we look for curiosity. Our people ask the right questions, get to innovative answers, and do whatever it takes to win. Building a winning startup takes hard work and a lot of time together, so being low-ego, genuine, and fun matters just as much.

Compensation

Additional Information

Salary Range:

Compensation of $170K to $300k. 

Meaningful equity.

Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location.

Benefits:

Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. Full time employees are eligible for premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance coverage. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera.

Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

Based outside of the US

We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions. 

The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.
