jobs.description:
Joining Collibra's Sales Compensation team

Collibra is the global leader in data intelligence, helping organizations find, understand, trust, and access data at scale.

You'll join the Sales Compensation team, which sits within Finance and works alongside Sales Operations and Total Rewards to design, calculate, and pay commissions for quota-carrying Collibrians across North America and EMEA. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Compensation you will be the hands-on owner of sales comp operations, plan logic in Xactly, monthly close, dispute resolution, and the annual plan cycle. Because every seller sees the output of this work each month, the team lives our value of being open, direct, and kind: we explain how a number was calculated, we say when something is wrong, and we fix it in the open.

This is a hybrid role based in our Raleigh office or remote US. Our hybrid model means you’ll work from the office at least two days each week. This setup helps us stay connected, work more closely together, and keep making progress as a team.

The Senior Sales Compensation Analyst at Collibra is responsible for 

Running the monthly commission close end to end data intake, credit validation, reconciliation against Salesforce and Finance ledgers, accrual submission, and payroll handoff, so that sellers are paid accurately and on the close calendar.

Administering incentive plan logic in our ICM platform, including quotas, rates, accelerators, SPIFFs, and overlay rules, and supporting rep data feeds from Salesforce and Workday, in order to keep the system aligned to approved plan documents.

Owning the compensation inquiry and dispute queue by tracing data from booking to payout and applying structured exception handling, so that sellers receive a documented root-cause answer within SLA.

Partnering with Accounting and FP&A on commission expense accruals, quarterly true-ups, and variance explanations, in order to support journal entries and a defensible close.

Making the function repeatable through SOPs, data maps and dictionaries, audit-ready documentation, and automation of manual workarounds, so that sales comp scales with the go-to-market organization.

You Have

6+ years in an analytical role, with at least 4 years in a dedicated sales compensation function at a B2B SaaS or high-growth technology company.

Demonstrated ownership of monthly commission close payroll handoff, accrual submission, and variance reconciliation plus hands-on administration of an enterprise ICM platform (Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, or Spiff)

Experience managing a compensation inquiry and dispute queue with defined SLAs and structured exception handling.

Advanced Excel and equivalent Google Sheets proficiency: multi-sheet financial models, named ranges, array formulas, XLOOKUP and INDEX-MATCH, pivot tables, and dynamic charts, built without hardcoded cell references.

Working experience with Salesforce, including opportunity objects, field mappings, report builder, and the data pipeline that feeds commission calculations.

A bachelor's degree or equivalent related working experience is required.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

You Are

Rigorous about accuracy: treats each payout cycle as a zero-defect process and self-audits before submission so errors don't reach sellers.

Able to manage several concurrent workstreams against fixed close-calendar deadlines without trading off quality.

Able to explain complex plan mechanics to a seller in plain English and present attainment analytics to a VP in a single well-structured slide.

Comfortable diagnosing ambiguous crediting scenarios from first principles and documenting a defensible conclusion.

Inclined to ask how a process can be made repeatable and scalable, including by applying AI and automation tools to routine comp work, rather than accepting manual workarounds.

Familiar with SaaS revenue metrics (ARR, ACV, TCV, bookings versus revenue recognition), quota coverage ratios, and commission accrual mechanics under ASC 340-40 and 606, or willing to learn them.

Measures of success are

Within your first month, you will have working knowledge of Collibra's core incentive comp plans and mechanics, have shadowed one to two commission closes, and be managing inquiry tickets with Senior Manager oversight on non-standard cases.

Within your third month, you will run monthly close independently with Senior Manager spot-checks, deliver the payroll file on time, and contribute to ICM implementation testing and reconciliation including parallel-run discrepancy work, with go-live sign-off remaining a shared decision.

Within your sixth month, you will hold SLA compliance above 95% on all inquiries, have zero payroll correction cycles attributable to calculation errors, and have documented SOPs for the team's top ten processes.

Compensation for This Role

The standard base salary range for this position is $88,000 - $110,000 per year. This position is not eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

Job Title: Senior DevOps Engineer

Location: USA (Remote or Regional Office)

Reports To: SVP of Engineering

About Cyware

Cyware delivers an innovative approach to cybersecurity that unifies threat intelligence, automation, threat response, and vulnerability management with data insights gleaned from assets, users, malware, attackers, and vulnerabilities. Cyware’s Cyber Fusion platform integrates SOAR and TIP technology, enabling collaboration across siloed security teams. Cyware is widely deployed by enterprises, government agencies, and MSSPs, and is the leading threat intelligence sharing platform for global ISACs and CERTs.

Why We’re Hiring

Cyware is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to build, secure, and operate the infrastructure supporting product environments in AWS and AWS GovCloud. This role owns CI/CD, deployment, and operational reliability across commercial and government environments, ensuring releases meet high standards of security, availability, and compliance across cloud boundaries, including FedRAMP High, GovRAMP Moderate, and IL5 environments.

About You

You are driven, inquisitive, proactive, and energetic.

You have a growth mindset and are committed to delivering results.

You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

You are passionate about cloud engineering, DevOps, automation, security, reliability, and scalable systems.

Come join an exciting cybersecurity product startup that has closed its Series C funding round!

What You’ll Do

Work closely with development teams to integrate projects into production AWS and AWS GovCloud environments and ensure ongoing support.

Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent; support Helm chart packaging and ArgoCD/GitOps deployment into Kubernetes.

Operate and harden infrastructure within compliance-heavy authorization boundaries such as FedRAMP High, GovRAMP Moderate, and IL5, maintaining continuous compliance across releases.

Own environment segmentation, secrets management, and access controls consistent with NIST 800-53 and FedRAMP control families.

Manage Kubernetes workloads, Helm chart versioning, and release promotion across development, staging, commercial, and GovCloud production environments.

Build reliable, scalable infrastructure services in AWS and support infrastructure for both cloud and on-premise deployments.

Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK for repeatable, auditable provisioning.

Support database deployment and schema migration using Postgres, Flyway, or equivalent tooling tied to release cycles.

Build monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational automation to meet government-grade availability and incident-response requirements.

Partner with Security/GRC to prepare and maintain evidence for FedRAMP/GovRAMP continuous monitoring, POA&Ms, annual assessments, and audit cycles.

Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis for GovCloud-hosted environments, with documentation meeting government audit standards.

Gain deep application-level knowledge of systems and contribute to their overall design; troubleshoot application, deployment, and operations issues.

Build engineering automation and productivity tools to streamline and scale production applications while minimizing manual interaction.

Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture, and Security/GRC to keep commercial and government environments aligned with the product roadmap without compliance drift.

Be a DevOps champion by building security, reliability, scalability, and best practices into the development lifecycle.

Who You Are

US Citizenship is a requirement of this position in accordance with 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(2)(C).

5+ years of experience in DevOps/Platform/Site Reliability Engineering, with 2+ years operating workloads in AWS GovCloud.

Hands-on experience deploying and maintaining infrastructure under FedRAMP High or Moderate, GovRAMP/StateRAMP, or DoD IL5 authorization frameworks.

Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance; active or eligible for a federal security clearance.

Working knowledge of NIST 800-53 controls and how they translate into infrastructure and pipeline design.

Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and GitOps (ArgoCD or equivalent).

Hands-on experience with AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent cloud services.

Experience with CI/CD pipeline engineering using Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or equivalent.

Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools including Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.

Experience with configuration-management/automation tools such as Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Rundeck, or equivalent.

Experience with queuing systems such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, or equivalent.

Experience with relational database deployment/migration tooling such as Postgres and Flyway, or equivalent.

Experience supporting continuous monitoring, POA&M remediation, assessment, and audit cycles.

Basic knowledge of networking concepts such as subnets and environment segmentation.

Experience with containers and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.

Ability to create infrastructure services for both cloud and on-premise deployments.

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Background in developer experience or platform engineering, especially building developer tooling

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

What you’ll do

Build safety systems: Design, develop, and scale automated moderation systems, abuse detection capabilities, and guardrails for AI agents across ElevenLabs’ products.

Respond to emerging threats: Partner closely with the Investigations team to identify emerging abuse patterns, understand evolving threats, and continuously improve existing safety systems, detection mechanisms, and guardrails to address new risks.

Own production infrastructure: Build and maintain a growing ecosystem of internal safety services, taking ownership of their architecture, deployment, reliability, monitoring, and ongoing operation.

Bring ML models into production: Partner closely with ML engineers to deploy and integrate fine-tuned and proprietary ML models into production safety systems, ensuring they operate reliably and efficiently at scale.

Build end-to-end solutions: Develop backend services, APIs, internal tools, and user-facing interfaces that enable effective moderation, safety operations, and policy enforcement.

Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Safety Policy teams to translate business, regulatory, and policy requirements into scalable engineering solutions.

Product: Understand and navigate the tradeoffs between product growth, user experience, and platform safety.

Legal: Translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable safety systems.

Safety Policy: Collaborate on how safety policies are implemented technically, while helping inform policy decisions through an understanding of engineering capabilities and constraints.

Shape our technical direction: Contribute to architectural decisions and help define how our safety infrastructure evolves as our products, users, and safety challenges grow.

Requirements

5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

Strong backend engineering experience, including designing APIs, working with databases, and building scalable services.

Proficiency in Python and experience with modern backend frameworks.

Experience building and maintaining distributed systems and cloud-based applications.

Comfortable owning systems end to end, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

Experience working across different parts of the stack, with the ability to build internal tools or frontend interfaces when needed.

Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and make pragmatic engineering decisions.

Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and non-technical stakeholders across different functions.

Bonus

Experience building Trust & Safety, content moderation, fraud detection, or abuse prevention systems.

Experience building guardrails or safety infrastructure for AI agents and LLM-based applications.

Experience deploying and integrating ML models into production applications.

Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.

Experience with React or other modern frontend frameworks.

Experience with real-time data processing, event-driven architectures, or technologies such as Kafka and Redis.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. 

Position Summary
We are looking for a Global Support Engineer I who can support a remote-first, flexible shift schedule. This is a growth role—you will advance your career as a support engineering professional while simultaneously increasing your knowledge and hands-on experience with networking infrastructure as a service. You will regularly support interesting and challenging technical matters and questions and bring clarity to our customers as they leverage our tools to secure their networks in an ever-changing security threat landscape.

Key Responsibilities
As a member of the Global Support Engineering team, you will work with customers to resolve technical issues with our product(s) using a variety of internal resources and provide data analysis to understand and troubleshoot systems. Your day-to-day responsibilities could include any of the following:

Provide hardware and firmware deployment support for our appliances.

Actively participate in Knowledge Centered Services (KCS) by learning from documented knowledge and contributing to discussions.

Engage in troubleshooting activities, following guidance and existing documentation.

Assist with the initial stages of ticket handling and escalate when necessary.

Work collaboratively with more experienced engineers and cross functional teams to gain deeper insights into complex issues.

Assist customers with configuration of network infrastructure, virtualization, and third-party integrations.

Assist customers with hardware support and replacement.

Utilize a ticketing system to update, communicate, and move work items to completion.

Act as the single point of contact for customer questions and concerns.

Communicate with customers in a highly professional manner via various channels including phone, ticketing system, and video conferencing.

Pair your existing knowledge with a continuous learning mindset to elevate your service to our customers while being a force-multiplier to your colleagues.

Attend regular “in-office” meetings (limited to no more than monthly) and annual in-office training sessions

Required Qualifications

Two years of experience in B2B Technical Support — this is not an entry-level position.

In-depth knowledge of the OSI model.

Understanding of network infrastructure routing and switching concepts.

In-depth knowledge of data traversal within an internal environment and its interaction with external networks.

Specific networking knowledge related to protocols, DHCP, TCP, DNS resolution, TLS and TLS connection establishment, HTTP, SSO, network topologies, etc.

Ability to translate technical concepts into applicable troubleshooting best practices.

Ability to troubleshoot complex architectural incidents based on the application or incident. 

Excellent customer service, organizational, and documentation skills.

Ability to work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders.

Ability to work well in fast-paced, high-stress environments.

Predictable, reliable attendance.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Unix/Linux-based operating systems.

An understanding of cybersecurity concepts, terminology and tools

Javascript familiarity and comfort.

Certifications in networking or infrastructure (like CompTIA Network+).

Certifications in Cyber Security (like CompTia Security+)

Schedule: 9am-6pm 

The salary range for this role is £30,000 - £35,000 + bonus 

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. 

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your role

Zip is hiring a strategic and hands-on Senior Technical Enablement Manager to own the readiness and development experience for our Solutions Engineering organization. This role sits at the intersection of pre-sales execution, product expertise, and learning design ensuring our SE team can confidently lead technical discovery, deliver compelling demos, crush the competitive landscape, and drive deals forward with depth and precision.

You'll be the primary enablement partner to the SE org, working closely with SE leadership, PMM, and Product to build programs that directly translate into better technical win rates and faster deal velocity.

What You'll Do

Own SE Onboarding & Ramp

Design and deliver a structured ramp program for new SEs including covering platform depth, demo certification, discovery methodology, and technical objection handling. Track ramp KPIs and iterate to accelerate time-to-readiness.

Drive Ongoing Technical Readiness

Build and maintain a continuous learning program that keeps SEs sharp as the product evolves. Partner with Product and PMM to operationalize new releases, competitive shifts, and messaging updates into field-ready training.

Build and Maintain SE Certifications

Own the SE certification framework including demo quality, technical discovery, and RFx readiness. Run bi-annual refreshes in partnership with SE leadership and use AI roleplay tools (e.g. LetterAI) to scale practice and coaching.

Enable Competitive & Vertical Depth

Develop programs that arm SEs with the technical differentiation, industry context, and ERP/integration knowledge (e.g. SAP) needed to win in enterprise deals.

Leverage Data to Improve Performance

Use Gong call intelligence, competency assessments, and win/loss data to identify gaps in technical delivery, narrative quality, and demo effectiveness then build targeted interventions to close those gaps.

Partner Cross-Functionally

Act as the connective tissue between SE leadership, PMM, Product, and RevOps to ensure SE enablement is tightly aligned with GTM strategy, product launches, and competitive priorities.

Measure What Matters

Track leading indicators (demo certification pass rates, call quality scores, competitive win rates, early-stage conversion) and lagging indicators (win rate, deal velocity, ACV) to demonstrate enablement impact.

What We're Looking For

• 4–7+ years of experience in technical pre-sales enablement, solutions engineering, or a closely related GTM role in a high-growth SaaS environment

• Deep understanding of the SE function. You know how SEs think, how they prep for technical evaluations, and what separates great demos from average ones

• Proven experience building certification programs, technical learning journeys, and demo readiness frameworks

• Hands-on with tools like Gong, LMS platforms, and AI roleplay tools (e.g. LetterAI)

• Strong data orientation and comfortable pulling insights from call intelligence and performance data to inform program design

• Excellent communication, cross-functional influence, and project management skills

• High execution bar. You’ll ship programs, iterate fast, and build trust with technical teams.

Nice to haves

• Background in solutions consulting, technical pre-sales, or sales engineering

• Experience with procurement or finance technology (Zip platform familiarity a plus)

• Familiarity with RFx processes and enterprise procurement evaluation cycles

• Instructional design and curriculum development experience

• Knowledge of ERP ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Workday) and how they intersect with procurement tech

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $170,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape the core experience our members rely on every day across iOS, Android and web.

You'll own the moments that matter: onboarding, listing homes, finding and applying for sits, matching with the right sitter or owner, preparing for a stay. This is a hands-on role as the primary designer in your squad. You'll have real strategic influence over your area's direction and drive measurable impact for both our members and the business.

What You'll Do

Design mobile-first experiences that work across iOS, Android and web, respecting platform conventions while staying consistent with our design system

Own discovery research and testing for your squad (interviews, usability testing, concept testing) and measure impact using product analytics and qualitative signals to guide iteration

Define problems and hypotheses with your squad, choose the right validation method to make sure we're building the right thing for our customers

Design AI-powered features for matching, personalisation and communication with trust and transparency built in, and use AI tools daily to speed up exploration, prototyping and synthesis

Work with stakeholders across product, engineering, user research, content, data and commercial teams, communicating design rationale clearly to stakeholders, facilitating workshops to create alignment and negotiating trade offs

Contribute to and evolve the design system, partnering with Design Systems to create robust, accessible, cross-platform patterns

Build solutions that scale. Map journeys and service relationships rather than solving problems in isolation, and champion craft and accessibility throughout

What you'll need

Strategy and systems thinking

Strong systems thinking with experience designing complex customer journeys end to end. Proven ability to set customer-centric vision and translate it into practical, phased delivery while balancing member needs with business goals and technical constraints.

Research and methodology

Hands-on user research skills, confident choosing methods and synthesising insight into clear design direction. Able to frame complex challenges into clear problem statements and testable hypotheses, with solid understanding of experimentation methods and when to use each.

Craft and execution

Exceptional interaction and visual design craft with meticulous attention to detail, including advanced prototyping and working within mature design systems. Deep knowledge of mobile interface guidelines and best practices, backed by a portfolio showing end-to-end, beautifully crafted, user-centred work with measurable impact on customer and business outcomes.

AI in design

Confident daily use of AI-assisted design and prototyping tools as part of your everyday workflow. You'll ideally be working in Cursor, Claude Code or similar for at least some of your workflow and you'll bring ideas of how AI tools can be used to drive efficiency and impact across the design process.

Collaboration and culture

Excellent communication and storytelling skills with comfort working in empowered, cross-functional squads. Experience in scale-ups with strong product and experimentation culture. You'll need to be confident in selling your ideas across the business, creating alignment and inspiring others.

Nice to have

Experience designing AI/ML-powered features such as recommendations engines and LLMs with good understanding of the UX challenges they create - trust, comprehension, feedback loops, agency etc.

Experience in two-sided marketplaces, subscription or membership businesses, or trust and safety-sensitive products.

Self-serve analytics experience (we use Amplitude, Mode) and familiarity with research depository tools such as Dovetail, Chattermill.

Our hiring process

Intro call with hiring manager

Technical portfolio review with PM, Design lead and Engineering partner

Leadership and first 90 days presentation

What you'll bring

You'll own the product design process end-to-end.

At TrustedHousesitters we start with the customer. You'll need to be able to show us how you've used quantitative and qualitative user research to inform your approach to solving product design problems.

You'll feel like a fish out of water if:

We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply:

Your design experience is web-only - you haven't shaped native iOS or Android app experiences.

Your background is mainly B2B, enterprise, or public sector - you're used to solving problems functionally, and this role needs you to think about design emotionally too.

You'd rather be handed a fully-scoped brief than help define the problem yourself - you'll be the primary designer in your squad, shaping direction, not just executing someone else's spec.

You're sceptical of AI having a genuine place in the design process, or you actively avoid using AI tools in your own workflow.

When you disagree with a decision, you tend to raise it and step back - we need people who'll stay in the room and help find the way through.

Compensation

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family

Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
year towards travel costs to and from sits

Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan

Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan

Specsavers eyecare scheme

Weekly virtual yoga sessions

Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

 💻 Working environment

Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident

Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start

Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe

We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year

We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth

Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)

Competitive salary which is reviewed annually

Generous equity package for permanent employees

Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly

Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters

£500 recruitment referral bonus

If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. Offers of employment into TrustedHousesitters are based solely on individual merit, qualifications, and the person's professional suitability.

Gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or beliefs, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy or maternity status, or any other protected characteristics do not enter into our decision-making process.

jobs.description:
About Carrot: 

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time, fully remote physician consultants who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across multiple U.S. states. Depending on your licensure, certification, and area of expertise, you will provide consultations in menopause and perimenopause care aligned to The Menopause Society and ACOG guidelines, early fertility support aligned to ACOG and ASRM guidelines, or both.

Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. Weight, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic risk are central to outcomes across every journey we support, from ovulatory function and preconception readiness to menopausal symptom burden and long-term cardiovascular and bone health. You should expect metabolic assessment and management to be a routine part of your visits, and clinicians comfortable prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists, within clinical protocols are especially encouraged to apply.

This is a flexible, part-time contractor engagement of approximately 5-40 hours per week, with a target commitment of 10-15 hours per week. 

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

Provide virtual consultations (video and/or phone) within your area(s) of expertise, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing management of menopausal, fertility, and related hormonal and metabolic concerns.

Apply current ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines with individualized, shared decision-making.

Assess and manage metabolic health as a routine part of visits, including prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications such as GLP-1 receptor agonists within clinical protocols where appropriate.

Document visits accurately and on time, order and interpret relevant labs, and coordinate referrals to primary care, OB/GYN, endocrinology, behavioral health, or subspecialists as needed.

Maintain active, unrestricted multi-state clinical licensure, complete credentialing and payer enrollment, and maintain eligibility for additional state licenses to expand coverage.

Contribute to member experience and quality through strong virtual visit presence, effective use of telehealth and EHR systems, participation in chart audits and case reviews, and staying current with emerging research and regulatory changes.

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

Established a consistent panel of high-quality virtual visits within your clinical area(s), with strong member experience and visit quality results.

Maintained timely, accurate documentation and lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.

Expanded your state licensure coverage in line with program needs, supporting broader member access.

Integrated metabolic assessment and management, including GLP-1 protocols where clinically appropriate, as a routine part of your visits.

Contributed to chart audits, case reviews, and clinical protocol refinement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You ✨

You likely have:

An MD or DO in Obstetrics/Gynecology, Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI), Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Endocrinology; or you are a Physician Assistant (PA) or Advanced Practice Registered Nurse/Nurse Practitioner (e.g., WHNP, adult/gerontology NP, FNP) with demonstrated expertise in the applicable clinical area.

A minimum of 3-5+ years of active clinical experience in early fertility support, menopause care, or both, including evaluation, treatment, and longitudinal management.

An active, unrestricted U.S. medical license; multi-state licensure is preferred and IMLC participation is strongly preferred.

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role.

We are searching for a driven and skillful Key Account Manager to work alongside and grow Halter’s enterprise dairy and beef customers in the Waikato region. We’re looking for someone with dairy systems knowledge, commercial nous, X-factor communication skills, and the ability to drive change and communicate value.

You will be managing a portfolio of large corporate dairy operations, from phase one rollout through to full-scale integration with Halter technology. You will be driving the success and growth of Halter within these accounts.

You’ll be an expert at building trusting relationships, identifying opportunities within a farming system to add value, and enjoy driving the growth of the largest agricultural businesses in New Zealand. You’ll thrive in high-pressure environments, using initiative to make results happen, often against the odds. You might find yourself in a boardroom assisting the negotiating of a million-dollar contract one day, reporting key KPI’s to a GM the next day, communicating opportunities and driving change with Farm Managers by Friday. You’ll masterfully navigate layers within these businesses, adjusting your communication at each level accordingly, to convey the right context and value to all parties. You’ll likely have deep extensive farming systems knowledge and have a natural ability to drive change at a farm and leadership level.

This isn’t a typical role. This is a high-stakes role, playing a critical role in Halter’s growth into the enterprise segment in New Zealand.

Aside from jumping on the Halter roller coaster, you will be making a real-world impact, helping large scale dairy and beef businesses transform how they operate to become more efficient and productive. You will build relationships across some of the most influential dairy businesses in New Zealand while working closely with Halter senior leadership - Up for the challenge? Let’s talk.

This role covers customers across the Waikato region. Frequent travel is required as part of this position.

What your day could look like.

Enterprise Customer Success: You’ll be embedded in the success of some of Halter’s largest and most strategic customers - ensuring our enterprise dairy and beef businesses realise full value from their investment. You’ll understand their goals and farm system deeply, help them embed Halter into daily operations, and surface impact across the business. Your efforts will directly influence execution, retention, expansion, and long-term growth.

Strategic Account Management: You’ll build trusted, long-term relationships with farm teams, operational teams and executive stakeholders alike. You’ll know when to guide, when to challenge, and when to step in to unlock new value. This isn’t just about managing relationships - it’s about owning customer outcomes.

Executive Engagement: In collaboration with the Enterprise Sales Manager you will work directly with senior leaders, and multi-entity decision-makers. You’ll understand the organisational structure, surface strategic pain points, and partner with the Enterprise Sales Manager to tailor solutions that move the needle. With the Enterprise Sales Manager, you’ll also play a key role in supporting expansion and renewal conversations.

Influencer & Network Management: You won’t stop with your customer. You’ll build relationships with rural professionals, consultants, and other industry influencers who shape opinion, success on farm and purchasing behaviour across your portfolio. You’ll be known and respected in the region as a trusted Halter advisor.

Enterprise Growth Strategy: You’ll collaborate with the NZ Enterprise Sales Manager to co-create account plans, drive territory expansion, and identify new revenue streams within your customer base. You’ll know your portfolio inside-out and play a key role in shaping how we grow our enterprise presence in-market.

Cross-functional Leadership: You’ll work closely with Halter’s product, support, and sales teams to champion your accounts internally. Whether it’s surfacing product feedback, coordinating training, or aligning on rollout strategy, you’ll be the glue that holds enterprise relationships together and drives results.

Forecasting & Planning: Alongside the Enterprise Sales Manager, you’ll contribute to accurate revenue forecasting and strategic planning. You’ll bring rigour to account performance tracking and identify early signals of both risk and growth.

Scalable Growth Initiatives: You’ll help evolve how we support and grow our largest customers. From refining account management strategies to building scalable playbooks, you’ll be part of the team shaping what great looks like as Halter scales globally.

Who are we looking for.

Enterprise experience - You’ve managed large, complex accounts and know how to drive growth over time. You’re comfortable navigating executive rooms, operational teams, farm teams, multiple stakeholders, and matrixed business structures.

Customer centric - You’re relentlessly farmer-first: you anticipate needs, address problems early, and are accountable for continuously improving customer satisfaction.

Industry fluency - You bring real experience in dairy and beef production systems and know what success looks like on high performing dairy farms. You’re credible, informed, and customer-first.

Strong commercial instincts - You don’t just nurture relationships; you find value, expand accounts, and deliver results.

Team-first mindset - You collaborate across roles and functions to get the best outcome for the customer and the company.

Autonomy & pace - You’re happy working independently in a fast-changing environment. You solve problems proactively and adjust quickly.

Growth hunger - You’re looking to stretch yourself, take on more, and grow your career alongside a world-class commercial team.

Travel-ready - You’ll regularly be out with customers; being in the room, the paddock, or the boardroom when it counts. Expected travel up to 50% of the time.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to drive new and expansion revenue across a portfolio of large industrial manufacturers. You'll be responsible for winning new enterprise logos and growing existing customers from initial sites to multi-site, global deployments of the Litmus Industrial DataOps platform. You'll work closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing and our partner ecosystem to help manufacturers connect and put their OT data to work for analytics, AI and digital transformation.

This role will focus on a specific industry vertical (for example, life sciences, food & beverage/CPG, automotive, chemicals, or energy). The vertical has not yet been determined and will be aligned to your background and Litmus's go-to-market priorities.

This is a remote role based in the U.S. or Canada, reporting to the VP of Sales, North America, with up to 40% travel to customer sites, manufacturing plants and industry events.

What You’ll Do

· Build and execute a territory plan to win new enterprise accounts within your assigned industry vertical.

· Prospect into and build relationships with senior stakeholders across Manufacturing and Operations, Digital/Industry 4.0, OT/Automation, Engineering and IT.

· Run disciplined, multi-threaded sales cycles using MEDDICC, from discovery and business case through technical validation, pilot, procurement and close.

· Expand existing customers from initial plant or use-case deployments to multi-site and enterprise agreements, working with Customer Success to drive adoption and value.

· Build strategic account plans and mutual success plans, and lead executive business reviews with key accounts.

· Become Litmus's go-to expert in your vertical: learn its operational priorities, regulatory environment and buying dynamics, and bring a clear point of view to customers.

· Co-sell with system integrators, consulting firms and technology partners (automation, MES, cloud and data platforms) that serve your vertical.

· Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast in Salesforce and consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets.

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

· 4+ years of quota-carrying enterprise software sales experience, with a track record of closing complex, high-value deals.

· Experience selling into manufacturing or industrial organizations.

· Proven success both hunting new logos and expanding existing accounts in a land-and-expand model.

· Comfort engaging executive and plant-level stakeholders, and translating technical capabilities into business outcomes.

· Experience with a formal sales methodology (MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger or similar).

Nice to Have

· Deep experience or an existing network in a specific manufacturing vertical.

· Background in industrial software, IIoT, OT/IT, MES, historians, automation or manufacturing data and analytics.

· Familiarity with ISA-95, OPC UA and Unified Namespace (UNS) concepts.

· Experience co-selling with global system integrators and cloud/data platform partners.

jobs.description:
What We're Up To

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has over 1,900 markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. 

Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. 

Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. 

Building a new category is hard… like, really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

We’re looking for a seasoned, detail-oriented Technical Accountant to serve as a trusted expert on complex accounting issues and emerging business initiatives. You’ll lead the Company’s interpretation and application of U.S. GAAP, partner cross-functionally on high-impact projects, and ensure technical conclusions are accurate, well-reasoned, and thoroughly documented. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of accounting, strategy, and regulatory evolution, and who’s passionate about shaping accounting policy in a fast-growing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Accounting Leadership

Lead the accounting evaluation for complex and emerging business initiatives, collaborating across teams to identify, assess, and resolve technical issues

Develop well-supported conclusions and high-quality technical memos that stand up to audit and regulatory scrutiny

Serve as a primary liaison with external auditors on technical matters, ensuring transparency and constructive dialogue

Accounting Standards & Policy

Monitor and interpret new accounting guidance from the FASB and other standard-setting bodies, evaluating potential impacts on financial statements

Lead implementation efforts for new standards and ensure consistent application across teams

Develop, document, and maintain company-wide accounting policies, updating them as business operations and regulations evolve

Cross-Functional Partnership & Projects

Partner with Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Operations to ensure accounting considerations are integrated into business decisions

Support strategic initiatives and special projects, proactively identifying and addressing accounting implications.

Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes, documentation, and internal controls

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting and active CPA (or equivalent certification)

5+ years of experience in public accounting (Big 4 preferred) and/or technical accounting roles

Strong preference for experience in financial exchanges, clearing organizations, broker-dealers/FCMs, fintech, or high-growth technology environments

Deep knowledge of U.S. GAAP and ability to interpret, apply, and communicate evolving guidance across varied topics

Proven success influencing cross-functional teams and driving alignment across Accounting, Legal, Finance, and Compliance

Analytical, structured thinker with exceptional attention to detail and strong written and verbal communication skills

A lifelong learner passionate about technical accounting, regulatory change, and continuous improvement

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Salary Range: $100,000 to $180,000 annually plus equity and benefits.
This salary range is based on the current available market data, and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to further discuss.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

But today those are dozens of separate, transactional relationships. The opportunity in front of us is to invert that: to move from point solutions to one deepening relationship with each customer, where we understand them holistically across all of their concerns, help them navigate what to do, and let the individual treatments become secondary to the relationship itself.

That shift is what this role owns. It's a true 0-to-1 build, but not a cold start. You'll define a brand-new, relationship-first product experience that spans our existing categories and the new ones we create to support it, with everything we've already built as your foundation. Picture a concierge-style experience for the person who knows they don't feel their best, wants to feel better, and is looking for a trusted guide rather than another one-off transaction: lab testing, continuous care, and access to treatment, wrapped into one experience that compounds over time.

This is a rare seat. We're a company known for physical product and transactional care, making the leap to a sticky, engagement-driven, relationship-driven digital experience. Few established companies reach that moment, and fewer put a single person at the center of it. You'll work across the entire company to define what it looks like, and you'll do it on top of the AI infrastructure we're building, as someone who works that way themselves.

You Will:

Own the end-to-end consumer experience for this new relationship-first offering, from discovery and onboarding through ongoing engagement

Define the synthesis layer across our existing categories, and stand up the new product lines the offering needs

Partner with engineering and design to build AI into the core of the consumer experience

Partner with our clinical teams so protocols, safety, and education are core to the product experience

Shape short- and long-term roadmaps, driving long-term scalability while balancing day-to-day improvements

Operate with focus in a fast-growing, constantly evolving environment, where there are always more opportunities than resources

You Have:

6+ years of product management experience, working collaboratively across cross-functional teams

A track record of building and shipping consumer products that customers love and that drive meaningful business impact

A strong, specific point of view on where AI can meaningfully reshape the consumer healthcare experience, and the excitement to build it into the core of the product

Fluency with AI agents and AI-native workflows. AI-native is your default operating mode: you work with agents the way most PMs work with docs, fluently and constantly

Strategic and tactical range: you can set the vision and also design and execute scalable processes from scratch, ideally in an operations-intensive environment

Strong communication and a low-ego, high-EQ style. You build alignment, partner well across functions, and bring people with you. This is a fully remote role, so clear written communication and proactive collaboration matter

Bonus: experience in health, wellness, or category-defining 0-to-1 products

jobs.description:
The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Actuarial is at the center of some of Clover's most important decisions—from pricing and forecasting to reserving, medical economics, and long-term strategy. As Chief Actuary, you'll lead and evolve this function during a pivotal stage of the company's growth, helping shape how we deploy AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve decision-making across the business. 

This isn't a traditional Chief Actuary role. We're looking for someone who can combine deep actuarial expertise with modern technology, building AI-enabled workflows that transform how actuarial work gets done while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and governance required in a highly regulated environment. You'll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Clinical, Growth, Operations, and Product to influence company strategy while building a best-in-class actuarial organization.

As a Chief Actuary, you will:

Lead Clover's enterprise actuarial function, including pricing, forecasting, reserving, medical economics, Part D, Stars analytics, and bid strategy.

Establish the long-term vision for actuarial, modernizing the function through AI, automation, and scalable analytical infrastructure. 

 Build AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and improve actuarial decision-making while ensuring explainability, governance, and regulatory compliance.

Lead the annual Medicare Advantage bid strategy and pricing process, framing tradeoffs among growth, competitiveness, margin, risk, and capital requirements to support enterprise planning and executive decision-making.

Assume responsibility for actuarial opinions, reserve adequacy, and related regulatory actuarial requirements, including transitioning responsibilities currently supported by external actuarial partners.

Guide reserving methodology, IBNR development, forecasting, and emerging experience analysis to provide timely, reliable financial insights.

Partner with Finance leadership to strengthen forecasting, planning, capital management, and enterprise performance measurement.

Collaborate with Medical Economics to identify healthcare cost trends, evaluate interventions, and develop strategies that improve member outcomes while managing medical expense. 

 Drive adoption of modern analytics tools and AI capabilities across the actuarial organization, helping the team operate faster, smarter, and with greater transparency.

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex actuarial concepts into clear business recommendations. 

Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing actuarial organization, including organizational design, performance management, workforce capacity, and development of actuarial and analytical talent.

Build strong partnerships across Finance, Clinical, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure actuarial insights are embedded in strategic decision-making.

Establish and maintain actuarial governance, model review, documentation, control, and validation standards that support regulatory compliance, financial integrity, and sound executive decision-making.

Success in this role looks like:

First 90 Days

Build trusted relationships across Finance and key business partners. 

 Assess the current actuarial organization, tools, and operating model.

Develop a roadmap for AI adoption and workflow automation across the actuarial function.

Gain deep familiarity with Clover's pricing, forecasting, reserving, and medical economics processes.

First 6 Months

Begin implementing AI-enabled actuarial workflows that improve efficiency and insight generation.

Strengthen forecasting, reserving, and bid processes through improved automation and cross-functional collaboration.

Successfully assume ownership of additional actuarial responsibilities, including reserve oversight and governance.

Establish a clear long-term organizational vision for the actuarial function.

Long Term

Build one of the industry's most modern actuarial organizations by combining deep actuarial science with AI-enabled decision support.

Improve forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and enterprise decision-making through advanced analytics and automation.

Develop a highly engaged, high-performing actuarial team that is recognized as a strategic partner across the organization.

You should get in touch if:

You are a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) and a Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.

You have significant leadership experience in Medicare Advantage actuarial functions, including pricing, reserving, forecasting, and bid development.

You are an AI evangelist and have demonstrated experience deploying AI workflows across your functional areas. Moreover, you are enthusiastic about applying automation and modern tooling to fundamentally improve the actuarial function.

You have experience leading large, cross-functional initiatives that influence executive decision-making.

You are equally comfortable discussing actuarial methodology with technical experts and communicating business implications to executives and non-technical stakeholders. 

You have a track record of building, mentoring, and developing high-performing actuarial teams.

You thrive in fast-moving environments where you can build, innovate, and shape the future of an organization.

Benefits Overview: 

Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. 

Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities

Reimbursement for office setup expenses

Monthly cell phone & internet stipend

Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams

Paid parental leave for all new parents

And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

#LI-REMOTE

$274,000—$356,000 USD
