jobs.description:
Help Build the Next Chapter of Product Development at Fresh Prints

Hi, I’m Andy, the Product Development Manager at Fresh Prints.

Before Fresh Prints, I spent five years with a national fashion retail group in the Philippines, working my way from graphic designer to creative lead. When I joined Fresh Prints as a graphic designer in September 2024, I wanted to focus on designing again. Building a department wasn’t exactly the plan.

I was thrown into it pretty quickly. I’d expected to be designing email newsletters. Within my first month, I was in China meeting manufacturers and sourcing fabrics. Soon after, I became the first dedicated person in Product Development, figuring out how to build the function from the ground up.

Fresh Prints already had successful garments, but there was no established playbook for the department. I worked across Creative and Logistics, built our tech pack template, mapped development timelines, and brought in technical support. Together with the wider team, we expanded beyond a single supplier and launched products like our mock neck, which has sold over 40,000 units in less than two years.

I also had to learn what American college students wanted. Through our Fashion Council conversations, I learned to push past “that’s cute.” Was it the fit, fabric, or color? Would they actually buy it? Those answers shaped our products. Clear specs, careful sample reviews, and consistent follow-through helped bring them to life.

That’s what I value about working here. You can question a process, propose something better, and take responsibility for making it happen. My role grew because there was room to contribute beyond what I was hired to do.

Now, we’re looking for a Product Development Associate who enjoys the technical side of bringing garments to life. Someone who cares about the details, catches inconsistencies, and thinks about how their work affects the next person in the process:

Can a supplier follow these specs without guessing?

Do the sample, tech pack, art proof, and website information agree?

What needs to be resolved before this moves into production?

If you enjoy solving problems, getting the details right, and seeing your work become something people wear, I’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

You’ll work closely with our Product Development Team Lead to turn product ideas and revisions into clear, accurate technical information. Your day-to-day work will include:

Create and update tech packs for assigned new products, existing garment revisions, and Collab or client requests, including measurements, construction details, and fabric specifications.

Review samples and document feedback, including QA findings, technical issues, and required revisions.

Check art proofs and briefs for garment accuracy, print compatibility, and production limitations.

Support supplier development by preparing technical specifications, reviewing supplier submissions, and coordinating follow-ups with suppliers and internal teams.

Keep product information accurate across technical records and website descriptions, specifications, colorways, and imagery.

Support new product development through tasks assigned by the Team Lead, flagging missing information, discrepancies, and potential production issues.

Your focus is to make sure other teams have complete, accurate product information they can confidently use.

Key Skills & Personal Attributes:

Commercial awareness and ability to execute within defined brand and market direction.

Advanced Adobe Illustrator skills (print design + garment CADs).

Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop.

Strong understanding of garment construction, materials, and fit.

Confident English communication for factory and cross-team coordination.

Highly detail-oriented with strong ownership of documentation and QA accuracy.

Qualifications: 

3 to 5 years of experience in fashion design, apparel technical design, or product development.

Proven experience creating prints, CADs, and production-ready tech packs for apparel.

Experience communicating with manufacturers and managing sampling revisions.

Portfolio showcasing printed garments and technical design work (CADs + tech packs required).

Strong organization skills with clear production and timeline awareness.

Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Design, or a related field preferred.

Job Location: Work From Home / Remote

Working Hours: 4:00 PM - 12:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday to Friday 

Monthly Salary: $700 - $900 (adjusted for experience) + $40 Night Shift Allowance

At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees.

Fresh Prints never charges any money during the hiring process. If you’re asked to pay for a job, it’s not real.

Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity; actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ+, and those with disabilities to apply.

jobs.description:
About Karbon

Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well-funded, ranked #1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List.

We are hiring a Senior Manager of Revenue Operations Systems to lead the team that owns Salesforce across Sales, Marketing, and the Customer organization, and to own the technology stack that powers our sales team. This person sets the architecture and standards for our core GTM platform, runs the team's intake and allocation, and makes sure every tool we pay for earns its place.

This is a player-coach role. Expect roughly half your time building: designing solutions, shipping complex configuration, and reviewing the architecture your team delivers. The other half goes to leading a team of three Revenue Operations Analysts, managing the team's workload, and partnering with GTM leaders so the right work gets done in the right order. We are looking for someone who is the most capable technical operator in the room and gets real energy from making the people around them better. As the function grows, so will the scope of this role.

Karbon is building an agentic organization. Every role here is expected to operate with an AI-first mindset, and this role carries a specific expectation: grow your team's capacity faster than its headcount. The rest of this JD describes what that looks like for Salesforce and the sales technology stack.

About the Role

Salesforce Platform Leadership

Own Salesforce as the core GTM platform for Sales, Marketing, and the Customer organization, including the data model, lifecycle automation, sharing and security model, and release management. Set the platform standards and architecture principles your team builds to

Design and ship solutions end to end, from complex flows and record types to integrations. Review and approve architectural changes from your team and others, and hold a high bar on quality, documentation, and change management

Architect how Salesforce connects to the rest of the GTM stack. Own integration patterns (native, middleware, event-driven) and know when to use each. Build with observability in mind so issues are caught before the business feels them

Partner with the Senior Manager of Marketing Operations on the data flow between marketing systems and Salesforce, including campaign sync, lead and contact routing, and attribution field architecture

Sales Technology Stack

Own the sales technology stack, including sales engagement, conversation intelligence, data enrichment, and quoting tools, along with the integrations that connect them to Salesforce. Run vendor evaluations, implementations, renewals, and consolidation analyses

Keep technology aligned to how Sales, Marketing, and the Customer organization work. Stay close enough to each team to understand their workflows, translate their needs into the right systems decisions, and say no when a new tool is not the answer

Make build vs. buy vs. automate decisions with business-case rigor. Identify redundancies, integration gaps, and where AI can remove manual work across the stack. The expectation is to continuously improve how the sales organization is enabled by technology, not just maintain what we have

Maintain the tech stack inventory, ownership, and renewal calendar for your domain so leadership and Finance always know what we use, what it costs, who owns it, and what it returns

Data Quality & Governance

Own data governance for the Salesforce platform: field definitions and ownership, stage gate enforcement, validation, and dashboard accuracy. Every field has a definition and an owner, and the numbers leaders see can be trusted

Run the change management and release process that keeps Salesforce stable as it scales. Enforce scope and intake boundaries without needing escalation

Surface issues before they are reported. Connect symptoms to root causes across systems, and frame findings in terms of revenue impact and a proposed action

Team Leadership & Workload Management

Lead and develop a team of three Revenue Operations Analysts: two focused on Salesforce and connected tools, and one supporting the Customer organization (customer success, service delivery, and support). Coach through weekly 1:1s and semi-annual reviews, build development plans tailored to each person, and grow people into bigger scope

Own the performance process for your team: goal setting, mid-year and annual reviews, calibration, and merit and promotion cases. Address underperformance early and directly

Own intake, prioritization, and allocation for the team. Publish the queue, manage to defined SLAs, and make the Now/Next/Later call with the Director of Revenue Operations as a partner. Push back on low-ROI work and reallocate toward the highest-leverage activity

Run capacity planning for your team. Every headcount ask is justified through the agentic lens: what AI has already taken on, what still needs a person, and why. Design AI-augmented workflows as the default for new work and teach your team to do the same

Own hiring for your team as roles open: write the JD, run the interview loop, and build onboarding that gets new hires productive quickly

Codify tribal knowledge into documented processes and runbooks. Remove single points of failure on the team, including yourself

Cross-Functional Partnership

Be a trusted partner to Sales, Marketing, and Customer leaders at the Director and VP level. Translate their questions into the systems and data changes that answer them, and communicate in business terms

Own the roadmap for Salesforce and the sales technology stack, and sequence it against the GTM plan. Present priorities and progress to GTM leadership monthly

Lead multi-quarter, cross-functional initiatives end to end. Keep stakeholders informed before they have to ask, and never surprise anyone on delivery

About You!

8+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Salesforce administration in a B2B SaaS environment, including at least 2 years leading a team. You are as comfortable building a complex flow yourself as you are walking the CRO through the roadmap

Deep Salesforce expertise. You have personally built and scaled Salesforce at a growing company and understand the architecture beneath the UI: data model, sharing and security, automation, APIs, and release management. Experience supporting post-sale teams in Salesforce is a strong plus

Cross-platform breadth. You have owned Salesforce alongside at least three integrated GTM platforms (e.g., sales engagement, conversation intelligence, marketing automation, data enrichment, CPQ) and can speak to how data moves between them

A track record of owning a tech stack. You have run evaluations, implementations, renewals, and consolidations, and can point to tools you added, tools you cut, and why

A people leader who grows people. You have coached analysts or admins into bigger scope, handled hard performance conversations with clarity, and managed a shared queue with competing priorities from multiple teams

Revenue literacy. You understand the full revenue engine, from new business to expansion, retention, and churn, and you prioritize by revenue impact. You can defend why one request matters more than another in terms a revenue leader accepts

Operational rigor with architectural thinking. You balance urgency in fixing what is broken today with a clear vision for what the system needs to look like at 2x and 5x scale

An AI-first operator. You are using AI in your work today, you have shipped AI-assisted workflows that expanded real capacity, and you have a point of view on how AI reshapes Revenue Operations

Clear, direct communicator. Tight for executives, detailed for peers, and willing to push back when the work calls for it

Experience in accounting, professional services, or practice management software is a plus but not required

Why Work at Karbon?

Industry-leading benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and up to three eligible dependents. Also:

Work-from-home allowance

Rice subsidy

Meal allowance per working day

Laundry allowance

15 paid time off days per year (which includes 5 Karbon Days per year)

7 Sick leave days per year

Internet and work-from-home subsidy

Discretionary bonus program

Work with (and learn from) a very experienced team

Be part of a startup team that will continue to grow around you

Flexible approach to work environment (we believe in trust and autonomy)

A culture of open communication, consistent feedback, and full transparency into company results, metrics, and financial position

Please be aware that Karbon will only contact you via email from our domain, karbonhq.com. If you receive an email from any other domain, please do not click any of those links.

Karbon embraces diversity and inclusion, aligning with our values as a business. Research has shown that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single criteria. If you've made it this far in the job description but your past experience doesn't perfectly align, we do encourage you to still apply. You could still be the right person for the role!

We recruit and reward people based on capability and a performance-driven mindset. We do not discriminate based on race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lifestyle, age, educational background, national origin, religion, physical or cognitive ability, and other diversity dimensions that may hinder inclusion in the organization.

If there are any adjustments or accommodations that we can make to assist you during the recruitment process and your journey at Karbon, contact us at people.support@karbonhq.com for a confidential discussion. Please note that, due to the volume, emails sent to this email address that are not for adjustments or accommodations will not receive a response.

At this time, we request that agency referrals are not submitted for this position. We appreciate your understanding and encourage direct applications from interested candidates. Thank you!

Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

The role

MetaMask is launching a VIP programme. As the China Relationship Manager, you will own MetaMask's relationships with Mandarin speaking high value users across Trade and Money lanes.

What you will own

Recruiting, onboarding and retaining high value users across Mainland China/ Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Singapore.

Building relationships across Mandarin speaking traders and users, community networks, including industry networks, referrals, events and inbound interest.

Acting as each high value user's main point of contact, and bringing in relevant teams when needed.

jobs.description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a resourceful, ambitious, and autonomous Account Executive, preferably with a strong understanding of SaaS or Payments, eager to contribute to ambitious growth plans in the APAC region. This is an exciting time for you to join: based on the size and breadth of our customers, we are growing like never before!

Reporting to the VP of Sales, APAC, working alongside a second Senior Account Executive and a Senior Solutions Engineer as the founding regional commercial team.

Paddle is establishing its first dedicated APAC sales organisation. The region has an existing customer base and commercial momentum, but historically relied on international sales coverage, primarily from EMEA.

This is an early market-building role rather than an established territory position. The Senior AE will own inbound and outbound opportunities across APAC, develop new pipeline, close business and contribute insights that shape our regional strategy.

What you'll do: 

Build pipeline from leads armed by your Business Development Representative and Marketing counterparts, as well as your own self-sourced opportunities’

You will be responsible for creating a portion of your own self generated pipeline opportunities

Be responsible for the full sales cycle from prospecting, qualifying, carrying out demo’s through to closing deals

Master Paddle’s product, know the features inside and out, understand the industry and be able to articulate Paddle’s value to CTO’s, Heads of Product and CEO’s alike.

Work with management and across departments (Marketing, Product, Success, etc.) to determine the most effective approach for each sales opportunity.

Identify flaws in both Paddle's and our competitors' product during the sales process, helping to inform our sales techniques and product roadmap.

Learn and refine new sales skills with regular Account Executive sales training sessions and continuously learn and develop yourself as a thought leader in the industry.

Mentor new Account Executives as they ramp and learn the process

We'd love to hear from you:

Have extensive closing experience in a software or SaaS business, managing multi-threaded sales processes and enterprise deals

Have experience with consultative, value-based selling and a proven track record of exceeding your quota

Have experience selling highly technical products/services

Are great at liaising with prospective clients in person, over the phone and email.

Have an entrepreneurial attitude which thrives when solving complex challenges and you want to be part of an exceptionally fast-growing company

It would be great if…

You have experience in the payments space or selling B2B SaaS.

Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/software company.

Experience selling to technical persons, (CTO, Head of Product, (Technical) Founders).

You’re familiar with eCommerce providers such as Stripe, Braintree, PayPal, Cleverbridge and subscription based services such as Chargebee, Zuora, Recurly.

Able to operate in an unstructured, self-starting environment.

Ideally fluent in Mandarin and English

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

Paddle for others

Paddle together

Paddle simply

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview 

As a Key Partner Executive, you own some of Rithum’s most strategic and high-value partner relationships within one of our partner pillars—Marketplaces, Technology/Accelerators. You define and execute long-term partner strategies, build executive relationships, develop complex commercial opportunities, and align cross-functional resources to maximize partnership value. As a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert within your assigned pillar, you independently navigate complex commercial and organizational dynamics and influence broader partner strategy and practices.

At Rithum, all team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance.

Partner Strategy & Relationship Management

Own the strategy and commercial relationship for a portfolio of Rithum’s highest-value partners within the pillar assigned to the role—Marketplaces, Technology, or Accelerators.

Develop long-term partnership strategies aligned to Rithum’s priorities, partner objectives, and evolving market opportunities.

Build trusted relationships with senior and executive partner stakeholders.

Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning discussions focused on growth, innovation, and long-term partnership value.

Anticipate partner, market, and competitive risks and develop strategies to protect and expand key relationships.

Pipeline & Commercial Growth

Drive significant partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, revenue, adoption, and expansion opportunities.

Identify new business models, partnership structures, and market opportunities that expand Rithum’s reach and competitive position.

Lead or influence complex commercial negotiations and strategic partnership opportunities.

Cross-Functional & Executive Influence

Translate partner insights, market dynamics, and commercial opportunities into strategic recommendations for senior leaders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Client teams, and other functions.

Navigate complex dependencies, competing priorities, and organizational dynamics across Rithum and partner organizations.

Represent Rithum with senior and executive partner stakeholders on strategic and complex commercial matters.

AI, Data & Operational Excellence

Use data to evaluate partner performance, commercial potential, investment priorities, risks, and growth opportunities.

Establish disciplined approaches to pipeline management, partner attribution, forecasting, and strategic account governance.

Develop scalable practices and tools that improve how Rithum develops and manages strategic partnerships.

Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.

At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

About Standard Bots

Standard Bots is America's largest manufacturer of AI-native industrial robots. Full-stack robots—hardware, software, and AI—all designed and assembled in Glen Cove, New York. The company makes AI-native robots anyone can buy and deploy, with customers ranging from family-owned machine shops to the Fortune 500. Customers include Sunoco, Lockheed Martin, NASA, and the U.S. Army, along with hundreds of manufacturers nationwide. Standard Bots raised a $200 million Series C at a $1 billion valuation from RoboStrategy, General Catalyst, Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, and Samsung Next.

About the role

Fabricators across the country can't hire enough welders, and you know it better than most, because you've run a torch yourself. As our Welding Sales Manager, you'll show shops what cobot welding does for their throughput, quality, and people, and you'll own the national welding number. Welding is one of our fastest-growing applications, and you'll be the person who helps it grow even faster.

📍 Location

This role is remote within the United States, and we prefer candidates in NYC metro, North Carolina, California, Illinois or Texas. Expect to travel frequently to customer sites, regional teams, trade shows, and partners (~50% domestic travel).

What you'll do

- Own the welding number. You carry the national quota for welding systems and revenue across direct and partner sales. You build and manage the welding pipeline and forecast with each region, and you measure success by installed, producing systems, not just bookings.

- Partner with Regional Sales Managers. You co-sell welding opportunities with RSMs in every territory, from discovery through close. That means welding-specific discovery, part and joint reviews, and ROI conversations with fabricators. You'll join customer site visits, demos, and weld trials alongside our Welding Applications Engineers, and you'll raise the welding knowledge of the broader sales team through training, deal reviews, and ride-alongs.

- Sell direct MIG welding systems. You help shops evaluate cobot MIG welding against their part mix, volumes, and labor constraints, and you lead the proposals, pricing, and negotiation on welding deals.

- Build the partner channel. You recruit and manage gas and welding distributors as a lead source for Standard Bots welding. You also support partner-built solutions, such as laser welding cells, from the first conversation to repeatable sales.

- Be the voice of the welding customer. You bring field feedback on ease of use, features, and competitive gaps to the welding product team, and you represent Standard Bots at welding and fabrication trade shows and industry events.

What you'll bring

- Hands-on welding experience. You've laid beads and you know what a good weld looks like. MIG is required; TIG or laser is a plus.

- 5+ years in welding sales or welding applications, ideally robotic or automated welding.

- A track record of closing capital equipment deals with manufacturers and fabricators.

- Comfort working as an individual contributor who leads through influence across regional sales teams.

- Willingness to travel frequently to customer sites, trade shows, and partner meetings.

Nice to have

- Experience with a welding OEM, welding distributor, or robotic welding integrator.

- Existing relationships with gas and welding distributors.

- AWS certification (CW, CWI, or similar).

- Experience building or managing a channel partner program.

Compensation and Benefits

The on target earnings (OTE) range for this role is $190,000 - $225,000, depending on experience. We are open to a variety of seniority levels for this role and will build compensation packages that are commensurate with seniority and skill level. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

R/GA is a global digital innovation agency specializing in digital product development, brand transformation, media, and communications for major companies. We are on a mission to help companies grow by enabling them to change, across their business, the experience they offer and the campaigns that take them to market. 

Our work tends to be a fusion of what we call Stories and Systems: the narrative and the design, technology and the interface working together. R/GA is a brand but it's also a collective of atypical outsiders and misfits who drive everything we do through bold creativity and bright, strategic thinking.

About the role

Our Designers are makers and storytellers that use design to bring ideas to life. They lead projects into uncharted creative territories and create new outcomes. They design fundamentalists, but approach projects with a systems and stories mindset. They identify user needs, interpret client challenges, create innovative concepts and define visual language.

We are looking for a Visual Designer to join the R/GA Marketing and Communications team. This person will play an integral role in how R/GA is shown to the world, designing everything from the content. Right down to quarterly reports and data visualizations for proprietary thought leadership. They will work closely with the brand marketing team, including the senior visual designer, to define R/GA's visual identity across owned channels and guide the implementation and evolution of our external and internal branding.

Define concepts and visual narratives that are grounded in strategy and culture.

Create designs such as user interface, layouts, brand identity and iconography to a high standard

Define art direction and evolve existing visual centers and guidelines

jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Engineer (Cyber), you will research, engineer, analyze, and actively collect cyber threat intelligence to protect CoreWeave’s global cloud infrastructure, AI platform, and internal systems. You will operate at the boundary between threat intelligence, threat hunting, and adversary tradecraft, with a mandate to go beyond passive analysis and materially shape how CoreWeave detects, understands, and disrupts real-world attackers.

This role is designed for practitioners who not only study adversaries, but actively probe, instrument, and test their behaviors—building intelligence through direct observation, telemetry-driven hunting, and controlled exposure (e.g., honeypots, canary systems, sinkholes, or deception techniques).

You will bring deep expertise in adversary behavior, exploitation techniques, and attack campaigns, and translate that knowledge into intelligence-driven detections, proactive threat hunts, and durable defensive improvements. You will have significant autonomy to pursue high-impact research, develop novel intelligence collection approaches, and ensure intelligence is operationalized across detection engineering, incident response, and cloud security.

Key Responsibilities

Research, track, and actively investigate cyber threat actors, campaigns, tooling, infrastructure, and TTPs relevant to CoreWeave’s threat landscape.

Design and operate advanced intelligence collection mechanisms, including controlled exposure systems (e.g., honeypots, canaries, decoys, or instrumentation) to observe adversary behavior in the wild.

Identify, evaluate, and manage intelligence sources across OSINT, commercial feeds, community sharing, and internally generated telemetry, with a focus on signal quality and adversary relevance.

Translate threat intelligence into durable detection logic, analytics, and intelligence-driven threat hunting hypotheses across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud telemetry.

Lead and execute proactive threat hunts informed by intelligence gaps, emerging adversary tradecraft, and novel attack patterns.

Analyze security incidents, suspicious activity, and hunt results to uncover campaign-level patterns, attacker objectives, and systemic defensive weaknesses.

Develop original intelligence products, including adversary profiles, campaign analyses, intrusion narratives, and forward-looking threat assessments.

Automate enrichment, correlation, and analysis workflows to embed threat intelligence directly into detection, response, and engineering pipelines.

Partner closely with detection engineering, incident response, cloud security, and platform teams to close the loop between intelligence, hunting, and prevention.

Establish and own technical standards, architectural patterns, and best practices for intelligence-led detection, hunting, and adversary analysis.

Contribute to the evolution of CoreWeave’s threat intelligence strategy by identifying opportunities to push beyond traditional CTI models.

Qualifications

8–10 years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, threat hunting, detection engineering, security research, or adjacent disciplines.

Deep understanding of adversary behavior and tradecraft, including exploitation techniques, lateral movement, persistence mechanisms, and infrastructure usage.

Demonstrated experience moving from intelligence → hypothesis → hunt → detection → feedback.

Hands-on experience developing detections or hunts using SIEM, EDR, cloud security, identity, or network telemetry.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex technical findings into clear, actionable intelligence.

Proven ability to work independently, exercise strong judgment, and operate effectively in ambiguous, rapidly evolving threat environments.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior technical and security leadership.

Preferred Skills

Experience building or operating honeypots, canary systems, sinkholes, deception platforms, or custom telemetry pipelines.

Background in threat hunting, red teaming, malware analysis, exploit development, or security research.

Experience securing cloud-native, large-scale, or hyperscale infrastructure.

Proficiency with scripting and data analysis (Python, SQL, APIs).

Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, intrusion lifecycle modeling, and intelligence frameworks.

Experience integrating threat intelligence platforms (TIPs) or building custom intelligence enrichment and correlation pipelines.

Relevant certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCED, GCIH, CTIA) are a plus.

jobs.description:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

ABOUT THE ROLE

iFIT is building its next generation subscription product, and the Growth Product Leader owns the funnel. You are accountable for every step between a new visitor and a paying, retained member: activation, onboarding, trial to paid, free to paid, referral and viral growth, and in product save flows. You lead a small team of product managers and analysts and run the Growth lane of the single product backlog.

You report to the Head of Product and partner daily with the Chief Subscription Officer on offer economics, with Marketing on acquisition, with Retention on save flows, with Design on growth surfaces, and with Analytics, who hold the experiment gate.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Paywall and plan surfaces. Own the paywall and plan presentation surfaces. Pricing, plans, and packaging remain with the CSO.

Trial to paid and free to paid. Decide the product experience that converts trials and free users to paid members. Work with the CSO, who sets offer economics and pricing, and with Retention on offer strategy.

Paid subscriber Conversion. Own the number of visitors, trial users, and free users who become paid subscribers. Set the targets, decide the experience from first session to checkout, and run the experiments that lift conversion.

Activation and onboarding. Decide the activation and onboarding experience and own onboarding conversion.

Referral growth. Make the final call on referral and viral growth mechanics.

Product led growth. Own product led acquisition strategy and the product levers behind organic and App Store growth. Marketing decides overall acquisition, paid, and brand. You decide the product experience.

In product save flows. Own churn related in product save flows and the lifecycle programs they feed, in partnership with the Head of Retention, who owns the retention number.

Growth roadmap and experimentation. Own the Growth roadmap, PRDs, and backlog lane. Run Growth A/B tests through the Analytics experiment gate, where no test ships without methodology sign off.

Partner driven acquisition. Own the product experience of partner driven acquisition, working with the Partner Product Leader.

HOW YOU DECIDE

Decides - Activation, onboarding conversion, trial to paid, free to paid, referral growth, and the Growth roadmap and PRDs, paid subscriber conversion.

Consulted on - Paid acquisition, Core engagement features, retention lifecycle programs, design system standards, and UX research.

Measured by - Analytics, which owns KPI definitions, cohorts, and LTV and CAC.

Does not own - Pricing and offer economics (CSO). Overall acquisition, paid, and brand (Marketing). The retention number (Retention). Engagement outcomes (Core).

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Substantial revenue and subscriber growth.

Efficient marketing funnel driven by the product.

Building the #1 app in Fitness

Best in class onboarding conversion, activation rate, trial and paid conversion, CAC, and save rate.

A steady, well run experiment cadence with documented learnings and clear readouts.

WHAT YOU BRING

8 or more years in product, with 3 or more years leading growth for a consumer subscription or mobile product. Senior Director candidates bring 12 or more years and experience leading multiple teams.

Proven record of moving funnel metrics through experimentation: onboarding, paywall, trial, and conversion.

Strong command of subscription metrics: LTV, CAC, cohort retention, and conversion funnels.

Experience managing and developing product managers and working closely with analysts.

Skill working across Marketing, Design, Engineering, and Retention without owning their budgets or roadmaps.

Direct communication and a bias for shipping, measuring, and iterating.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience in fitness, health, wellness, or content driven consumer products.

Experience with AI driven personalization in onboarding or conversion.

Experience with referral programs, partner distribution, or App Store optimization.

Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status.

Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Engineer focused on Actor Analysis, you will investigate the cyber adversaries relevant to CoreWeave’s global cloud infrastructure, AI platform, and corporate environment. You will develop a detailed understanding of their objectives, capabilities, targeting patterns, infrastructure, and operational behavior, and assess how their activities could affect CoreWeave.

You will be part of CoreWeave’s defensive security operations team, working alongside threat hunters, detection engineers, incident responders, and other security engineers. You will conduct original research using external intelligence, technical artifacts, and internal telemetry, and apply your findings to active investigations, hunt hypotheses, deception capabilities, vulnerability prioritization, and detection improvements. Your research priorities will be driven by operational needs and gaps in our understanding of adversaries. Success means helping the security team identify threats, make better defensive decisions, and respond effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain sustained coverage of priority cyber threat actors, including state-sponsored groups and cybercriminal organizations, tracking changes in their objectives, capabilities, targeting, and tradecraft relevant to CoreWeave.

Investigate adversary campaigns and intrusion activity to reconstruct operational timelines, identify attacker objectives, and assess implications for CoreWeave’s infrastructure, technologies, and business.

Research adversary infrastructure, tooling, malware, and operational patterns. Correlate technical artifacts and behaviors across external reporting, internal investigations, and telemetry to identify relationships between activity clusters and campaigns.

Develop and test hypotheses about actor relationships and attribution, accounting for shared infrastructure, commonly used tools, and alternative explanations. Clearly communicate supporting evidence, uncertainty, and confidence.

Produce actor profiles, campaign assessments, and intrusion analyses that help security teams make specific defensive decisions. Explain likely adversary actions, relevant attack paths, and opportunities to improve defenses.

Define intelligence requirements and collection gaps for priority actors in partnership with security teams. Pursue relevant information through open sources, commercial intelligence, research communities, and internal telemetry.

Support active investigations with Incident Response and Detection and Response, providing adversary context, investigative pivots, and assessments of campaign connections to inform triage, incident scope, and response decisions.

Develop actor-specific hunt hypotheses and participate in hunts with security partners. Translate observed behaviors into detection requirements and help detection engineers validate coverage against relevant adversary techniques.

Partner with security engineers to develop deception capabilities informed by actor targeting and tradecraft. Analyze activity from honeypots, canaries, decoys, and other instrumentation to refine actor assessments and identify new collection opportunities.

Assess observed exploitation and actor capabilities against CoreWeave’s technologies and exposure. Support vulnerability management by identifying adversary-relevant vulnerabilities and attack paths that warrant remediation priority.

Develop scripts and analytical workflows to enrich artifacts, track infrastructure, and correlate activity. Maintain actor relationships and supporting evidence in the threat intelligence platform, incorporating findings from defensive operations into ongoing research.

Qualifications: 

8–10 years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, security research, incident investigation, threat hunting, or related disciplines, with substantial experience conducting threat actor and campaign analysis.

Deep expertise in at least one cyber threat actor set, such as Chinese, Russian, Iranian, North Korean, or cybercriminal actors, demonstrated through sustained analysis of their campaigns, targeting, tradecraft, and infrastructure.

Demonstrated ability to produce original adversary research from technical evidence and multiple intelligence sources.

Deep understanding of adversary tradecraft, including initial access, credential theft, persistence, lateral movement, command and control, and infrastructure use.

Experience correlating intrusion activity, infrastructure, tooling, and targeting patterns to evaluate campaign relationships and attribution hypotheses.

Hands-on experience querying and analyzing endpoint, network, identity, or cloud telemetry to investigate adversary activity.

Demonstrated experience applying actor research to threat hunting, deception, vulnerability prioritization, detection engineering, or incident response, with concrete examples of resulting defensive improvements.

Strong analytical judgment, including source evaluation, consideration of competing hypotheses, and clear expression of uncertainty and confidence. Ability to explain technical findings and their operational implications to security teams and leadership.

Ability to independently manage actor research while adjusting priorities to support investigations, emerging threats, and other defensive requirements.

Preferred Skills:

Experience analyzing threats involving Linux, Kubernetes, cloud control planes, identity systems, or software supply chains.

Background in malware analysis, digital forensics, network analysis, or incident response.

Experience researching adversary infrastructure using passive DNS, certificate data, domain registration records, or other technical datasets.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Our team is small relative to our impact, and we believe our user success is our success (not the inverse). A team member summarized: “Roboflow is a company full of giant brains and tiny egos.” We find software has a multiplier effect on all roles (not only product and engineering), so Roboflow employs developers across the company in design, sales, customer support, marketing, and beyond.

We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

What You'll Do

We’re hiring a GTM Systems Engineer to build and scale the systems our revenue team runs on, reporting into the Revenue Operations lead and working hand-in-hand with sales leadership, finance, marketing, and data engineering. Revenue Operations owns the operating system for go-to-market at Roboflow: how pipeline is measured, how the forecast is built, how territories and account handoffs work, and whether the numbers can be trusted. This role is hands-on and execution-focused: you’ll implement, customize, and scale Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack (Outreach, enrichment platforms, and more), while also building custom tooling and AI-powered workflows where off-the-shelf solutions fall short.

You’ll start by building under the direction of the Revenue Operations team and grow into ownership of our Salesforce architecture as the function scales. As our sales team grows, the systems you ship will shape how quickly new reps ramp, how accurately we forecast, and how cleanly accounts move from a first land to enterprise-wide expansion. You’ll partner closely with sales stakeholders, ops, and engineering to turn requirements into shipped solutions.

Build and extend Salesforce functionality (Apex, LWC, Flows, custom objects), turning Revenue Operations designs into working, tested, source-controlled systems

Implement the data models behind how we sell: account hierarchies and site-level data, product catalog and packaging, territory and coverage assignment, and account handoffs between sales teams

Build the inputs and enforcement behind our forecasting models: stage exit criteria and stage gates, forecast categories, pipeline snapshots, and the field history needed to track forecast accuracy over time

Partner with data engineering on programmatic BI: SQL and BigQuery, code-defined dashboards on Salesforce data, and native Salesforce reports, templates, and folder/permission structures as the self-service layer for end users

Own data quality across Salesforce and connected GTM systems, including deduplication, field standardization, ownership cleanup, and the cleanup views that show each rep what to fix and why it matters

Lead integration and data pipeline work across the GTM stack, including migrations as we retire and replace tools

Build the infrastructure for partner and cloud marketplace revenue: deal registration, sourced vs. influenced attribution, and reporting the whole team trusts

Facilitate the variable compensation program by providing data quality and management support

Serve as the control point for AI agents in our GTM stack (permissions, access, and rollout), and design and deploy AI- and LLM-powered GTM workflows yourself

Share end user support with the rest of the team, including lead routing and assignment troubleshooting, round-robin logic, SLA misses, and bulk list uploads for marketing campaigns and sales prospecting

Who You Are

You are a systems builder with strong GTM instincts who wants to be an important part of an exceptional team that focuses on using Roboflow's computer vision tools to impact and improve every industry. You have high agency and a bias toward action.

Required Skills:

5+ years of experience building on Salesforce in a technical admin or developer capacity

5+ years supporting Sales, RevOps, or GTM teams

Working knowledge of Salesforce, Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce Integrations

Experience testing and deploying solutions, ideally with source tracking and the Salesforce Metadata API

Experience implementing automation, custom objects, and non-trivial business logic

Working SQL and experience with a data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar)

Practical understanding of GTM concepts: product catalogs, pipeline, forecasting, territories, renewals, expansion, compensation planning and administration

Experience working across an ecosystem of GTM tools including communication platforms, enrichment platforms, quoting tools, CLMs, e-signature platforms, etc.

Hands-on experience building or integrating LLM-based workflows, and building with AI coding agents

Preferred Skills:

Salesforce Platform Developer Level 1 certification or higher

Hands on experience with source control, particularly for Salesforce deployments

Experience with land-and-expand enterprise sales motions, PLG, or developer-first companies

Experience with partner, channel, or cloud marketplace operations

Experience with stakeholder management

Experience with, and a willingness to learn, how to leverage AI to optimize output and outcomes

Experience managing or supporting variable compensation programs

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is a fully distributed company. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and Brazil (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

$4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

$350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

$350/mo AI Stipend

$500 one time home office stipend

$150/mo Team lunch stipend

Unlimited PTO - with an annual 2 week minimum, we encourage you to take time off for yourself

12 weeks parental leave

Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process 

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We’re committed to building an exceptional team and aim to be thoughtful while also moving quickly. We respect your time and strive to make decisions efficiently, depending on scheduling and availability.

You’ll have several conversations with the hiring manager, a member of the Roboflow leadership team, and complete a role-relevant project or challenge.

Throughout the process, you’ll speak directly with team members about what it’s like to work and succeed at Roboflow. Below is the interview process you can expect for this role.

Before the Interview:

The best way to stand out is to write about something you’ve built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

[60m] Technical Assessment

Team Interview Phase:

[30m] Meet with another member of the team

[30m] Meet with another member of the team

Final Interview Stage

References

References are required as part of our process. We will reach out to coordinate timing.

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can.

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Learn More About Us

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

Weights & Biases at CoreWeave

CoreWeave acquired Weights & Biases to create the most powerful end-to-end platform to develop, deploy, and iterate AI faster. CoreWeave operates a growing footprint of data centers covering every region of the US and across Europe, and was ranked as one of the TIME100 most influential companies of 2024. By bringing together CoreWeave’s industry-leading cloud infrastructure with the best-in-class tools AI practitioners know and love from Weights & Biases, we’re setting a new standard for how AI is built, trained, and scaled.

The integration of our teams and technologies is accelerating our shared mission: to empower developers with the tools and infrastructure they need to push the boundaries of what AI can do. From experiment tracking and model optimization to high-performance training clusters, agent building, and inference at scale, we’re combining forces to serve the full AI lifecycle — all in one seamless platform.

Weights & Biases has long been trusted by over 1,500 organizations — including AstraZeneca, Canva, Cohere, OpenAI, Meta, Snowflake, Square, Toyota, and Wayve — to build better models, AI agents and applications. Now, as part of CoreWeave, that impact is amplified across a broader ecosystem of AI innovators, researchers, and enterprises.

As we unite under one vision, we’re looking for bold thinkers and agile builders who are excited to shape the future of AI alongside us. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems at the intersection of software, hardware, and AI, there’s never been a more exciting time to join our team.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you will apply advanced knowledge of software engineering, data architecture, distributed systems, and database technologies to design and operate our enterprise data platform. Your responsibilities will include:

Design and implement scalable data systems and pipelines — 30%: Architect, develop, test, and maintain distributed batch and streaming pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver structured and semi-structured data across production systems.

Develop data transformation and orchestration frameworks — 20%: Build and optimize workflows using technologies such as dbt, Dagster, Airflow, or comparable tools. Establish testing, deployment, dependency-management, data-quality, and observability standards for these workflows.

Improve data warehouse performance and reliability — 15%: Design data models, schemas, partitioning strategies, and storage patterns for large-scale analytical workloads. Diagnose and resolve performance, scalability, availability, and cost-efficiency issues within multi-petabyte data environments.

Build product telemetry and data instrumentation — 15%: Partner with software engineering teams to define event schemas and implement reliable logging, telemetry, and instrumentation for web applications, backend services, and distributed systems.

Develop data catalog and semantic-layer capabilities — 10%: Design metadata, lineage, governance, and semantic-modeling systems that enable consistent business definitions and secure self-service analytics.

Support data-powered AI applications — 5%: Establish data interfaces and platform foundations for internal AI applications, including systems that support automated data discovery, workflow assistance, customer-growth analysis, churn-risk modeling, and abuse detection.

Operate and support the platform — 5%: Monitor production systems, troubleshoot incidents, document operational procedures, and participate in an on-call rotation after completing the required onboarding and training.

This position requires independent technical judgment to evaluate architectural alternatives, identify system constraints, and select appropriate data structures, algorithms, database designs, and distributed-processing patterns.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a closely related technical or quantitative field involving substantial coursework in Engineering.

At least five years of progressive professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, data infrastructure, or a closely related occupation.

Professional experience designing and implementing production data pipelines and distributed data-processing systems.

Professional experience with data transformation or workflow-orchestration technologies such as dbt, Dagster, Airflow, or comparable platforms.

Professional experience designing data models, schemas, and storage strategies for large-scale analytical databases or cloud data warehouses.

Professional experience programming in Python, Go, Java, Scala, or another general-purpose programming language used to build production data systems.

Professional experience with SQL, database performance optimization, data-quality testing, and production monitoring.

Knowledge of software-engineering practices, including version control, automated testing, code review, continuous integration, deployment automation, and technical documentation.

Knowledge of web-application telemetry, event instrumentation, logging systems, APIs, and distributed-service architecture.

Ability to communicate technical designs, risks, and tradeoffs to engineering, data science, analytics, and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating multi-petabyte data platforms or other high-volume, business-critical data systems.

Experience with cloud infrastructure and data services on AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure.

Experience with data catalogs, metadata management, lineage systems, governance frameworks, or semantic layers.

Knowledge of machine-learning workflows, model-development terminology, or the data requirements of production AI applications.

Experience supporting internal platform users, responding to technical questions, and converting user feedback into platform improvements.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a self-directed environment, identify opportunities for improvement, and collaborate across engineering and business teams.

Why Us?

We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

Be Curious at Your Core

Act Like an Owner

Empower Employees

Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $165,000 to $242,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility). 

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

Company-paid Life Insurance 

Voluntary supplemental life insurance 

Short and long-term disability insurance 

Flexible Spending Account

Health Savings Account

Tuition Reimbursement 

Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health 

Family-Forming support provided by Carrot

Paid Parental Leave 

Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside

401(k) with a generous employer match

Flexible PTO

Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations

A casual work environment

A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act 

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements.

At Skillsoft, we believe skills fuel growth. Our mission is to empower every organization and every learner to turn constant change into continuous growth. As part of the team, your skills will help organizations understand what skills they have, what they need next, and how to apply them in ways that drive real performance and progress.

Skillsoft is hiring an experienced Solutions Specialist, who will play a critical role in Skillsoft’s Solutions go-to-market strategy across multiple markets enabling consistent, scalable solutioning while allowing for market-specific depth and specialization. In this role you will have the opportunity to be responsible for shaping, influencing, and co-designing the Customer’s full solution—platform, services, learning experience, and transformation outcomes by partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, and Marketing. 

Our Solutions Specialists apply a structured consulting and discovery methodology to engage complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees and build executive conviction for enterprise-scale transformation. This role combines C-level consulting presence, deep Percipio platform expertise, and strong grounding in instructional design and adult learning principles to ensure that solutions are not only commercially compelling, but also instructionally sound, value and learner-centered, and outcome-driven. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Strategic Discovery & Buying Committee Engagement 

Apply a structured, repeatable methodology to engage complex buying committees across HR, Talent, Learning, IT, Data, and Executive leadership. 

Experience in building executive-level business cases and value narratives that establish urgency, confidence, and alignment for large platform-led deals. 

Manage client relationships, ensuring clear communication and understanding of their needs. 

Surface business priorities, workforce challenges, readiness signals, and constraints to align stakeholders around a shared transformation narrative. 

Platform Solution Architecture 

Influence and shape the entire end-to-end solution, including Skillsoft Percipio platform capabilities, professional services, learning strategy, experience design, and change enablement components. 

Partner with Sales, Customer Success and Professional Services to design solutions that are commercially viable, instructionally effective, and operationally executable. 

Ensure clear alignment between customer outcomes, platform capabilities, services scope, and measurable success criteria that enables executive-level business cases. 

HR Tech Ecosystem & Data Fluency 

Act as a market Subject Matter Expert on Percipio and its role within broader HR tech stacks, including HCM, LMS/LXP, talent, skills intelligence, and analytics platforms. 

Identify data considerations (sources, quality, flows, governance) that influence skills visibility, analytics, personalization, and measurement. 

Ensure solution designs reflect realistic integration and data maturity assumptions. 

Adult Learning, Instructional Design & Learning Experience Integration 

Provide strong consulting expertise to guide clients in their learning and development strategies. 

Experience in adult learning theory, instructional design, and learning experience design to inform solution recommendations and platform use cases. 

Experience in proposing learning experiences are grounded in evidence-based principles such as relevance, application, practice, personalization, and flow of work. 

Influence how Percipio is positioned as a learning and experience engine, not just a content or technology platform, ensuring solutions support sustained behavior change and performance impact. 

Talent, Workforce & Transformation Consulting 

Experience in acting as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on talent, workforce capability, skills, and organizational transformation challenges. 

Conduct deep diagnostics of customer environments, including business strategy, workforce priorities, learning maturity, and HR technology ecosystems. 

Assess transformation readiness and design phased, outcome-aligned approaches that reduce risk and increase adoption. 

Commercialization & Enablement 

Expertise in strategic discovery, solution positioning, proposal development, and solution commercialization with c-level customers. 

Translate customer needs into repeatable solution patterns, and aligning packaged offers, and playbooks that accelerate deal velocity and consistency across markets. 

Customer Insight & Continuous Improvement 

Experience in collaborating and executing feedback loops that improve solution quality, instructional effectiveness, and go-to-market execution over time. 

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS: 

6+ years of professional experience in enterprise solution consulting, platform-led sales, or specialized consulting on platform integration.

Demonstrated ability to build executive-level business cases and influence senior stakeholders and present to all levels of an organization. 

Strong background in learning, talent, workforce, or organizational transformation, with the ability to connect business strategy to capability development. 

Working knowledge and experience in instructional design, adult learning principles, and learning experience design as they relate to enterprise learning solutions. 

Robust consulting background with a proven track record of successful engagements. 

Ability to translate learning science and instructional design concepts into executive-friendly value narratives. 

Experience partnering cross-functionally across Sales, Services, Product, and Marketing with strong experience with virtual and collaboration web tools 

Strong storytelling, facilitation, and presentation skills, including executive workshops and discovery sessions. 

Comfort operating in ambiguous, evolving environments while maintaining structured, outcome-focused approaches. 

Ability to work collaboratively within a team and with clients 

Excellent analytical, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills. 

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and executive presence. 

PREFERRED SKILLS: 

Experience influencing or designing platform + services solutions in SaaS, HR tech, or learning ecosystems

Familiarity with HR technology landscapes (HCM, LMS/LXP, skills platforms, analytics). 

Knowledge of strategic workforce management principles. 

Experienced practitioner of learning facilitation, leadership development, learning ROI metrics and measurement, and/or learning strategy 

Advanced literacy in Generative AI, with an understanding of basic prompting 

Advanced level of desktop application skills (MS365) with ability to learn new technologies and applications quickly as new application skills are required for the position

We also offer Enterprise benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, and paid time off

Skillsoft (NYSE: SKIL) is a global leader in AI-native skills management for the human + AI era. About Our Company:

Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients.

About the Position:

Cologix is seeking a Senior Revenue Accountant to join our Accounting organization. Reporting to the Controller, this role will be responsible for lease and other revenue accounting, with a focus on accurate revenue recognition, billing support, accounts receivable analysis, revenue accruals and deferrals, sales commission accounting, and timely month-end close activities.

What You’ll Do

Maintain the NetLessor lease revenue system in NetSuite to support complete and accurate lease revenue accounting

Coordinate with the Billing team to identify revenue billing and revenue recognition timing differences to ensure related accruals and deferrals are recorded appropriately

Partner with Sales and Billing teams to confirm sales orders are structured to support proper revenue recognition

Monitor accounts receivable balances, evaluate collectability, and record reserves in accordance with Company policy

Align sales commission expense recognition with the related revenue and applicable accounting requirements

Ensure long-term revenue deferrals are recorded, reconciled and amortized accurately

Support the annual external audit by preparing schedules, responding to requests and explaining revenue-related activity

Prepare timely and accurate general ledger entries, account reconciliations and supporting documentation

Organize and maintain revenue accounting support

Own assigned close activities to ensure a timely and accurate month-end close process

Analyze monthly fluctuations and present clear explanations to management

Research and resolve accounting issues, initiate corrective actions and record adjustments as needed

Identify, develop and implement procedures and process improvements that strengthen revenue accounting operations and controls

What Makes You a Good Fit

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting required; CPA preferred

4–8 years of relevant accounting experience

Experience with lease revenue recognition or revenue accounting in a recurring-revenue environment preferred

Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, revenue recognition policies, accounts receivable reserve methodologies and internal controls.

Demonstrated knowledge of ASC 842 (US GAAP)

Advanced Excel skills and a strong aptitude for technology; Power Query experience preferred

Demonstrated ability to interpret, reconcile and analyze large data sets

NetLessor SuiteApp and NetSuite experience preferred

At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

At Vynca, we're transforming care for people with serious illnesses- ensuring that individuals receive the right care, at the right time, in the setting that’s best for them. Our People team plays a key role in supporting that mission by driving a people-first, performance-focused culture across our remote, fast-growing organization.
