jobs.description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the Alberta region in Canada.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of Canadian ranchers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.

This role covers the South West region of Saskatchewan. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

What your day could look like

Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes 

Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap 

Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch 

Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds 

AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted 

Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

jobs.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

Location: Remote.

Contract: Full-time, permanent.

Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 

Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

About The Role

The NOC Incident Manager bridges technical expertise and operational leadership to drive network reliability, swift incident resolution, and continuous process optimization. In this role, you will lead complex technical escalations, oversee Incident and Change Management lifecycles, and collaborate with internal engineering, vendors, and roaming partners

What You'll Do

Incident & Outage Management: Lead and coordinate real-time incident resolution efforts during critical service disruptions, including hosting technical bridges, engaging internal and external engineering teams, managing escalations, and sending regular status updates to key stakeholders. Actively contribute to incidents resolution efforts, having a sound high-level understanding of mobile services including mobile core systems, OSS and BSS systems and it’s correlated end to end interaction in order to coordinate stakeholders and sense check of resolution actions.

SLA & Vendor Governance: Enforce SLA compliance across all services contracted. Act as the primary operational escalation point for external suppliers, vendors, and network partners, holding regular operational performance reviews.

Complex Issue Ownership: Take direct ownership of driving complex, long-running issues to complete resolution. Perform advanced troubleshooting and service restoration activities across core network and service platforms.

Post-Incident Reviews & RCAs: Facilitate post-incident reviews, collaborate with technical leads to identify Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and ensure preventative actions are tracked and executed.

Change Management & CAB: Review and provide final approval for change requests and planned maintenance. Coordinate required additional approvals, host Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, lead implementation bridges, coordinate and notify various stakeholders.

Continuous Process Improvement: Optimize Incident/Change processes, update operational runbooks, enrich the NOC knowledge base, and support OSS/automation initiatives (AI augmented scripting, dashboards, tool integrations).

On-Call Rotation: Being stand-by through on-call rotation for high-priority incidents outside standard working hours.

What You'll Bring

Practical experience leading high-pressure incident bridges and coordinating cross-functional technical teams.

Hands-on experience with Incident, Problem, and Change Management

Efficient stakeholder management able to actively coordinate activities in high stress situations

HLR/HSS, Auth and (e)SIM provisioning ecosystems.

Expertise in mobile packet core architectures providing 4/5G services.

Hands-on experience with GGSN, PGW, PCEF and DPI functions.

Strong technical background in IMS/Voice Core architectures, including VoLTE, SIP, SBC, CSCF, and MGW.

Good understanding of SS7 online charging messaging (CAP1/2/3, MAP), Diameter (S6a/S13, Gi, Gn, Ro, Gy, Gx, Sy), GTP, VoLTE Roaming (S8HR), and SMSoIP.

Practical understanding of Diameter Routing Agents (DRA) and GTP.

Good knowledge of GRX/IPX interconnect environments, IP routing, enterprise firewalls, and edge router configurations.

Nice to have

Degree in Telecommunications, IT, or a related field in telecom network environments.

ITIL Framework: In-depth understanding and hands-on operational experience with ITIL frameworks, specifically around Incident Management and Change Management lifecycles.

Familiarity with TM Forum frameworks (eTOM/TAM)

Solid understanding of end to end service interaction in mobile networks (user and control plane)

Excellent communication skills for coordination with teams and external partners.

Scripting or development experience (Python, Bash, or API integrations) for NOC automation.

Able to effectively use AI tooling (i.e. Claude, Notion) to automise daily routines and create meaningful dashboards

Compensation

At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍 This role is remote and open to candidates across our supported locations in Europe. The range below reflects the full salary range for this role across the countries where it's available:

📍 UK: £70,400 – £105,600
📍 Ireland: €64,800 – €97,200
📍 Western & Southern Europe: €44,000 – €114,600
📍 Central, Eastern Europe & Caucasus: €50,800 – €95,400

Your Home Destination 🛫
At Airalo, we use localized market data, so your compensation band depends on where you’re based. You can learn more about our compensation philosophy in our public handbook.

Most of our hires come in within the first half of the band, which leaves you room to grow, and you’ll see exactly what that looks like from day one. In exceptional cases, where a candidate’s skills and experience clearly exceed the role’s requirements, we’re happy to discuss going higher.
We’ll walk through your range together on your first call with our Talent team, so we’re all aligned for takeoff! 🎒✨

Additional Information

Why People Join Us

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

On-Call

Participating in our on-call rotation is a core expectation of this role. It's essential for maintaining 24/7 service reliability across our global operations, ensuring our systems remain resilient and our customers experience uninterrupted service, regardless of time zone or geography.

Paid Rotation: We offer standby fees + overtime pay.

Delayed Start: No on-call duties for your first 6 months.

Rest & Recovery: Guaranteed rest periods and flexible hours following night incidents.

Shared Load: Rotations are split (Weekdays vs. Weekends) to minimize fatigue.

Please refer to the On-Call Policy in the Airalo Handbook for full details: https://airalo-public.notion.site/our-approach-to-engineering-on-call-policy

Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy

At Docplanner, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. We built the ultimate healthcare powerhouse: doctors partnered with AI.

Having already built one of the world’s largest digital healthcare ecosystems—simplifying practice management for doctors and making care instantly accessible for millions of patients. We are moving beyond administrative tech to integrate AI directly into patient care. From intelligent triage and automated documentation to AI-assisted diagnostics and proactive prevention, we are building a future where top-tier care is accessible to everyone.

Join us and build the technology that will prolong and improve human life.

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 100 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 3.000 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 14 years ago.

Why should you join us?

Because it feels good to know that your work is making the world a little bit better. You get to end your day knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

What makes us proud to work at Docplanner?

Real Impact: We are deeply driven by our mission to improve the global healthcare system for both doctors and patients.

A Supportive Culture: We foster an inclusive, fair, and collaborative environment where every team member is respected and heard.

Recognition & Growth: We actively celebrate your wins and provide clear opportunities to advance your career.

AI-Native Innovation: As an AI-native company, we constantly push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We leverage AI tools to supercharge our own productivity, allowing you to spend less time on routine tasks and more time solving complex, high-impact challenges.

True Flexibility: We offer the work-life balance and flexibility you need to thrive both inside and outside of work

About the team

The Core Platform team is part of the Internal Platform area at Docplanner. We build and maintain the core infrastructure that all Docplanner products run on. Our focus is availability, scalability, security and cost. Our goal is that product teams can ship their applications without having to deal with infrastructure complexity.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join the Core Platform team. You will design, build and operate the Kubernetes platform that product teams use every day. You will work on a shared platform that serves the marketplace and several practice management systems across the Docplanner Group.

The challenges

Standardization. Teams across Docplanner build and run their services in different ways. You will help define one standard way to build, deploy and operate a service, and make it simple enough that teams adopt it without help from us.

Security by default. Every service that runs on the platform should be secure from the first deployment, without extra work from its team. You will harden the platform and its processes while keeping delivery fast for developers.

Availability. All Docplanner products depend on the platform. You will keep it highly available while it grows and changes, including during upgrades and incidents.

Developer autonomy. Product teams should be able to operate their own services without waiting for the platform team. You will replace manual requests with self-service and automation.

Cost efficiency. The platform should use its resources well. You will help teams see what their services cost and reduce waste.

What you will do

Build, monitor and maintain Kubernetes clusters in several regions.

Design and run continuous delivery with a GitOps approach.

Keep disaster recovery procedures current, tested and documented.

Automate service deployments so that they are highly available.

Troubleshoot critical issues and improve system performance.

Support your teammates and share what you know.

What you need

Must have

Deep Kubernetes experience in production. You understand the control plane, scheduling, autoscaling of workloads and clusters, and how a cluster heals itself.

AWS experience with EKS, VPC networking and IAM. You can design for high availability across zones and you know where the costs are.

Infrastructure as code with Terraform, used by a team through pull requests and pipelines.

GitOps delivery with Argo CD or a similar tool, and application packaging with Helm.

Network troubleshooting in Kubernetes and in the cloud: pod networking, DNS, load balancers, IP address planning.

Secrets management and least-privilege access in Kubernetes and in the cloud.

Backup and disaster recovery design, with clear recovery time and recovery point targets.

Using AI coding agents in your daily infrastructure work.

Professional working English, spoken and written. You can discuss technical topics, write documentation and take part in meetings in English.

Nice to have

Managing cloud resources through the Kubernetes API, for example with Crossplane.

Policy as code and network policies to enforce security in the cluster.

Cost-aware autoscaling of nodes and workloads.

Experience with different deployment strategies.

Writing your own tooling and automation in Go or Bash.

Building monitoring and alerting for a platform.

We value a growth mindset. Nobody meets every requirement, so apply if you are willing to learn the rest.

Let’s talk money

A salary adequate to your experience and skills.

True flexibility and work-life balance

Remote or hybrid work model with or hub in Warsaw;

Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly);

20/26 days of paid time off (depending on your contract);

Additional paid day off on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

Private healthcare plan with Signal Iduna for you and subsidized for your family.

Multisport card co-financing for you to have access to sports facilities across Poland.

Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.

Keep growing with us

Free English and Spanish classes.

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

Join us and build the technology that will prolong and improve human life.

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 100 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 3.000 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 14 years ago.

Why should you join us?

Because it feels good to know that your work is making the world a little bit better. You get to end your day knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

Real Impact: We are deeply driven by our mission to improve the global healthcare system for both doctors and patients.

A Supportive Culture: We foster an inclusive, fair, and collaborative environment where every team member is respected and heard.

Recognition & Growth: We actively celebrate your wins and provide clear opportunities to advance your career.

AI-Native Innovation: As an AI-native company, we constantly push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We leverage AI tools to supercharge our own productivity, allowing you to spend less time on routine tasks and more time solving complex, high-impact challenges.

True Flexibility: We offer the work-life balance and flexibility you need to thrive both inside and outside of work

About the team

The Core Platform team is part of the Internal Platform area at Docplanner. We build and maintain the core infrastructure that all Docplanner products run on. Our focus is availability, scalability, security and cost. Our goal is that product teams can ship their applications without having to deal with infrastructure complexity.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join the Core Platform team. You will design, build and operate the Kubernetes platform that product teams use every day. You will work on a shared platform that serves the marketplace and several practice management systems across the Docplanner Group.

The challenges

Standardization. Teams across Docplanner build and run their services in different ways. You will help define one standard way to build, deploy and operate a service, and make it simple enough that teams adopt it without help from us.

Security by default. Every service that runs on the platform should be secure from the first deployment, without extra work from its team. You will harden the platform and its processes while keeping delivery fast for developers.

Availability. All Docplanner products depend on the platform. You will keep it highly available while it grows and changes, including during upgrades and incidents.

Developer autonomy. Product teams should be able to operate their own services without waiting for the platform team. You will replace manual requests with self-service and automation.

Cost efficiency. The platform should use its resources well. You will help teams see what their services cost and reduce waste.

What you will do

Build, monitor and maintain Kubernetes clusters in several regions.

Design and run continuous delivery with a GitOps approach.

Keep disaster recovery procedures current, tested and documented.

Automate service deployments so that they are highly available.

Troubleshoot critical issues and improve system performance.

Support your teammates and share what you know.

What you need

Must have

Deep Kubernetes experience in production. You understand the control plane, scheduling, autoscaling of workloads and clusters, and how a cluster heals itself.

AWS experience with EKS, VPC networking and IAM. You can design for high availability across zones and you know where the costs are.

Infrastructure as code with Terraform, used by a team through pull requests and pipelines.

GitOps delivery with Argo CD or a similar tool, and application packaging with Helm.

Network troubleshooting in Kubernetes and in the cloud: pod networking, DNS, load balancers, IP address planning.

Secrets management and least-privilege access in Kubernetes and in the cloud.

Backup and disaster recovery design, with clear recovery time and recovery point targets.

Using AI coding agents in your daily infrastructure work.

Professional working English, spoken and written. You can discuss technical topics, write documentation and take part in meetings in English.

Nice to have

Managing cloud resources through the Kubernetes API, for example with Crossplane.

Policy as code and network policies to enforce security in the cluster.

Cost-aware autoscaling of nodes and workloads.

Experience with different deployment strategies.

Writing your own tooling and automation in Go or Bash.

Building monitoring and alerting for a platform.

We value a growth mindset. Nobody meets every requirement, so apply if you are willing to learn the rest.

Let’s talk money

A salary adequate to your experience and skills.

Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings.

True flexibility and work-life balance

Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona.

Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly).

Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier).

23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays.

Private healthcare plan with Adeslas for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental).

Free English and Spanish classes.

At Makai, we build and run cloud platforms for clients in healthcare and other high-stakes industries. You take a platform from an empty Azure subscription to production, make the architecture calls and live with them, and own the infrastructure as code, the pipelines and the monitoring. Much of this runs inside our clients’ own Azure environments, so you work with their infrastructure teams daily: reviewing their designs, explaining what we need and why, and keeping work moving when it depends on them.

The ideal candidate will be able to

Design, build and maintain Azure environments with Terraform across multiple subscriptions, from networking and identity to a running application

Build and maintain CI/CD for applications and infrastructure in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and similar platforms: release promotion with approvals, secure deployment identities and repository synchronization

Operate the compute and runtime platforms, from virtual machines to containers and PaaS: base images, upgrades, patching, rolling deployments, autoscaling and capacity planning

Design and maintain secure network architectures: hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN, private endpoints and DNS, Application Gateway and WAF, Azure Firewall, NSGs and isolation between environments

Maintain security and compliance: vulnerability remediation, patching, Azure Policy, and audits against client policies and regulatory frameworks

Design and run backup, high availability and disaster recovery: recovery objectives, zone and region redundancy, restore testing, DR drills and failover

Own production changes and incidents: formal change management with verification and rollback, and troubleshooting through to root cause

Act as the technical counterpart to clients’ infrastructure and security teams: design reviews, proposals, change requests and runbooks

Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building and operating production Azure environments

Expert-level Terraform: you have owned large multi-environment, multi-subscription Azure codebases, designed their code and state structure, and carried out major refactors and state migrations on live infrastructure

Proven experience designing CI/CD systems for both applications and infrastructure on Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable platforms, across many repositories and environments

Strong Linux systems administration background, with a deep understanding of how servers are provisioned, configured and run, and hands-on troubleshooting of services, containers, storage and networking at the OS level

Fluency in Bash and PowerShell; Python is a plus

Deep understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and of identity protocols such as OIDC, OAuth 2.0 and SAML, and of Azure’s control-plane and data-plane authorization models

Proven experience designing, implementing and testing high availability and disaster recovery for production systems, with a solid understanding of the SLAs and recovery limits of Azure services

Hands-on experience with Azure compute services such as Virtual Machines and VM Scale Sets, App Service and Container Apps

Experience building observability on Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights, and fluency in KQL

Solid working knowledge of Azure networking, particularly hub-and-spoke topologies, private connectivity and DNS

Experience operating Azure data services such as Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure SQL Database, Azure Managed Redis, Cosmos DB and Azure Storage

Excellent technical writing and live communication: documentation others can act on without you, and a composed, precise manner on client calls and during incidents

Candidates must be authorized to work in the US. No visa sponsorship is available for this position.

How we work

Small senior teams, real ownership. We'd rather have one engineer who understands a platform top to bottom than several who each own a slice.

Be a flexible, innovative and creative thinker

Be congenial and a team player

Be self-sufficient

Come Join Our Team At Anteriad and innovate the way B2B marketers make data-driven business decisions. 

About Anteriad

We are not just another B2B solution provider. We're problem solvers. We believe that data is the key to unlocking effective solutions that span a range of marketing challenges - from customer acquisition to demand generation to account-based marketing. Data is at the core of everything we do. Our team works tirelessly to create powerful solutions that drive real results for our clients. Whether it's through innovative technology or deep analysis, we're committed to finding the best path to growth for every one of our customers. 

Why Join Our Intelligence & Analytics Team?

Anteriad is seeking a Marketing Insights Lead (MIL) to join our Intelligence and Analytics team. This is a client-facing seat with real ownership. You'll be the person turning their hardest marketing questions into clear, defensible recommendations.

We are trusted by enterprise clients such as IBM, Microsoft, Lenovo, SHRM and Forbes, and have been recognized on Inc. 5000’s Fastest Growing Companies in the US four years running.

This is a remote position with required travel to our New York City office and client meetings as needed. Candidates must reside in the East Coast or Midwest regions and will be expected to work Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours.

This position is not eligible for employer-visa sponsorship, including OPT.

As our Marketing Insights Lead, you'll run your own analytical work streams end-to-end, sit at the table with senior marketing stakeholders, and have the backing of an experienced team of statisticians and strategists. Your work will encompass the following:

Frame the problem. Translate ambiguous business questions ("why is performance down YoY?") into structured analyses with a clear hypothesis and a clear answer.

Run the analysis. Pull and shape the data in SQL, build the models or tests, and pressure-test your own work before anyone else sees it.

Tell the story. Turn statistical output into a narrative that our clients can act on.

Be a trusted partner. Build relationships with client stakeholders so that when something complex comes up, you're the first call.

Raise the bar. Bring better methods, sharper questions, and reusable frameworks back to the team.

Operate independently. Prioritize effectively, and bring strategic thinking to every engagement. The ideal candidate is both technically strong and client-centric.

Curiosity, accountability, and intellectual rigor are essential. You should naturally ask “why?” and “what does this mean for the business?”.

Anteriad means “always moving forward” and we apply that to our company culture by tirelessly promoting an environment that allows our employees to thrive:

• Flexible PTO

• Training & development with unlimited access Percipio LMS

• Community outreach via Anteriad Cares - Encouraging staff to take time to volunteer

• Professional mentoring program - Career guidance from leadership

• Employee Resource Groups - Collaborate with others that share your passions!

• Great benefits for you and your family

• Certified Great Place to Work for the three consecutive years.

Benefits We Bring To You:

• Comprehensive medical (choice of 3 plans), dental and vision coverage

• Company paid short-term disability, long term disability and life insurance

• Optional supplemental life, accident and critical illness insurance plans

• 401K with company match

• Flexible PTO and generous paid holiday schedule

• Fully paid primary caregiver leave (12 weeks) & parental bonding leave (2 weeks)

What You'll do: 

Begin your day by scanning what came in overnight: client requests, open questions, flagged deliverables and building your priority list before the first meeting hits. If something urgent surfaced, you're already on it.

Spend a midday block building a A/B test read-out, manipulating data in SQL, translating raw outputs into a clean, story-driven deck that a CMO can act on by end of week.

Jump on a client call in the afternoon where you're not just presenting findings, you're fielding follow-up questions in real time, pushing back on assumptions, and shaping what comes next.

Close out the day triaging two or three active workstreams across different accounts, prioritizing what moves the needle and flagging anything that needs team input before it becomes a fire.

Some weeks you're deep in creation of reports and data visualizations (PBI, Domo, Excel); others you're presenting at an executive meeting for a key client. 

What You’ll Bring: 

• A quantitative degree (statistics, finance, economics, math, engineering, analytics, or similar)

• 3–5 years of hands-on experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, or B2B data consulting.

• SQL fluency (complex joins, CTEs, aggregations)

• BI tool proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent

• Client presence. You're comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders, pushing back diplomatically, and managing competing priorities across multiple accounts.

• Solid grasp of statistical concepts including A/B testing and predictive modeling concepts

Lead & Learn We lead with unrivaled vision, innovation and execution, always learning and embracing new ways of doing things to stay out in front​

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Security Product Manager to join our team. Security Product Manager is responsible for conveying the company’s security strengths to customers, partners and the market at large. This includes participating in relevant security partnership initiatives, influencing security positioning and branding, and working closely with internal teams to ensure company’s security posture and security products is communicated effectively to all stakeholders. By combining expertise in compliance requirements with a customer-centric approach, Security Product Manager helps position security as a competitive advantage rather than just an internal obligation. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

1. Product Management 

Define the vision and roadmap for Nebius’ security products. 

Owning the ideation, postmortem, prioritization, backlog, and customer feedback processes. 

Guiding new features, systems and services from inception to launch, while keeping customers at the center of everything. 

2. Customer-facing communications 

Lead public-facing communications around security updates or changes in compliance status. 

In the event of a security incident, coordinate user messaging (email notifications, press releases, FAQs) with support from the Head of Security Products and CISO. 

Gather user feedback on user experience and security to guide continuous improvements. 

 3. Competitive analysis and market research 

Conduct ongoing research on industry benchmarks, emerging security standards and technologies, and competitor certifications. 

Identify gaps and opportunities in organization’s product security posture; propose strategic initiatives that differentiate the company’s security story in the market. 

Stay informed about new regulations or frameworks that may influence future product certifications or transparency requirements (e.g., privacy laws, data sovereignty standards). 

 4. Certification and audit support, service ownership 

Collaborate with the CISO office to gather technical evidence or make necessary product enhancements that satisfy certification requirements. 

Take ownership of some security-related services of Cloud platform. 

Track and maintain a certification roadmap (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPPA, etc.), working closely with CISO, GRC & Compliance, Corporate Security departments. Communicate timelines, goals and status updates to leadership and sales representatives. 

5. Cross-functional collaboration 

Coordinate with multiple Product Managers to align security goals with other product roadmaps, ensuring a consistent narrative between product security and external messaging. 

Work with Platform Security, GRC & Corporate Security and legal teams to gather essential information for security products enhancements (e.g., penetration test summaries, compliance reports). 

Work with Customer-facing teams to address client inquiries about security posture and guide them on using security features optimally. 

We expect you to have: 

3+ years of Product Management or Program Management experience with a focus on security initiatives. 

Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and familiarity with how they translate into business value. 

Proven ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, customer-friendly manner (e.g., writing content, speaking at webinars or conferences). 

Stakeholder management skills to align with other Product Managers, CISO staff, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams. 

Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., security feature adoption, NPS around trust, certification progress) and making data-driven decisions. 

Project management skills: demonstrated ability to manage inter-team collaboration within company-wide projects, ensuring timely delivery of cross-functional tasks and alignment with compliance goals. 

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

 Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or PMP; prior experience in regulated industries; prior experience working for Cloud Service Provider.

About Nebius

We're hiring an Offensive Security Engineer to join us at Nebius. You'll design and execute adversarial simulation across our cloud platform - attacking the same infrastructure our customers depend on - and translate findings into measurable security improvements.

Identify threats, which are able to impact an organization's operations. Work closely with Detection & Response and other security engineering teams to run purple team exercises, validate detection coverage, and close gaps collaboratively.

Assess tenant-isolation boundaries and how they can be broken at the low-level stack

Conduct targeted assessments of new products and infrastructure changes before they ship.

Deliver clear, actionable reports for both technical audiences and leadership - with prioritized findings and remediation guidance.

Establish red team processes, tooling, and a methodology that scales as the platform grows.

What we’re looking for 

6+ years in offensive security - penetration testing, red teaming, or adversary simulation 

Deep experience attacking cloud-native environments: Kubernetes privilege escalation, cloud IAM abuse, virtualization and container escapes.

Strong fundamentals across the attack lifecycle: initial access, persistence, lateral movement, data exfiltration.

Proficiency developing custom tooling and post-exploitation capabilities (Python, Go, or similar).

Experience running purple team exercises and working constructively with blue teams.

Ability to write clear, senior-level reports with business-contextualized risk (not just raw findings) that engineers can easily use.

Experience attacking ML infrastructure, model serving pipelines, or GPU clusters.

Reverse engineering and exploits development experience

Application security experience

Familiarity with eBPF bypass techniques or kernel-level exploitation.

Background in vulnerability research or CVE discovery.

Experience with cloud provider internals (hypervisor/networking layers).

Presenting your security research at conferences like BlackHat/DefCon, etc.

Attack surface that's genuinely novel - GPU clusters, AI platforms, multi-tenant cloud at scale.

Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.

Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will focus on three core missions. One, you will help our users and prospects navigate their Grafana journey by engaging with and listening to them in order to provide them with appropriate resources and guidance. Two, with these learnings, you will partner with our Sales Team to connect with other influential people in these organizations to identify new business opportunities that are the pipeline for our company’s revenue goals by partnering proactively with our Sales Team. And three, you will develop valuable, transferable skills to help you achieve your career goals. By fulfilling our three core missions, you will contribute importantly to Grafana Labs’ community and business goals. 

We understand that our commercial success is linked to our open source DNA and users’ success with our software. As such, we want team members who can effectively leverage this connection and help support the long-term health of our company.

In this role, you will balance reactive and proactive work, responding to inbound inquiries as well as outreaching to target accounts. You will need to research and have a detective mindset in order to craft thoughtful, value-add messaging; and you’ll need to be confident driving business conversations on the phone. You will need to know how to use AI as a tool to constantly improve your productivity. 

This is a demanding and rewarding role. It is a fast-paced and challenging environment. While our company is growing sustainably, we still have a lot of building and improving to do. And we do this work together with our teammates from more than 15 different countries. We're looking for driven, humble, technically curious people who embrace a team-first attitude and demonstrate extreme ownership. This is a great team to join, whether you’re just starting your career or looking to pivot into the tech industry. You’ll have managers and teammates that care deeply about you as a professional and human, and you will learn more than you thought possible.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Build and maintain knowledge of our technology, competitors, open source ecosystem, and industry trends

Follow up on inbound leads effectively and efficiently

Use a multi-channel approach (email, social, calling) to proactively outreach to new leads within target accounts; our top SDRs are confident and effective on the phone

Use Salesforce and Grafana dashboards for lead and account management and research

Use research and data to prioritize and customize outreach to target prospects and accounts via email and LinkedIn

Drive effective discovery conversations to understand users’ needs and goals in to provide them the appropriate resources and communicate how Grafana can help them 

Consistently meet new business opportunity and pipeline targets

Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing and sales to win as a team

What Makes You a Great Fit:

Fluent in French and English (written and spoken)

Open to feedback and coaching, always looking for ways to improve 

Clear and concise written and verbal communication style

Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize many tasks and demands

Willingness and ability to take on any task - no matter how small or big - with a focus on quality

Resourceful and proactive in an environment that is constantly evolving

Driven by purpose and by winning with a team-first attitude

Located in France 

Bonus Points For:

Let’s be honest - interviewing is not easy. However, we want you to come prepared and succeed. When we interview, we’re trying to determine a couple of things:

Would you be successful if you were part of our team?

Will you love working here and be a positive influence on your fellow colleagues?

Will you grow professionally and personally during your time here?

We’re looking for people who are curious and passionate about technology, so make sure you invest some time in learning about Grafana Labs. Explore our community, the industry we operate in, what we offer, and how we set ourselves apart.

During your interview, you’ll be sharing stories about your current and past roles and experiences. The best way to frame this is with the CARR model: Context, Action, Results, Reflection. This allows you to succinctly share the experiences you’ve gained.

Remember, humility drives learning and we love working with people who are always trying to better themselves. Throughout our interview process, you will receive feedback, and usually directly in the interview. As you move through the interview process, make sure you listen to the feedback you receive and figure out how to incorporate the advice in the next step of the interview. 

Compensation & Rewards

In France, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is EUR 60,000 - EUR 63,700. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 

Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

jobs.description:
Want to join a company that works on real world problems that make a difference to people’s lives? We are focused on changing how we build what’s around us, helping people to design and construct buildings and infrastructure more efficiently.

Do you have experience of large capital projects in the built environment? Are you passionate about leading data-centric solutions to solve the frustrations and complex problems faced by the industry? We want to hear from you.

Interested? Read on!

_____________________________________________________________________________________

We are Laminar Projects!

We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it)

We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products.

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 200 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job”, we challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life: 

Connects us with meaningful relationships

Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans

Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

We are achieving this vision through the following two missions:  

To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation

To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_____________________________________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

We are looking for experienced Digital Consultants to join our team. You will leverage your industry experience to deeply understand clients' problems, advise them on best practice and deliver data-driven digital solutions tailored to their needs. You will be a proactive individual who directs technical teams to deliver impactful results and excels at communicating complex concepts to less technical audiences.

Team 

The Data & Digital team helps people to use data effectively to improve the performance of their projects or organisations. To do this effectively and at scale we use the modern digital technologies including Azure, Fabric, Power BI and Python. We pride ourselves on being structured and outcome driven, helping us to build the best solutions and helping us to continuously improve what we do.

Your top 5 responsibilities

Solve our clients’ most complex business problems: Develop data-driven digital solutions tailored to clients' needs by fully understanding their business processes and challenging the status quo.

Implement best practice data solutions: Work with our technical experts and lead junior team members to deliver to clients’ expectations by successfully communicating complex business concepts and requirements.

Develop internal Laminar data solutions: Helping Laminar to become data driven by leveraging digital technologies to collect organisation data and enhance operational efficiency.

Productisation of client solutions: Work with our technical teams to develop products that work across different clients.

Following and developing our processes: Following our best practices and identifying areas for us to improve by refining or introducing new processes.

Your Capabilities

As a candidate, you should have: 

Degree educated in one of the following: Engineering, Surveying, Project Management, or similar.

5+ years experience in the engineering/construction of large capital projects (>USD 100m).

2+ years experience driving data and digital solutions set up and implementation across an organisation or large project.

Great communication skills, able to translate complex ideas in a clear and concise manner to a wide variety of audiences.

Demonstrable passion for digital transformation and improving the delivery of Capital Projects, with the curiosity to learn the latest digital tools and processes across project life cycle.

Have an analytical mindset and be able to create structure and clarity from uncertainty. 

It would also be great if you have: 

Chartered in relevant body (e.g. ICE, RICS) or moving towards chartership.

PMP/APM membership and/or MBA.

Consultancy experience.

Working knowledge of information management best practice.

Product Management/Software development experience.

Experience with BI tools (e.g. Power BI).

Experience with databases (e.g. SQL, Azure) 

Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: 

You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge

You like to be the smartest person in the room

You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback

You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

_____________________________________________________________________________________

Benefits 

The standard stuff: 

- Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage – for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority 

- Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term – plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings 

- Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future – with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance 

- Professional body membership. One fee covered per year – so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft 

- Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels – and do your bit for the environment 

The life-changing stuff: 

- In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally – professionally and as a human being 

- Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future – and own a piece of it 

- Flexible working. Work where it makes sense – most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins 

- Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up 

_____________________________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

We get hundreds of applications so please ensure your CV one or two pages. You will also be asked the following questions: 

What new opportunities or experiences are you seeking in this role that your current position hasn’t provided?

Describe a complex business problem you recently solved through a data-driven solution and what was the impact to the project or organisation. 

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders.

You must be located and have the current right to work in the UK. We can support the transfer of existing UK visas, but cannot sponsor new visas.

In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role
At Samsara, we're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to help turn growing Telematics products into major businesses. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations.
The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll help shape what comes next, working directly with customers to understand their operations, test ideas and build solutions they choose to use. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale.
This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction.

What you will do

Work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand unmet needs, test assumptions and identify opportunities worth pursuing. Agree on success measures with Product and Design before investing in a solution.

Lead ambiguous initiatives end to end, from discovery and prototypes through production rollout, adoption and iteration. Use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve, expand or stop.

Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product.

Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time.

Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows.

Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently.

About the role:

In this role, you will: 

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

What you will bring

A track record of shipping customer-facing products and growing them beyond their initial launch. You can explain your contribution to measurable outcomes such as adoption, revenue growth, retention, customer efficiency or cost to serve.

Strong product judgement. You have worked directly with customers, clarified poorly defined problems and made decisions using evidence, including changing direction when an initial idea did not work.

Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way.

Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth.

Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners.

Experience that could be useful
Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. We value evidence of learning a complex customer domain and delivering results; previous industry experience is helpful, rather than essential.

What success looks like
Customers adopt the capabilities you help build and can see the benefit in their day-to-day operations. The products remain dependable as usage grows. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sales Engineer to join our team. This is a remote role based in Germany, reporting to the Sales Engineering Manager in the Solutions Consulting department. In this role, you will serve as the technical pivot point for our sales process, presenting the Zscaler cloud security platform to prospective customers and translating their business goals into enticing, high-impact recommendations. As a trusted advisor, you will guide clients through their digital transformation journeys, gathering technical requirements and driving proof-of-value engagements, presentations, and custom demonstrations that clearly articulate our value proposition while collaborating closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to shape comprehensive account strategies.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

Present the Zscaler cloud security platform to prospective customers to demonstrate clear business value

Set the technical vision and translate customer goals into enticing, relevant recommendations

Act as a trusted advisor to clients, guiding and aiding them through their transformational security journey

Gather customer technical requirements and promote the value proposition through presentations, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept engagements

Partner closely with Account Executives, cross-functional specialists, and extended teams to shape strategic account plans

Who You Are (Success Profile)

You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

About Medium

Medium is one of the world's most influential writing platforms, connecting millions of readers with ideas that matter. We're a small, dedicated team that cares deeply and takes real ownership of the problems we tackle, moving fast while building something that lasts. Our actions and decision-making are guided by four principles: Humans First, Deepen Understanding, Orient for Impact, and Ladder Together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer to help build and evolve the Android experience that millions of readers and writers rely on every day. You'll own Android features end to end. That means digging into what users actually need, building it, shipping it, and paying attention to how it actually performs once it's out in the world. You'll work closely with our design team the whole way through.

This is a product engineering role at heart. We don't have a dedicated product team, so you won't be handed a fully-specified ticket and told to go build it. Rather, you'll be the one figuring out what's worth building in the first place, partnering with design and other engineers, and making good calls when the ask is vague or doesn't quite solve the real problem. Android is where you'll spend most of your time, but we want someone who can also hold their own on at least one other platform, whether that's web, iOS, or backend. That range matters: it means you can see how a feature fits into the bigger picture, make good calls about where logic should live, and work credibly with whoever owns that other platform.

What You'll Do

Own Android features end to end. Understand the problem, build it, ship it, and see how it actually does

Shape what gets built, not just how it gets built. Push back on scope, propose simpler solutions, and raise platform constraints early rather than after the fact

Write idiomatic, well-tested Kotlin and Compose UI that fits naturally into the team's existing architecture

Work directly with iOS, web, or backend engineers depending on what a feature needs, and help decide where functionality should live

Partner with our leadership team, design team, and engineers in the US and France to turn a rough idea into something that actually ships well on Android

Bring superb judgment to ambiguous requests. You can ask good questions, spot edge cases early, and propose reasonable first steps when the full scope isn't clear yet

Own shaping product and feature spaces, maintaining and driving a sense of forward momentum even when the final destination of your work may not be clear

Help raise the bar for the mobile team on code quality, testing, and product thinking

Attend Medium's twice-yearly, in-person offsites (hosted in locations around the U.S.)

What You Have

You've spent several years building production Android apps and you're genuinely fluent in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, coroutines and Flow, and modern Android architecture

You're an expert with all things Android engineering, but you can also hold your own on at least one other platform (web, iOS, or backend) and can work credibly there when a feature calls for it

You think like a product engineer. You don't just build what's asked, but can own and appreciate the impact at a product impact altitude of your work.You understand the problem underneath the request, push back when something doesn't add up, and care about whether it actually worked once it shipped

You've worked closely with designers and engineers on other platforms before. You're good at explaining a technical tradeoff in a way that actually lands for someone who isn't an engineer

You have good instincts about systems, you're adaptable, and you're genuinely eager to learn. You can advocate for an approach while staying open to a better one. We care a lot about collaboration and psychological safety here. We want someone who adds to it

You have the ability to push forward in ambiguity and make great trade off decisions to keep a project moving

Nice to Haves

Experience using AI to improve a team's leverage, reach, output and impact

You've owned product direction yourself rather than just executing someone else's plan

You personally use Medium and are genuinely excited to contribute to its mission, which is empowering humans to write meaningfully for other humans

Benefits

In addition to the new skills you'll pick up, here's what else you'll enjoy by working at Medium:

Working with a fully distributed team: We’re fully remote and have teammates across the U.S. & France

Healthcare benefits covered at 100% for employees and 80% for dependents

Generous parental leave policy

Mental health support through Spring Health (or find a provider through Rula or Kaiser Mental Health Network)

Financial wellness support through Northstar

Stipends for co-working, professional development, wifi, and a one-time home office bonus

Unlimited PTO and standard company holidays

A discounted Medium membership

Why Medium

We're a small team doing meaningful work. Beyond guiding your team's execution, you'll have real influence over engineering strategy, culture, and direction. You'll work alongside people who are genuinely good at what they do and who care about building something worth building.

At Medium, inclusion, diversity, and equity are core to how we work and what we build. We believe a more inclusive team creates a better product—one that’s intuitive, thoughtful, and serves a wide range of users. We strive to foster a supportive, fun, and challenging environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive.

We welcome applicants from all walks of life and strongly encourage those from historically underrepresented groups to apply. Our hiring process is built to ensure fairness and equal opportunity for everyone. Even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your perspective and passion matter more than checking every box.

Learn more about our mission, operating principles, and culture:

Yes to a diverse community

Be part of a better internet

Medium Rules

Operating Principles

Read about our story here.

Read our guidance on AI use for candidates. We believe human ideas have the power to change how people think, for the better. That belief shapes how we hire. We use AI tools ourselves, but we’ve thought carefully about where it adds value and where it gets in the way of something important.

Salary Range

$165,000—$215,000 USD
