jobs.description:
Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, electricians, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber, they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.

Small business owners don't just need software - they need a financial partner.

Running a home service business means juggling cash flow, fronting the cost of materials, protecting the business from risk, and helping customers afford bigger jobs. Today, most small business owners stitch this together with personal credit cards, generic bank accounts, insurance brokers who don't understand their trade, and financing options their customers can't access at the moment they need them. It's fragmented, it's expensive, and none of it is built for how they actually work.

That's the opportunity for Fintech New Bets.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager, Fintech New Bets to discover, validate, and launch Jobber's next generation of financial products - in areas like insurance, consumer financing, and spend and money management (think a card offering and business banking built for Pros). This is a high-impact, highly senior individual contributor role at the intersection of zero-to-one product building and deep fintech domain expertise. You'll take loosely defined opportunities and turn them into live products with real customers and real revenue.

The team

Fintech is one of the fastest-growing parts of Jobber, and a core strategic priority for us as a company. We're investing in this growing area because we believe embedding financial tools within our product deepens our ability to help small businesses be successful.

Whether it's helping small businesses get paid using Jobber Payments, getting access to capital to invest in growth, or offering financing to our customers' customers, we believe small business owners should have seamless access to financial tools that allow them to thrive.

New Bets is the team charged with finding what comes next. As Jobber's fintech business scales beyond payments, we're expanding into new, high-impact financial products - and this role is the product leadership engine of that expansion. You'll work in close partnership with your commercial and strategy counterparts on the New Bets team, who own business cases, partner negotiations, and unit economics - together, you'll take new bets from idea, to business case, to shipped product.

Simply put, we care much more about our customers than any financial institution ever will. That's our superpower.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager, Fintech New Bets who brings deep product expertise, strong zero-to-one instincts, and the ability to lead through influence across a complex, ambiguous, and high-stakes domain.

In this role, you'll own the product side of Jobber's newest fintech bets. You'll look across the financial life of a home service business - how they spend, borrow, insure, and bank - and identify which products Jobber should build, buy, or partner to deliver. You'll run rapid discovery and validation, shape build-vs-partner decisions with embedded finance and banking-as-a-service providers, and lead the first versions of these products from pilot through to scale.

Unlike our established product areas, there is no playbook here. You'll be expected to operate with high autonomy, form conviction from thin data, kill ideas that don't clear the bar, and bring cross-functional partners along with clarity and speed. This is a role for someone who is energized by ambiguity, moves fast without breaking trust, and has shipped financial products before.

As a Staff Product Manager, Fintech New Bets you will:

Take new bets from zero to one: frame the customer problem, size the opportunity, design and run lean validation experiments and pilots, and make evidence-based go/no-go recommendations.

Lead build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions, evaluating embedded finance, banking-as-a-service, insurance, and lending partners on capabilities, economics, risk, and customer experience - and shaping those partnerships alongside our commercial team.

Ship and scale first versions of new financial products, defining the MVP, sequencing the roadmap, and iterating quickly based on customer and market feedback.

Partner deeply with Design, Engineering, Data, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and GTM to navigate the regulatory and operational realities of launching financial products.

Use qualitative and quantitative insights - including unit economics, adoption signals, and risk performance - to form deep conviction about which bets deserve further investment.

Elevate product thinking across the fintech group, shaping how other PMs and leaders evaluate new opportunities, frame trade-offs, and make decisions in emerging financial domains.

Balance the urgency of proving new bets quickly with the rigor required to build durable, trustworthy financial products at scale.

To be successful, you should have:

Extensive product management experience, with a proven track record of taking new products from concept to launch - ideally including at least one financial product with meaningful revenue accountability.

Experience operating at a staff or principal level - defining strategy across ambiguous problem spaces, influencing without authority, and shaping org-wide product direction.

Deep familiarity with fintech products such as card issuing, spend management, business banking, insurance, or lending - and an understanding of the partner, risk, and compliance ecosystems behind them.

Exceptional product sense and commercial rigor. You can pressure-test unit economics and business cases as comfortably as you can critique a customer flow.

A bias for validated learning: you know how to de-risk a bet cheaply, when to double down, and when to walk away.

The ability to connect deep customer insight to long-term business strategy and communicate it clearly to senior stakeholders, external partners, and cross-functional teams.

A high bar for quality, ownership, and outcomes - combined with the judgment to know when to go deep and when to zoom out.

Bonus points if you have:

Experience launching embedded fintech products in a vertical SaaS or platform business

Experience working with banking-as-a-service or embedded finance providers, card networks, sponsor banks, insurance carriers or MGAs, or consumer lending partners.

Experience serving small businesses, particularly in home and field services.

Location:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $169,200, a midpoint of $199,100, and a maximum salary of $228,900, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience, and against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us, too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

jobs.description:
About Phaidra

Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.

The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.

Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:

We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.

We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning.

We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them.

Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo, to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact.

Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Transparency, Collaboration, Operational Excellence, Ownership, and Empathy. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture

Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR. Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India.

Who you are 

You’re an independent worker, skilled in organization, planning, and project management.

You have technical knowledge of industrial controls, building automation systems, and/or air or water cooled chiller plants. 

You have the drive to learn about different industries and technologies, and a passion to help customers operate their plant more efficiently and effectively with Phaidra’s AI supervisory control system.

You can take ownership of your assigned customers and delight them!

You can guide internal and external teams as you coordinate the configuration and installation of the customers industrial plant AI Agents, and provide professional support while you grow customer relationships for future expansion and advocacy.

You thrive in a process-driven environment, yet possess the flexibility to adapt and tailor those processes to each customer's unique needs.

You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to tackle complex projects, leveraging your expertise to drive successful outcomes.

**This role is posted at multiple levels (mid-level and senior). Final leveling, title, and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, and qualifications during the interview process. 
Responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery of complex, large-scale customer programs, including multi-site, multi-product, and highly customized deployments, ensuring successful execution from kickoff through long-term support and customer satisfaction.

Lead program strategy and planning by defining timelines, milestones, resource allocation, and risk mitigation plans across concurrent initiatives, aligning execution with both customer goals and company objectives.

Serve as the primary customer-facing program leader and trusted advisor, proactively guiding customers through technical and operational challenges while delivering strategic recommendations.

Work closely with engineering and product teams to ensure our customer solutions are configured correctly and delivered on time according to the customer’s specific site requirements.

Independently manage high-complexity engagements, navigating ambiguity, prioritizing competing demands, and ensuring consistent delivery against scope, schedule, and quality expectations.

Lead executive-level communication, presenting complex technical concepts, program updates, and risks in a clear, concise, and actionable manner to stakeholders at all levels.

Proactively identify program risks, inefficiencies or gaps in delivery workflows, and lead initiatives to update playbooks or processes that improve delivery, customer experience, and internal operations.

Shape and influence customer strategy by aligning evolving customer needs with long-term product and company direction, providing structured feedback to inform product development.

Establish and continuously improve program management best practices, including documentation standards, onboarding processes, and delivery frameworks.

Own comprehensive program documentation, including project progress milestone records, critical customer decisions, technical requirements, and customer-facing materials.

Lead complex internal initiatives that enhance product capabilities, deployment methodologies, or operational tooling.

Peer-mentor other TPMs on project execution and technical domain nuances; provide 'on-the-job' guidance during onboarding to help new hires navigate internal processes and manage their first customer deployments

Adapt and apply appropriate project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid approaches) based on program complexity and customer requirements.

Uses AI tools strategically to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and guide others in effective AI-assisted workflows.

Key Qualifications

5+ years of technical program or project management experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Proven ability to independently lead large-scale, technically complex customer programs with high levels of ambiguity.

Strong experience working with enterprise customers and distributed, cross-functional teams.

Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.

Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management, risk management, and program execution at scale.

Ability to translate explicit and implicit customer needs into structured requirements and influence product and engineering roadmaps.

Demonstrated expertise in at least two of the following domains, with working proficiency across others:

Data centers

Industrial controls and automation systems

HVAC and mission-critical cooling systems

AI / Machine Learning applications in industrial environments

Proficiency in a wide range of program management tools and methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and risk management frameworks.

Strong documentation and organizational skills with a focus on creating scalable, repeatable processes.

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Strong track record of driving process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.

Experience leading cross-functional technical solution delivery involving engineering, research, and product teams.

Proven ability to mentor, coach, and develop team members.

Experience influencing product strategy through customer insights and program learnings.

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.

Onboarding 
In your first 30 days…

You will be immersed in an onboarding program that introduces you to Phaidra and our product.

You will read various parts of our handbook and familiarize yourself with the documentation culture at Phaidra.

You will join calls with current customers to familiarize yourself with managing customer installs.

You will familiarize yourself with our tools and process for developing customer schedules.

You will meet with members of the Customer Success department to better understand strengths and opportunities with current processes.

By your first 60 days…

You will have a solid understanding of what Phaidra does and how deliver for customers.

You will have met with team members across Phaidra and started building relationships that will help you be successful at your job.

You will have become proficient at navigating the department’s processes and software tools.

You will learn how to manage customer support issues and assist with managing our customer service agreements.

You will assist in creating and managing project and process documentation.

By your first 90 days…

You will have been fully integrated into the Customer Success team and with Phaidra team members across the company.

You will have begun to manage your own customers and projects.

You will help improve our processes and project documentation.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a B2B Paid Media Senior Manager to our Marketing team in Brazil!

This role joins the Revenue Marketing team and focuses on our largest market, Brazil. You will lead our digital marketing initiatives across paid channels and use AI to increase demand generation, lead generation, awareness, and engagement for Wellhub. You will report to the Global Paid Media Director and work closely with the marketing, paid media, and creative teams. You will also manage end-to-end execution of ABM/hyper-targeted, awareness, lead gen, and full-funnel campaigns on LinkedIn, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and more. The role is hands-on: you will design campaigns, analyze performance, and optimize strategy. You will also build, motivate, and lead an in-house Paid Media team in Brazil. The work centers on high-priority strategic projects with visibility to senior leadership.

YOUR IMPACT

Own the Paid Media strategy for Brazil and its role in the overall marketing strategy, in partnership with regional marketing leadership.

Drive the region's targets (cost per MQL, CPA, ROAS, lead and MQL quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and B2B pipeline and revenue), focusing on profitable results at scale and on lead quality over volume.

Lead end-to-end campaign execution across Google and Microsoft Ads (Bing), paid social (Meta and LinkedIn), retargeting, display, and DV360 for SMB and Enterprise audiences.

Embed AI in daily work, from campaign analysis and audience discovery to creative testing, reporting automation, and forecasting. Claude is our primary tool, and you will use our AI Library and internal Paid Media tools. Design the tests that show when platform AI features (Performance Max, AI Max, Meta Advantage+, LinkedIn predictive audiences) beat manual setups.

Bring a strategic view that goes beyond what AI suggests: analyze results and propose hypotheses of your own.

Establish how the team uses AI responsibly (data privacy, brand safety, quality checks, human sign-off). Build AI-enabled workflows, prompts, and agents, and share them with other regions through the team's AI Library.

Lead, motivate, and develop the in-house team in Brazil. Coach them to build AI fluency and measure the gains in speed, efficiency, and performance.

Partner with marketing, creative, data analytics, and sales (including SDRs), and build trust with senior stakeholders. Report results, keep everyone aligned with the Regional Marketing team, and represent Paid Media in global and regional forums, including our bi-weekly global Paid Media meeting.

Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

This role is fully remote and open to candidates based in Brazil. All team members may join occasional in-person meetings or offsites, about once or twice per quarter.

A B2B paid media leader with at least 7 years of hands-on experience driving growth and strategy through paid channels.

A results-driven marketer with a proven record of managing budget and goals at scale, who looks past CPL and CPA to lead quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and pipeline.

A people leader with experience managing paid media team members and leading B2B paid media strategy.

A multi-channel B2B expert with proven success on Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and LinkedIn, including audience segmentation.

Experienced with a CRM such as HubSpot, and aware of how tracking and conversion setup affect campaign optimization.

A curious, test-and-learn builder with hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) and platform AI features, and the judgment to know when to trust AI output and when to check it.

An analytical thinker with strong skills in Google Sheets or Excel (models, forecasts, pivot tables) and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker Studio.

A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership who solves problems and works well both independently and in a team in a fast-growing company, across time zones (UK, Brazil, US, Argentina).

A confident communicator with advanced English (written and spoken) and presentation skills. English is mandatory, as our global team works in English.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in B2B paid media (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, LinkedIn), advanced English, and experience managing paid media teams are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. 

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. 

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a GPU Compute Partnerships & Commercial Operations Manager to secure and manage the external GPU capacity that enables our inference business to serve customers and grow.

Working closely with GTM, technical, and finance teams, you’ll translate commercial demand into provider sourcing priorities, help secure commercially attractive capacity, and manage provider agreements throughout their lifecycle. Your work will help ensure that capacity availability, deployment timelines, and provider economics support customer commitments and business objectives.

You’ll own day-to-day commercial and operational coordination with compute providers — from evaluating proposals and progressing agreements to managing capacity changes, validating service delivery, and ensuring accurate billing.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States.

Align compute supply with commercial demand: Work with GTM and technical teams to understand expected customer demand, deployment requirements, and timing, and translate these into external capacity sourcing priorities.

Source and evaluate compute partners: Identify and assess GPU providers based on pricing, available capacity, deployment timelines, service reliability, and suitability for customer inference workloads.

Coordinate timely payments: Work with Finance and Accounts Payable to ensure approved invoices are paid on time and outstanding issues are resolved, supporting continuity of critical capacity relationships.

Maintain visibility into capacity and commitments: Track contracted capacity, spend, payment schedules, renewal dates, notice periods, provider performance, and open issues to inform commercial planning and upcoming capacity decisions.

Experience in infrastructure partnerships, commercial operations, technology sourcing, or vendor management supporting a commercial business.

Experience coordinating agreements across Legal, Finance, Procurement, and technical teams.

Confidence working with pricing, contractual commitments, operational data, invoices, and service credits.

Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to drive progress across teams without direct authority.

Comfort with infrastructure concepts and translating technical requirements into commercial and operational actions.

Attention to detail in reconciling discrepancies and maintaining clear records of obligations, decisions, and adjustments.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

Experience with GPU compute, cloud infrastructure, data center services, or other capacity-based technology partnerships.

Familiarity with inference workloads and the factors affecting capacity requirements and unit economics.

Experience supporting capacity planning in a customer-facing or GTM environment.

Experience administering SLAs, availability calculations, service credits, and consumption- or commitment-based billing.

Familiarity with contract management, procurement, and accounts payable systems.

External GPU capacity is secured in time to support customer deployments and commercial demand.

Provider pricing and commitments support the inference business’s commercial objectives.

Agreements and internal approvals progress in line with deployment timelines.

Provider issues and capacity changes are resolved with clear ownership and follow-through.

GTM, technical, and finance teams have clear visibility into available and committed capacity, spend, and upcoming provider decisions.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a B2B & Brand Social Media Senior Manager (US) to our Marketing team in the US!

The US is one of Wellhub’s largest and most dynamic markets—and we’re looking for a social media leader who can build our relevance with both the companies investing in employee wellbeing and the people using Wellhub to care for themselves every day.

Partnering closely with our Senior Director of Global Social Media, you will own the shaping and execution of our US social media strategy, connecting B2B authority with B2C engagement and cultural relevance. You’ll help position Wellhub as a trusted voice among HR leaders and corporate decision-makers while inspiring consumers to discover our offering, build wellbeing habits, and become brand advocates.

Across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels, you’ll develop platform-specific strategies that bring these objectives to life. This could mean turning research into compelling thought leadership, creating content with an executive, capturing a cultural moment, or partnering with a creator to show how Wellhub fits into everyday life.

You combine strategic thinking with hands-on creative execution. You understand US business and social culture, know how to speak to different audiences, and can connect strong storytelling with measurable brand and business outcomes. This is a high-visibility role where your work will influence how consumers, partners, and companies discover, experience, and trust Wellhub.

YOUR IMPACT

Lead Wellhub’s US social media strategy across B2B and B2C, building complementary content plans that strengthen our authority with corporate buyers and our relevance with consumers, while supporting partner audiences.

Own the US editorial calendar, balancing business priorities, consumer storytelling, product education, global campaigns, launches, and cultural moments.

Lead our US LinkedIn editorial approach, translating research, customer insights, and company perspectives into engaging content about employee wellbeing, leadership, the future of work, and business impact.

Build consumer engagement across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels, creating content that makes wellbeing relatable, showcases the Wellhub experience, and encourages eligible employees to subscribe and stay engaged.

Develop executive thought leadership, partnering with US leaders and internal spokespeople to shape their perspectives, create content, and strengthen their presence in relevant conversations.

Partner with Revenue Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to amplify reports, customer stories, events, and campaigns that build credibility, support consideration, and contribute to demand generation.

Collaborate with Brand, Product Marketing, and local marketing teams to communicate Wellhub’s value to consumers, turning our network of gyms, studios, apps, and wellbeing experiences into compelling social stories.

Concept, script, shoot, and edit platform-specific content—from executive interviews and customer stories to Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts—using the in-house production studio to bring ideas to life.

Capture spontaneous, social-worthy moments across the office, events, studio sessions, and partner activations, extending their impact through timely content.

Identify US cultural trends, conversations, humor, and moments Wellhub can authentically participate in, adapting global narratives to local audience expectations.

Support the development and execution of US influencer and ambassador programs, working with wellness creators and credible voices in business, HR, and leadership. Manage briefings, content feedback, deliverables, and performance tracking.

Collaborate with US marketing, PR, people, and partner teams, and work closely with global creative colleagues to maintain consistent storytelling, content quality, sonic identity, and brand voice.

Measure performance against audience-specific objectives, including awareness, engagement, growth, sentiment, consumer consideration, and qualified B2B traffic. Partner with marketing teams to assess contributions to subscriptions, lead generation, and pipeline where attribution is available.

Use social listening, competitor analysis, and performance insights to understand consumer interests and buyer concerns, test new formats, and improve content effectiveness.

Oversee proactive community management across US channels, engaging consumers, HR professionals, customers, prospects, and partners while cultivating brand advocates and following global crisis and response protocols.

Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

You have 7+ years of in-house corporate social media experience, with a strong track record in B2B marketing alongside experience supporting B2C brand storytelling.

You have a track record of building brand relevance through social, combining content that engages business decision-makers with compelling consumer storytelling.

You understand how to reach corporate buyers, and how social supports trust, consideration, and longer buying journeys.

You’re fluent in US social culture, trends, and consumer behavior, with strong corporate judgment and brand-safety instincts to identify which conversations and formats are right for the brand.

You bring strong expertise in LinkedIn and consumer platforms such as Instagram, understanding their distinct audiences, algorithms, and creative opportunities.

You’re an excellent writer and editor who can translate complex business insights into clear narratives and make everyday wellbeing feel engaging and relatable.

You’re a sharp editorial and multimedia strategist who is comfortable scripting, interviewing, and directing lean video production in partnership with internal production teams.

You have proven brand-side experience managing brand ambassador and creator programs, from talent vetting, contracting, and creative briefing to brand safety and evaluating campaign results.

You can partner effectively with Revenue Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Brand, Legal, and PR, translating shared priorities into actionable social plans while navigating corporate stakeholder approvals.

You understand how to measure success across brand and business objectives, using data to improve creative decisions and demonstrate impact.

You combine strategic judgment with strong execution, managing calendars, workflows, stakeholder input, approvals, and reporting with ownership and autonomy.

You’re collaborative and comfortable advising senior stakeholders, challenging ideas constructively, and bringing recommendations alongside challenges.

You’re proactive, curious, comfortable testing new ideas, and passionate about wellbeing and digital storytelling.

We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

By understanding their systems and helping them reach production, you will uncover requirements that inform our Cloud, Serverless, and Token Factory teams. The goal is to connect needs across Physical AI industries with product decisions, including improvements that benefit enterprise customers more broadly.
You will also investigate opportunities for new Nebius products. You will develop hypotheses about unmet needs, examine demand and existing alternatives, and build prototypes to test with customers. Your findings will help determine which opportunities deserve investment and what an initial product should deliver.
The work is hands-on. You will write code, deploy and benchmark models, build agents, and troubleshoot infrastructure alongside customer engineers.

Work with customer engineers to understand their workloads, infrastructure constraints, and production requirements.

Translate Physical AI use cases into requirements that Cloud, Serverless, and Token Factory teams can use, backed by measurements and customer evidence.

Identify enterprise adoption barriers and common needs across industries. Work with Product and Engineering to assess gaps and test improvements with customers.

Build agents that set up, run, and debug Physical AI workloads, connecting them to clusters, schedulers, storage, and model servers.

Deploy and benchmark open-weight models with serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, then tune them for customer workloads.

Build prototypes and run technical evaluations to answer specific questions about performance, reliability, and product fit.

Assess demand and existing alternatives for opportunities outside current product teams’ scope, then build where there is a clear market.

Debug across Python, agents, model servers, Kubernetes, GPUs, networking, and storage. Turn successful setups into reusable scripts, deployments, and short guides.

Three or more years in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, ML infrastructure, or similar, including ownership of a production service, cluster, or platform.

Experience working directly with customers or external engineers to scope problems, run evaluations, and explain technical tradeoffs.

Ability to turn an unfamiliar customer problem into concrete infrastructure requirements.

Practical experience building with LLMs or agents, at work or independently, with an understanding of their internals (e.g., transformers, KV caching, or tool calling) and how to evaluate their outputs.

Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure requirements, including identity and access management, network isolation, security, monitoring, and reliability.

Strong Python and Linux skills: you can read unfamiliar code, automate a setup, and debug from logs and metrics.

Practical experience with containers and Kubernetes, including configuration, networking, storage, and scheduling.

Enterprise customer engineering, solutions architecture, consulting, or taking a new product from an initial customer problem to adoption.

Distributed compute such as Ray, Slurm, Spark, or multi-GPU jobs.

NVIDIA GPU workloads, including memory management, drivers, CUDA, NCCL, and monitoring.

Model serving with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or TGI.

Robotics, simulation, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, world models, or tools such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, and Cosmos.

Infrastructure automation and enterprise integrations, including Terraform, CI/CD, private connectivity, and identity federation.

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. 

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

Our Core Technologies

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

What You'll Do

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

What We Look For:

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

Nice To Have:

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

• Conversation design or UX writing experience

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

Environmental & Working Conditions

Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Role Summary

We are seeking dynamic sales professionals to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for growing and developing strategic relationships with National Life Group’s distribution partners. Your focus will be on finding new business relationships and collaborating with existing strategic partners to develop and implement growth-oriented business goals. In addition, you will prospect and develop business relationships to drive sales of life and annuity products. You will form strong partnerships with agencies to ensure mutually beneficial relationships with an emphasis on customer service, business development, profitability, and retention. This role requires a relationship builder with a sales focus, excellent communication and presentation skills, strong work ethic, a passion for life and annuity products, and a competitive drive to succeed.

Responsible for building new and growing existing relationships with agents and agencies to increase revenue from life and annuity sales.

Support agents and agency marketers in product selection, case design, and illustration fulfillment.

Conduct training, both in person and virtual, on products, processes, business development and services offered by National Life Group.

Onboard new relationships with National Life Group to quickly grow and develop business.

Maintain an active understanding of the competitive landscape and current industry trends to create innovative solutions designed to meet customer needs.

Minimum Qualifications

An entrepreneur with a history of demonstrating year over year growth with strategic partners in life and annuity products.

Exceptional relationship management skills, including the ability to get things done, breaking down barriers, and finding/executing solutions.

Excellent problem solving and communication skills (verbal and written).

Strong organization and self-management skills, including managing travel and business expenses.

Ability to travel more than 50% of your time, growing and developing new and existing agency relationships.

Team player who can work with other field leaders and internal support roles to collaboratively develop business relationships.

History of success in a sales role, overcoming objections with creative problem solving and optimism to provide the best solution for customers.

AI Proficiency Expectations 

At National Life Group, we view AI as an enabler of human potential. We use AI to help us work smarter, serve more clients, and keep our promises, while remaining a relationship-driven business where our people are our greatest strength.

All applicants are expected to:

Leverage approved AI tools, where appropriate, to improve the efficiency, quality, and impact of their work.

Stay curious and open to new AI-enabled ways of working.

Exercise sound judgment by reviewing and validating AI-generated content.

Maintain accountability for the accuracy, quality, fairness, and integrity of work products by adhering to National Life’s AI guiding principles.

Use AI responsibly and in accordance with company policies related to confidentiality, data privacy, security, compliance, retention and intellectual property.

Your benefits start day one and are flexible and customizable to your and your family’s specific needs. Check out the BENEFITS of a Career at National Life!

Compensation for this role is earned primarily through commissions which are calculated as a percentage of life and annuity sales and pay guarantees may be offered for the first year of employment.

The total compensation package for this position may also include a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. 

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. 

The Role: 

As a Software Engineer within our Billing group, you will play a key role in developing core areas of our new billing platform. You’ll provide world-class experiences to thousands of customers who use and trust Paddle every day. You'll take the lead on discovering new features, planning their implementation, and contributing your technical expertise to shape the future of our billing platform.

You’ll collaborate with multiple teams—engineers, product managers, and designers—working across a wide range of areas that will give you plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career as a valued member of our engineering team.

What you'll do: 

Independently deliver on milestones that may span across multiple systems within Billing.

Make changes with care and precision, recognising the importance of correctness when working with financial data.

Contribute to systems designed for scale, reliability, and security, following established architectural patterns.

Write clear, well-structured, and well-tested code that meets team standards.

Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving constructive feedback.

Work closely with other engineers, product managers, and designers to understand requirements and deliver solutions.

Break down larger pieces of work into manageable tasks and estimate your own work with guidance.

Help monitor and support production services, investigating and fixing issues as they arise.

Contribute to shaping our team and wider engineering culture to ensure Paddle remains an exceptional place to work.

Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data, Risk, and Operations to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

Help shape product direction by providing technical insights, trade-offs, and delivery estimates.

Partner with Customer Support or Operations teams to investigate and resolve production issues.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

You have a development background with Go.

Have experience designing and building systems to handle high traffic at scale in a cloud-based environment in AWS

Are someone who enjoys collaborating with our technical and non-technical departments

Have a proactive attitude towards finding ways to improve the code and team processes.

A strong understanding of the development process - from design through to deployment, maintenance, and what that means for day-to-day development.

A strong understanding of API principles and best practices.

A proven track record of bias for action and strong customer focus.

Solid communication and collaboration skills, you should be comfortable working alongside both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Are someone who takes pride in what you build.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

jobs.description:
About Cobalt

At Cobalt, we believe everyone deserves to live and work in a safer, more secure world. Founded in 2013 on the belief that penetration testing could – and should – be better, we set out to challenge the status quo and transform how organizations approach offensive security.

Today, we’re leading the way in transforming the offensive security market, bringing together world-class security expertise, innovative technology and a global community of security professionals to make security testing more seamless, effective and collaborative. Our diverse, fully-remote team partners with organizations of all sizes to help them OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

And we’re just getting started!

AI is fundamentally reshaping the cybersecurity landscape, creating new opportunities, new challenges and entirely new ways of thinking about security. At Cobalt, we’re not waiting to see what happens next; we’re helping define it. We’re challenging conventions, pushing boundaries and reimagining what’s possible in offensive security.

Customers can launch a pentest in as little as 24 hours through our SaaS platform and exclusive Cobalt Core community. With 500+ highly vetted security testers, representing just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core conducts thousands of tests annually, helping organizations identify and remediate risk across their evolving attack surfaces.

This is an exciting time to join Cobalt. We’re looking for ambitious, creative and agile leaders who thrive on change, think beyond traditional playbooks and have the vision to create new categories, shape markets and build what comes next. If you’re excited by the opportunity to make a real impact in a market undergoing significant transformation, we’d love you to be part of our journey.

Description

Cobalt is looking for a Channel Account Manager to develop, manage, and grow our technology and strategic partner ecosystem across the UK. This role will be responsible for building strong relationships with existing partners, identifying and recruiting new strategic partners, and driving joint go-to-market initiatives that generate pipeline and revenue for Cobalt.

You will manage a diverse portfolio of partners, including technology vendors, OEMs, solution integrators, security and IT consulting firms, and strategic alliance partners. Working closely with partners and internal teams, you will develop joint business plans, strengthen sales and marketing alignment, enable partner teams, and create opportunities to expand Cobalt's market presence.

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role for someone who can balance strategic relationship management with day-to-day execution. You will own partner engagement and performance across your territory, driving measurable outcomes through partner-sourced pipeline, joint selling initiatives, and revenue growth.

What You Would Do

Partner Relationship Management: Own and grow relationships with strategic Cobalt partners across the UK, including technology vendors, OEMs, solution integrators, security software companies, and IT consulting firms.

Partner Recruitment & Development: Identify, engage, and develop new partner relationships while expanding the engagement and contribution of existing partners.

Joint Business Planning: Develop and execute partner business plans, go-to-market strategies, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) focused on generating pipeline, increasing partner engagement, and driving shared revenue.

Partner Enablement: Train and enable partner sales and technical teams to effectively position Cobalt's Pentest as a Service platform, communicate its value proposition, and identify opportunities within their customer base.

Joint Go-to-Market Execution: Build and execute collaborative marketing and sales initiatives, including co-branded content, campaigns, webinars, events, account mapping, lead-sharing programs, and joint customer engagements.

Pipeline & Revenue Growth: Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities through joint prospecting, referrals, co-selling, and reseller activities. Own partner pipeline reporting, forecasting, and progress against revenue targets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Cobalt's Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to align partner priorities, support joint selling activities, and identify opportunities for deeper solution alignment and market expansion.

Partner Operations & Performance: Establish and maintain effective partner engagement processes, including pipeline governance, reporting, lead management, enablement resources, and ongoing performance reviews.

Market Development: Identify opportunities to expand Cobalt's presence across EMEA technology and cybersecurity ecosystem through strategic partnerships, industry relationships, and joint market initiatives.

You Must Have

5+ years of experience in channel management or partner management within B2B SaaS or cybersecurity (preferrably).

Experience managing, developing, or supporting relationships with technology partners, solution integrators, resellers, OEMs, or strategic alliances.

Understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategies, channel sales motions, and partner-led revenue generation.

Demonstrated ability to build relationships, develop joint business plans, and drive measurable business outcomes through partners.

Experience developing and executing partner-facing marketing and sales initiatives, including joint campaigns, co-branded content, webinars, events, and account mapping.

Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and commercial stakeholders.

Experience managing partner pipelines, tracking performance, and providing accurate reporting and forecasts.

A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a willingness to roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Ability to manage multiple partner relationships and initiatives while maintaining strong organization and follow-through.

Nice to Have

Experience in a quota-carrying role, with direct responsibility for pipeline generation or revenue targets.

Existing relationships within the UK and wider Europe cybersecurity, IT services, and technology partner ecosystem.

Experience selling or partnering within cybersecurity, penetration testing, or security services.

Familiarity with selling into IT and security leadership, including CISOs, CTOs, and other senior technology stakeholders.

Experience negotiating partner agreements and managing complex partner or alliance relationships.

Proficiency with Salesforce, PartnerStack, and other CRM or partner management platforms.

Experience working with cross-functional teams in a scaling SaaS organization.

Why You Should Join Us

Shape the Future of Cybersecurity: Help define the Continuous Offensive Security Market, build Cobalt's global brand and establish category leadership in a rapidly growing industry.

Make a Strategic Impact: Work alongside an experienced executive team, influence company strategy and lead a global marketing organization through Cobalt's next phase of growth.

Share in Our Success: Enjoy competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan, with the opportunity to share in the long-term value you help create.

Comprehensive Benefits: Access retirement savings 401(k) in the US or pension in the EU, healthcare coverage and dedicated stipends for wellness, home office equipment, Wi-Fi and learning and development.

Work Flexibly, Live Fully: Benefit from generous flexible paid time off and 12 weeks of paid parental leave, supporting your wellbeing and life beyond work.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Enterprise Business Development Representative to join our team! In this role you will work closely with your Account Executives, Marketing and Partner teams to ensure EMEA builds strong opportunities in key target accounts. Your responsibilities will include outbound calling, video prospecting, crafting compelling messaging as well as qualifying leads to start high quality conversations for your AEs.

Organize, log activity, and categorize sales lead information into our CRM, as well as utilize other prospecting tools.

Be able to articulate and sell Fivetran’s value to prospects and how we can support their business goals.

Adhere to your inbound and outbound KPIs as well as being comfortable balancing your time & competing priorities.

Experience outbounding into large enterprise businesses, with a track record of high performance.

Confident qualifying inbound/outbound leads.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Highly curious and interested in solving our customer's problems.

Able to convey technical principles in a way that is easy to understand.

Comfortable with daily, weekly and monthly calls, email and meeting targets.

Intrinsically motivated person with a 'get stuck in' attitude.

jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers

Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team

Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training

Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS

Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions

Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders

Advocate and advance modern software development practices

Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value

Collaborate with other teams in the organisation

Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar

You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development

Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes

Experience with version control systems such as git

Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other

Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality

Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written

Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu

Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models

People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

Annual compensation review

Recognition rewards

Annual holiday leave

Maternity and paternity leave

Employee Assistance Programme

Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
